title: Customer Delivery Architect | 10+ years exp, SP routing platforms, architectural and validation expertise
description:
**Meet the Team**
Customer Experience (CX) is a team of extraordinary technical experts whose #1 focus is to deliver a premier customer experience and accelerate value realization. Our team, Solution Validation Services (SVS), is an integral part of Cisco Customer Experience, specializing in pre-deployment solution validation, software qualification, and architectural assurance for complex, mission-critical networks prior to Go-Live. We help Tier-1 Service Providers, Web/Cloud hyperscalers, and large Enterprises tackle their toughest business and operational challenges through network-centric testing, digital twin lab simulations, and advanced test automation. Our success is proven through accelerated customer deployments, reduced operational risk, premier customer satisfaction metrics, and employee engagement excellence.
  
  
**Your Impact**
As An Architect In SVS, You Will Provide Top-tier Technical Leadership And Drive The Validation Strategy For Next-generation Service Provider Networks
  
  

* Architectural Influence: Translate complex validation outcomes and testbed findings into actionable business risk mitigation strategies for C-level and senior engineering leadership.
* Solution Validation & Assurance: Lead end-to-end testing of next-generation Service Provider routing architectures, major software releases (Cisco IOS-XR 64-bit), and modern transport solutions (SRv6, BGP EVPN, Routed Optical Networking) to guarantee production readiness.
* Lab Digital Twin Simulations: Build full-scale, high-fidelity customer simulations in world-class SVS test laboratories to uncover, isolate, and resolve sophisticated protocol, scale, and multi-vendor interoperability bottlenecks before production deployment.
* Test Automation Excellence: Architect and implement continuous test automation frameworks using Cisco pyATS/Genie, CXTM, and CI/CD pipelines, driving automated test coverage and accelerating project delivery velocity.
* Defect Advocacy & Engineering Liaison: Act as the primary technical escalation authority during validation, partnering directly with Cisco Product Engineering (XR Dev, HW/Silicon teams) to triage defects, validate SMUs/patches, and ensure rapid resolution.
* Pre-Sales & Scoping Leadership: Partner with SVS Business Development Managers (BDMs) and Account Teams on pre-sales scoping, developing Statements of Work (SOW), Level of Effort (LOE) models, and Joint Test Plans on Record (JTPOR).
* Talent Mentorship: Mentor, coach, and elevate the technical proficiency of consulting engineers across the global SVS organization, fostering a culture of innovation and delivery excellence.

**Decision Making & Scope of Impact**

* Strategic Autonomy: High degree of technical autonomy: determines validation methodologies, test strategies, and architectural best practices across global SP engagements.
* Business Impact: Decisions directly impact customer Go-Live success, network availability, multi-million dollar project margins, and Cisco's trusted advisor standing with Tier-1 accounts.
* Organizational Alignment: Translates global CX and SVS strategic priorities into concrete technical initiatives, testbed innovations, and delivery standards.

**Role-Specific Responsibilities**

* Customer Architectural Engagement: Collaborate closely with customer Principal Architects, Cisco Account Teams, and CX Technical Leaders to define validation scopes, acceptance criteria, and migration test strategies.
* Deliverable Governance: Author, review, and formally approve key SVS deliverables, including Detailed Test Plans (DTP), Joint Test Plans on Record (JTPOR), Method of Procedures (MOP), and End of Test Reports (EOTR).
* Performance & Scale Validation: Synthesize complex traffic profiles and performance benchmarks utilizing industry-standard hardware traffic generators (Spirent TestCenter, Keysight/Ixia IxNetwork) and WAN impairment tools to validate line-rate throughput, QoS behavior, and failover convergence.
* Automation & Tooling Leadership: Drive the adoption of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and Test Automation as Code across SVS delivery pods, building reusable pyATS test scripts and CI/CD validation pipelines.
* Advanced Troubleshooting & RCA: Lead root cause analysis (RCA) on sophisticated customer defects, analyzing packet captures, router debug logs, and telemetry streams to pinpoint software bugs and configuration regressions.
* Knowledge Transfer & Assets: Champion knowledge sharing by authoring best-practice whitepapers, test methodology playbooks, and reusable test suites to scale delivery efficiency globally.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Education & Experience: Typically requires a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Telecommunications Engineering, or equivalent plus 10–15+ years of relevant experience in Service Provider network design, testing, validation, or advanced technical delivery.
* Core Platform Expertise: Deep, hands-on architectural and validation expertise in Cisco Service Provider routing platforms and network operating systems.
* Consulting & Client Engagement: Proven experience in customer-facing consulting, technical leadership, or solution architecture roles engaging with senior-level decision makers.
* Certifications: Expert-level Cisco certification (CCIE Service Provider or CCIE Enterprise/Routing & Switching) or equivalent proven industry standing is strongly desired.
* Software & Automation: Demonstrable foundation in software programmability and automation scripting (Python, REST APIs, JSON/YAML).
* Communication Skills: Exceptional written and verbal communication, executive presentation, and interpersonal skills with the ability to navigate ambiguous, high-pressure environments.

**Preferred Technical Qualifications**
Strong architectural understanding and hands-on validation expertise across minimum two of the following SP domain areas:
  
  

* Service Provider Core & Edge Routing Architectures (Converged SDN Transport & RON):
* Cisco SP Platforms
* Operating Systems
* Core Routing Protocols
* Segment Routing & Traffic Engineering
* Multi-Service VPNs & EVPN
* SP Network Timing & 5G Sync
* Routed Optical Networking (RON)
* SP Resiliency & Security
* SP Automation, Orchestration, Observability & Tooling:
* Cisco pyATS & Genie Test Frameworks
* SP SDN Orchestration & Controllers
* Data Modeling & Interfaces
* Streaming Telemetry & Observability
* Scripting & CI/CD Pipelines
* Test Lab Simulation, Traffic Generation & Telco Cloud:
* Hardware Traffic Generation
* Virtualization & Digital Twin Platforms
* SP Cloud & Telco Infrastructure

**Leadership & Autonomy**

* Self-Direction & Initiative: Operates with high autonomy, determining methods and validation frameworks on strategic, high-visibility customer projects.
* Strategic Advisor: Serves as a trusted technical advisor to leadership and customers, translating strategic technology goals into actionable validation programs.
* Team Leadership: Champions innovation, leading internal initiatives to advance SVS testing capabilities, tooling, and delivery best practices.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. title: IT Infrastructure & Operations Consultant (Onsite)
description:
**Department:**
IT / Operations

**Employment Type:**
6 months contract

**Location:**
Kharadi, Pune (Onsite)

**Experience:**
3–6 years preferred

**Shift:**
US Eastern Shift (6:30 PM to 3:30 AM IST)

**About the Role:**

We are looking for a hands-on IT Infrastructure & Operations Consultant to manage and optimize the organization's IT ecosystem, including software applications, cloud platforms, user access, licenses, networking, and hardware assets.

The individual will be responsible for ensuring that employees have access to the right tools, licenses, devices, and permissions to perform their jobs effectively and securely. This person will own the administration and documentation of the company's technology stack, identify opportunities to reduce software costs, evaluate new technologies, and help employees get the most out of the tools they use.

The ideal candidate is organized, technically proficient, security-conscious, and comfortable managing a diverse range of SaaS applications, cloud services, and IT infrastructure in a growing organization.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. SaaS Application & License Management**

* Manage the organization's software subscriptions, licenses, and user accounts across all business applications.
* Administer tools and platforms including Microsoft 365, Zoho Workplace and other Zoho applications, AWS, Apollo, Tailscale, Cloudflare, Cursor, AI tools, and other current or future company applications.
* Provision, assign, modify, reclaim, and revoke licenses based on employee roles, requirements, and employment status.
* Maintain a centralized inventory of applications, including license counts, assigned users, subscription plans, renewal dates, costs, billing information, and application owners.
* Monitor license utilization and identify unused, duplicate, underutilized, or redundant subscriptions.
* Manage renewals, upgrades, downgrades, cancellations, and vendor communications.
* Ensure license assignments comply with vendor licensing terms and organizational policies.

**2. User Access, Identity & Permission Management**

* Manage employee onboarding, role changes, and offboarding across all company applications.
* Configure and maintain role-based access control (RBAC), permissions, and access policies within each platform.
* Create and manage user groups, teams, departments, and permission groups to ensure the right employees have access to the appropriate features and resources.
* Implement least-privilege access principles and ensure access is granted based on business requirements.
* Review access rights periodically and remove unnecessary or outdated permissions.
* Administer multi-factor authentication (MFA), single sign-on (SSO), and related identity and access management features where supported.
* Maintain auditable records of user access, license assignments, access changes, and administrative actions.
* Coordinate with department leads to understand access requirements and approve changes where necessary.

**3. IT Asset & Hardware Management**

* Manage the organization's hardware inventory, including laptops, peripherals, networking equipment, and other IT assets.
* Coordinate with approved vendors for laptop procurement, configuration, shipping, delivery, repairs, replacements, and warranty claims.
* Track device assignments, serial numbers, asset tags, specifications, purchase dates, warranty details, shipping status, and employee ownership.
* Ensure devices are prepared and delivered to employees before their joining dates, including remote employees where applicable.
* Maintain records of device allocation, returns, repairs, replacements, and decommissioning.
* Coordinate secure device setup, software installation, updates, and data removal when devices are issued, reassigned, or returned.
* Track hardware expenditure and identify opportunities to optimize procurement costs and device utilization.

**4. Cloud Infrastructure & Networking**

* Provide basic administration and operational support for cloud services, particularly AWS, including user access, permissions, account organization, resource visibility, and usage monitoring.
* Maintain a working understanding of networking fundamentals, including DNS, IP addressing, VPNs, routing, firewalls, connectivity, and network troubleshooting.
* Administer and support networking and connectivity tools such as Tailscale and Cloudflare, including relevant access policies, configurations, and user permissions.
* Assist with managing domains, DNS records, SSL/TLS certificates, and other related services where applicable.
* Troubleshoot routine connectivity, access, configuration, and endpoint issues.
* Coordinate with developers, cloud engineers, or external specialists for complex infrastructure changes, outages, or technical issues.
* Monitor cloud and service usage, flag unusual activity, and help identify cost optimization opportunities.

**5. IT Documentation, Reporting & Compliance**

* Maintain a centralized and up-to-date IT asset and software inventory.
* Develop periodic reports covering:
* Software applications and subscription plans.
* Total licenses purchased, assigned, available, and unused.
* License costs, renewals, and upcoming contractual commitments.
* Employee access, user groups, roles, and permissions.
* Hardware inventory, assignments, procurement, and warranty status.
* Cloud service usage and relevant expenditure.
* Access reviews, offboarding completion, and outstanding IT issues.
* Establish standard operating procedures (SOPs) for application administration, access requests, device management, and employee onboarding and offboarding.
* Maintain appropriate records to support internal audits, security reviews, and compliance requirements.
* Ensure documentation is accurate, accessible to authorized personnel, and updated whenever changes are made.

**6. Technology Evaluation & Cost Optimization**

* Evaluate new software, AI tools, productivity applications, and infrastructure solutions based on business requirements.
* Research alternatives to existing tools and compare features, pricing, security, integrations, scalability, and ease of use.
* Identify opportunities to consolidate applications, eliminate redundant subscriptions, negotiate better pricing, and optimize license allocation.
* Prepare recommendations for management, including cost-benefit comparisons and implementation considerations.
* Assess new AI tools and developer productivity platforms, including tools such as Cursor, against business needs and applicable security policies.
* Coordinate pilots, trials, and rollouts of approved tools.
* Maintain an up-to-date view of the organization's technology stack and recommend improvements as the company grows.

**7. Employee Training & IT Support**

* Help employees understand and use the company's software applications effectively.
* Conduct onboarding sessions, tool demonstrations, training workshops, and knowledge-sharing sessions.
* Create user guides, FAQs, and documentation for frequently used tools and workflows.
* Assist employees with application access, license issues, permissions, device setup, connectivity, and routine technical problems.
* Promote the effective adoption of existing tools before recommending additional software.
* Track recurring IT issues and recommend process or configuration changes to prevent them.

**Required Skills & Qualifications:**

* 3–6 years of experience in IT administration, IT operations, systems administration, SaaS administration, or a similar role.
* Hands-on experience administering multiple SaaS applications, managing user accounts, and assigning software licenses.
* Familiarity with Microsoft 365, Zoho applications, cloud platforms, and modern business productivity tools.
* Understanding of user provisioning, access controls, RBAC, user groups, MFA, and basic identity management.
* Working knowledge of AWS administration, account permissions, and cloud cost monitoring.
* Basic understanding of networking concepts, DNS, VPNs, firewalls, and connectivity troubleshooting.
* Experience managing hardware inventory, laptop procurement, vendor coordination, shipping, and asset tracking.
* Strong documentation, reporting, and organizational skills.
* Ability to evaluate software products, compare alternatives, and make cost-conscious recommendations.
* Good communication skills and the ability to train employees with varying levels of technical proficiency.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and coordinate with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with identity providers and SSO solutions such as Microsoft Entra ID, Google Workspace, or equivalent platforms.
* Familiarity with endpoint management and device security solutions such as Microsoft Intune or equivalent tools.
* Experience with IT asset management, SaaS management, or license optimization platforms.
* Basic understanding of cloud security, access auditing, backup practices, and incident response.
* Familiarity with AI productivity tools and developer tools, including enterprise account management and data security considerations.
* Experience creating automated workflows or scripts for user provisioning, reporting, and routine IT administration.
* Relevant certifications in Microsoft 365, AWS, networking, or IT service management are an advantage.

title: CDN & Cloud Network Engineer - Akamai
description:
**Role overview**

Akamai CDN delivery, Akamai WAF, DNS and traffic management, and the Azure networking that connects the edge back to origin. You'll design and make the changes, be the person others come to when traffic behaves strangely, and raise the standard of how we run the edge.

You'll work day to day with platform engineers, application pods, and cybersecurity, and act as the technical reference point for CDN and edge security across the team.

**Key responsibilities**

- Own CDN delivery configurations across a large public web estate: caching strategy, request routing, origin failover, and performance tuning — designing and implementing changes, end to end.

- Own WAF policy across the estate: rule design and tuning, false-positive triage, protection updates, and hands-on response during live attack traffic, working alongside cybersecurity.

- Run DNS and global traffic management, including regional routing, load balancing, and failover between origins.

- Manage TLS certificates and secure delivery standards at the edge.

- Configure and troubleshoot the Azure networking that fronts our origins: Application Gateway, load balancers, NSGs, DNS, and traffic routing.

- Lead technical investigation of complex performance and availability issues, tracing requests from browser through edge to origin using logs, monitoring, and diagnostic tooling.

- Act as senior technical escalation during incidents affecting traffic, availability, or edge security, and drive root cause analysis so problems don't come back.

- Review changes and designs from other engineers, and share edge and CDN knowledge across the team.

- Keep documentation, runbooks, and knowledge articles accurate and useful.

**Required qualifications and requirements**

**Essential**

- Deep, current hands-on experience running Akamai in production at scale: property configuration, caching, routing, origin management. You should be comfortable opening a property and knowing exactly what it does.

- Hands-on experience operating Akamai WAF (App & API Protector or Kona): policy design and tuning, false-positive management, and working through real attack traffic — not just reviewing dashboards.

- Strong command of how the web actually works: HTTP/HTTPS, TLS, DNS, caching behaviour, headers, and the full request path from client to origin. You can debug from a HAR file, curl output, or edge logs.

- Solid Azure networking experience: application gateways, load balancers, NSGs, DNS, and traffic routing between edge and origin.

- A track record of diagnosing hard production issues across edge, network, and application layers.

- Ability to produce clear technical documentation and explain edge behaviour to engineers and business stakeholders.

**Desirable**

- Bot management and DDoS mitigation experience.

- Multi-CDN experience (e.g., CloudFront, Cloudflare, Tencent) or CDN migrations.

- Terraform (Akamai provider) and CI/CD pipeline experience.

- Experience operating within security and operational risk controls in regulated environments.

- Experience managing configuration through APIs or infrastructure as code.

description:

**Summary**
We are seeking a highly skilled Cloud and Virtualization Networking Engineer to design, implement, and manage networking solutions across on-premises, hybrid, and public cloud environments. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in Proxmox, VMware NSX-T, F5 Load Balancers, Layer 2 & Layer 3 VPN (L2L), BGP Routing, Virtual Cloud Director (vCD), vSphere, and various VMware products Knowledge is required, and experience with, AWS and Azure cloud networking is strongly preferred.
  
  
****ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES (Additional duties may be assigned as required)****

* Design, deploy, and manage VMware NSX-T network virtualization solutions, including micro-segmentation, distributed firewall, and network automation.
* Design and implement networking solutions in AWS, and Azure, including Compartments, VPCs, subnets, security groups, route tables, VPNs, Direct Connect/ExpressRoute/FastConnect, load balancing, Transit Gateway/Virtual WAN/DRG, PrivateLink/Private Endpoints, and cloud-native DNS.
* Conduct VMWare NSX V to T migrations. Architect and maintain hybrid cloud connectivity solutions between on-premises VMware environments and public cloud providers (OCI, AWS, Azure).
* Configure and optimize F5 Load Balancers (LTM, GTM, APM, ASM) to ensure high availability, redundancy, and security.
* Implement and manage Layer 2 & Layer 3 VPN (L2L) solutions for secure connectivity between data centers and cloud environments.
* Configure and maintain BGP routing for dynamic network communication and optimized traffic flows across multi-site deployments.
* Manage and optimize VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF), VMware vCloud Director (vCD), for multi-tenant cloud environments, including resource provisioning and networking.
* Administer VMware vSphere, ensuring optimal performance, scalability, and security for virtualized workloads.
* Work with various VMware products (vRealize, vSAN, Horizon, etc.) to enhance and integrate virtualization solutions.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex networking and virtualization issues across hybrid cloud and on-prem environments.
* Collaborate with security teams to enforce compliance policies and improve network security posture.
* Work with DevOps and automation teams to integrate infrastructure as code (IaC) for networking configurations.
* Document network architectures, configurations, and operational procedures.
* Provide Level 2/3 support for networking incidents, escalations, and performance tuning.
* Configure and manage cloud-native network security services including WAF, DDoS protection (AWS Shield, Azure DDoS Protection), PrivateLink/Private Endpoints, and Network Security Groups across cloud environments.

**Required Skills**

* 12+ years of experience in network engineering with a focus on VMware NSX networking and VMWare virtualization suite (VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF), vCloud Director, vSphere, etc) and Proxmox.
* Hands-on expertise with VMware NSX-T, including micro-segmentation, edge nodes, and service-defined firewalling.
* Strong experience with F5 BIG-IP (LTM, GTM, APM, ASM) for traffic management and security.
* In-depth knowledge of BGP routing, VPN (L2L), and network segmentation strategies.
* Expertise in AWS, and Azure networking, including VPCs, virtual networking, cloud security, and hybrid connectivity.

**Nice To Have**

* Experience with Software-defined wide area network (SD-WAN) technologies.
* Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform, CloudFormation, or ARM Templates.
* Familiarity with Zero Trust Security models in network architecture.
* Understanding of containerized networking (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Familiarity with Change Management.
* Exposure in multi-cloud networking solutions across AWS, and Azure. Transit Gateways, Virtual WAN, VCN peering, PrivateLink/Private Endpoints, and cloud DNS services (Route 53, Azure DNS), cloud-native WAF, DDoS and CDN integration (CloudFront, Azure Front Door, OCI CDN).
* Experience with Network Observability and Monitoring tools (Datadog, Grafana, ELK Stack).
* Basic scripting knowledge in Python, Bash, or PowerShell for automation.
* Understanding Disaster Recovery (DR) and Business Continuity Planning (BCP) strategies for networking.
* Strong troubleshooting skills and ability to work in high-availability environments.
* Excellent documentation and communication skills.
* Experience with firewall platforms like Palo Alto, Fortinet, or Check Point.

**PREFERRED CERTIFICATIONS (Not Mandatory)**

* VMware Certified Advanced Professional (VCAP) – NSX-T
* VMware Certified Professional (VCP-DCV, VCP-NV, VCP-Cloud)
* F5 Certified Technology Specialist (F5-CTS LTM/GTM/APM)
* AWS Certified Advanced Networking – Specialty
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Network Engineer Associate

****WHY ARMOR****
Join Armor if you want to be part of a company that is redefining cybersecurity. Here, you will have the opportunity to shape the future, disrupt the status quo, and be a part of a team that celebrates energy, passion, and fresh thinking. We are not looking for someone who simply fills a role – we want talent who will help us write the next chapter of our growth story.

* Commitment to Growth: A growth mindset that encourages continuous learning and improvement with adaptability in the face of challenges.

* Empathy In Action: Active understanding, compassion and support to the needs of others through genuine connection.

description:
**Technical Support & Design Engineer**

**Domain:**
CCTV | Fire Alarm | Public Address Systems

**Location:**
Pune

Technical / Projects / Pre-Sales

CTC : 2.4 Lpa - 3.4 Lpa

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a
**Technical Support & Design Engineer**
to support the design, estimation, configuration, commissioning, and troubleshooting of
**CCTV, Fire Alarm and Public Address systems**
.

The role will involve a combination of
**office-based system designing and technical support**
, along with occasional site visits for commissioning, troubleshooting, demonstrations, and customer support.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Prepare system designs for
  **CCTV, Fire Alarm and Public Address systems**
  based on customer requirements, drawings, BOQ and tender specifications.
* Prepare
  **BOQ, technical compliance sheets, datasheets, system architecture and solution proposals**
  .
* Perform CCTV camera selection, coverage planning, storage calculations, bandwidth calculations and server/NVR/VMS sizing.
* Support configuration and commissioning of
  **IP cameras, NVRs, VMS platforms and network-based surveillance systems**
  .
* Design Fire Alarm systems including detector selection, loop calculation, panel selection, modules, interfaces and system architecture.
* Support programming, testing, commissioning and troubleshooting of Fire Alarm panels.
* Design Public Address systems including speaker selection, amplifier sizing, zone planning and basic load calculations.
* Provide technical support to customers, system integrators, consultants and internal sales teams.
* Assist the sales team in selecting technically suitable products and preparing solutions.
* Review tender specifications and prepare
  **technical compliance/deviation statements**
  .
* Prepare drawings, schematics, system block diagrams and technical documentation.
* Conduct product demonstrations, FAT/SAT and customer training when required.
* Coordinate with OEM technical teams for complex technical issues.
* Troubleshoot hardware, software, networking and integration-related issues.
* Maintain project documentation, configuration files and technical reports.
* Provide remote as well as onsite technical support.
* Travel to customer/project sites when required.

**Technical Knowledge Preferred**

**CCTV & VMS**

* IP Cameras, NVR/DVR, VMS
* Camera lens and coverage selection
* Storage and bandwidth calculation
* Networking fundamentals – IP addressing, VLAN, PoE, switches
* Video analytics and basic system integration
* ONVIF, RTSP and related CCTV protocols

**Fire Alarm**

* Addressable Fire Alarm Systems
* Detectors, MCPs, sounders, modules and interfaces
* Loop architecture and system configuration
* Cause & Effect programming
* Basic understanding of applicable fire alarm standards

**Public Address**

* 100V Line PA Systems
* Speakers and amplifier sizing
* Zone-based PA architecture
* Emergency/Public Address fundamentals
* Basic audio system troubleshooting

**Qualification**

* Diploma / BE / B.Tech in
  **Electronics, Electrical, Instrumentation, E&TC or related engineering field**
* Freshers or candidates with
  **0–2 years of relevant experience**
  can apply.
* Candidates with hands-on exposure to ELV / Security / Fire systems will be preferred.

**Skills Required**

* Strong technical and troubleshooting ability
* Basic knowledge of networking
* Ability to read technical drawings and specifications
* Good communication and customer-handling skills
* Working knowledge of
  **MS Excel, Word and PowerPoint**
* AutoCAD knowledge will be an advantage
* Willingness to learn multiple technologies
* Willingness to travel for projects and technical support

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

We are looking for someone who is technically curious and interested in developing expertise across
**CCTV, Fire Alarm and PA systems**
, rather than working on only one product category.

The candidate should be comfortable working across
**design, pre-sales support, configuration, commissioning and troubleshooting**
and should have the ability to learn new technologies and OEM platforms quickly.

title: Major Incident Management Lead - Pune/BangaloreVOIS

**About This Role**
We are seeking an experienced Major Incident Management Lead to coordinate and drive the resolution of high-impact incidents across live operational services within a fast-paced telecommunications environment. **What's In It For You**

* Opportunity to lead critical, customer-impacting incident response activities across global operational services
* Exposure to senior leadership, customers, suppliers, and cross-functional technical teams
* Experience working within a 24x7 operational environment supporting business-critical telecommunications services
* Involvement in business continuity, disaster recovery, crisis management, and service resilience initiatives
* Opportunities to contribute to operational transformation, process improvement, and service excellence programmes

title: Manager - Network Security
description:
**About Cognizant Corporate**
Cognizant Corporate is a global community united by a shared purpose: to make a meaningful impact. We are committed to excellence and driven by outcomes that matter. Collaboration is at the heart of how we work, and our forward-thinking mindset fuels continuous learning, innovation, and growth.
  
  
At Cognizant, careers transcend titles. We empower our people to think strategically, inspire others, and lead with purpose – always guided by our core values. Join us in shaping future of business.
  
  
**About The Role**
The
**Manager, Network Security Engineering and Operations**
will provide technical and operational leadership for enterprise network security services across traditional firewall, remote-access, identity-based access, and cloud-delivered Zero Trust technologies.
**12 to 16 years**
of experience in enterprise networking or network security, including substantial experience in technical leadership or service management.
  
  
Demonstrated experience managing Network Security engineering or operations teams in a large, distributed enterprise
  
  
**Role**
The role will be accountable for service strategy, architecture governance, engineering delivery, operational stability, security compliance, major-incident leadership, and team capability across:
  
  

* Enterprise firewalls, preferably Cisco ASA/FTD and Palo Alto Networks
* Remote Access VPN using Cisco Secure Client/AnyConnect
* Site-to-site IPSec VPN
* Cisco Identity Services Engine
* Zscaler Internet Access
* Zscaler Private Access
* Zero Trust Network Access and Secure Access Service Edge

**In This Role, You Will**
1. Service Ownership and Leadership
  
  

* Own the end-to-end lifecycle of enterprise Network Security services, including strategy, architecture, engineering, transition, operations and optimisation
* Establish clear service ownership, operating procedures, escalation paths and accountability across internal technology teams.
* Define annual service roadmaps covering platform upgrades, security improvements, automation, technology refresh, resilience and legacy retirement.
* Manage service performance, capacity, availability, risks, dependencies, technical debt and operational readiness.
* Act as the management escalation point for significant service, delivery, stakeholder and vendor issues.
* Balance operational stability with security transformation and business delivery priorities.
* Architecture and Design Governance
* Provide design authority for network security solutions across corporate environments, data centres, remote users, cloud platforms, business units, merged entities and isolated environments.
* Review and approve high-level and low-level designs, security patterns, traffic-flow diagrams, migration approaches, implementation plans and operational acceptance criteria.
* Govern technical standards for firewalls, RAVPN, IPSec tunnels, Cisco ISE, ZIA, ZPA, App Connectors, traffic forwarding and endpoint posture.
* Ensure architecture decisions align with Zero Trust, least privilege, segmentation and defence-in-depth principles.
* Technology and Engineering Leadership

Maintain Sufficient Technical Depth To Guide Engineering Teams, Challenge Vendor Recommendations, Approve Designs And Support Critical Escalations Across The Following Domains
  
  
**Firewalls**

* Cisco ASA/FTD, Firewall Management Center, Palo Alto Networks and Panorama
* Security policies, ACLs, NAT, segmentation, routing and high availability
* IPS/IDS, URL filtering, SSL inspection and threat prevention
* Rule optimisation, recertification and removal of obsolete policies
* Platform lifecycle, patching and vulnerability remediation

**Remote Access and IPSec VPN**

* Cisco Secure Client/AnyConnect architecture
* SSL VPN, IKEv1/IKEv2 and site-to-site IPSec VPN
* Authentication, authorization, SAML, RADIUS and certificates
* Tunnel profiles, split tunnelling, routing, NAT and resiliency
* Migration from conventional VPN access to application-based Zero Trust access

**Cisco ISE**

* Authentication and authorization policies
* RADIUS, TACACS+, 802.1X, profiling and posture
* Certificate and identity integrations
* VPN posture, device compliance and access enforcement
* Node health, upgrades, high availability and disaster recovery

**Zscaler ZIA and ZPA**

* ZIA traffic forwarding through ZCC, GRE, IPSec, Cloud Connectors and service edges
* URL filtering, SSL inspection, DNS security, cloud firewall, threat prevention and DLP integration
* ZPA App Connectors, application segments, access policies, Browser Access, posture and identity integration
* Managed, unmanaged and isolated-device access patterns
* App Connector placement, capacity, application discovery and segmentation
* ZIA/ZPA policy governance, administrative access and logging
* Operations, Delivery and Problem Management
* Ensure effective L3/L4 support for firewall, RAVPN, IPSec, ISE, ZIA and ZPA services.
* Lead or oversee P1/P2 incidents, technical war rooms and executive escalations.
* Coordinate troubleshooting across network, security, endpoint, identity, cloud, application, vendor and service-management teams.
* Ensure Network Security platforms comply with corporate security baselines, internal standards and applicable control frameworks.
* Partner with Corporate Security and Audit teams to provide evidence for firewall governance, endpoint posture, identity enforcement, vulnerability remediation and access controls.
* Support NIST, ISO, internal audit and regulatory evidence requirements as applicable.
* Lead security transformation programmes involving RAVPN-to-ZPA migration, firewall optimisation, application segmentation and cloud-security adoption.
* Lead, coach and develop a team of Network Security engineers and technical leads.
* Build effective relationships with Corporate Security, Architecture, IAM, Endpoint, Cloud, Network Operations, Service Management and business stakeholders.
* Translate technical issues and risks into clear business impact, decisions and investment requirements.
* Manage engineering and escalation relationships with Cisco, Palo Alto Networks, Zscaler and implementation partners.
* Review vendor proposals, statements of work, architecture recommendations and product roadmaps.
* Hold vendors accountable for defect resolution, root-cause findings, security fixes, platform reliability and delivery commitments.
* Coordinate complex incidents and interoperability issues involving multiple providers.
* Ensure all material decisions, responsibilities and dependencies are captured through documented RACI and governance structures.

**These will help you succeed**
**Preferred Certifications**

* CCNP Security or equivalent Cisco security certification
* Palo Alto Networks PCNSE
* Zscaler ZIA/ZPA Administrator or Zscaler Digital Transformation certification
* ITIL Foundation or advanced IT service-management certification
* Relevant cloud certification in Azure, AWS or GCP

**Work model –**
We believe hybrid work is the way forward as we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring 2-3 days a week in a client or Cognizant office in Pune, Maharashtra. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance though our various wellbeing programs.

title: Linux Administrator
description:
**Job Title: Linux Administrator (AWS Cloud Migration)**

**Location: Viman Nagar, Pune (Hybrid)**

**Shift Time: 2PM-11PM IST / 3PM-12AM IST**

**Key responsibilities**

**Discovery and planning**

* Inventory on-prem Linux servers (RHEL), applications, dependencies, storage and network flows using tools such as AWS Application Discovery Service or Migration Evaluator.
* Classify workloads by migration strategy (rehost, replatform, refactor, retire) and group them into migration waves.
* Define target-state designs: instance sizing, OS versions, EBS/EFS/FSx storage, VPC placement and security groups.

**Migration execution**

* Migrate servers with AWS Application Migration Service (MGN), plus rsync, LVM snapshots or image-based methods where needed.
* Move file shares and data using AWS DataSync, Snowball or S3 transfer as appropriate.
* Upgrade or re-platform legacy OS versions (e.g., RHEL ) during migration.
* Plan and run cutovers, including DNS changes, rollback plans and post-migration validation with application owners.

**AWS Linux operations**

* Build, patch and maintain Linux on EC2 using AMIs, Systems Manager (Patch Manager, Session Manager, Run Command) and Auto Scaling.
* Manage users, sudo, SSH keys and directory integration (Active Directory / SSSD / AWS Managed Microsoft AD).
* Monitor health and performance with CloudWatch metrics, logs and alarms; tune kernel, memory, disk I/O and network settings.
* Set up backup and DR with AWS Backup, EBS snapshots and cross-region copies; test restores.

**Automation and infrastructure as code**

* Provision infrastructure with Terraform or CloudFormation.
* Automate configuration and builds with Ansible, Bash and Python; build golden AMIs with EC2 Image Builder or Packer.
* Contribute to CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins or CodePipeline) for infrastructure changes.

**Security and compliance**

* Apply CIS benchmarks and OS hardening; manage IAM roles and instance profiles on least privilege.
* Encrypt data at rest and in transit (KMS, TLS); manage secrets with Secrets Manager or Parameter Store.
* Support audits with evidence from CloudTrail, AWS Config, Security Hub and Inspector.

**Hypercare and handover**

* Provide post-cutover support, resolve incidents and drive root-cause analysis.
* Write runbooks, architecture diagrams and SOPs; hand over to steady-state operations teams.
* Track cost and right-size instances using Cost Explorer and Compute Optimizer.

**Required qualifications**

* 6+ years administering enterprise Linux (RHEL/CentOS, Ubuntu, Amazon Linux) in production.
* 2+ years hands-on with AWS: EC2, VPC, EBS, EFS, S3, IAM, Route 53, ELB, CloudWatch and Systems Manager.
* Completed at least one on-prem to AWS migration, including server rehost with AWS MGN or an equivalent tool.
* Strong troubleshooting across boot, kernel, filesystems (LVM, XFS, ext4), networking (TCP/IP, DNS, firewalld/iptables) and performance.
* Scripting in Bash and Python; configuration management with Ansible.
* Infrastructure as code with Terraform or CloudFormation.
* Working knowledge of VMware or other on-prem virtualization as a migration source.
* Experience with Git-based workflows and change management (ITIL, ServiceNow or Jira).

**Preferred qualifications**

* AWS Certified SysOps Administrator – Associate or Solutions Architect – Associate (Professional level a plus).
* Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA) or Engineer (RHCE).
* Familiarity with the AWS Migration Acceleration Program (MAP) and the Well-Architected Framework.
* Exposure to containers (Docker, Amazon ECS or EKS) and serverless services.
* Experience migrating databases or middleware hosted on Linux (Oracle, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Tomcat, JBoss, Apache, NGINX).
* Hybrid connectivity: Site-to-Site VPN, Direct Connect, Transit Gateway.
* Background in regulated environments (financial services, SOX, PCI DSS).
* Deliver runbooks and a clean handover to operations.

  **pyranometers (GHI, POI), albedometers, anemometers, back-of-module temperature sensors**
  , and soiling stations.
* Integrate WMS data loggers into the main SCADA network to ensure real-time, accurate environmental data is available for
  **Performance Ratio (PR)**
  calculations.

**Site Management & Troubleshooting**

* Diagnose and resolve complex networking, wiring, and communication faults during the commissioning phase.
* Coordinate with electrical subcontractors to ensure panel wiring and field instrumentation comply with engineering Single Line Diagrams (SLDs) and schematics.
* Enforce strict adherence to site safety guidelines (OSHA, NFPA 70E) and electrical safety practices.

**Documentation & Handover**

* Redline engineering drawings to create accurate
  **As-Built documentation**
  .
* Compile detailed commissioning reports, loop sheets, and calibration logs for handover to the Operations & Maintenance (O&M) team.
* Provide basic system orientation and training to site operators upon successful plant energization.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

**Education:**
Bachelor’s degree or Diploma in Electrical Engineering, Instrumentation & Control, Electronics & Communication, or a related field.

**Experience:**
3+ years of field experience in commissioning
**SCADA systems and/or Weather Monitoring Systems**
preferabbly within utility-scale solar PV plants.

**Technical Knowledge:**

* Hands-on experience with industrial protocols (Modbus RTU/TCP is a must).
* Familiarity with meteorological sensor brands.
* Understanding of industrial networking, fiber optic splicing concepts, and IP routing.
* Ability to read and interpret Electrical Schematics, Single Line Diagrams, and P&ID diagrams.

title: Sr. Infrastructure Engineer – Data Platforms (Python + Cloud)
description:
**Company Overview**
We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.
  
  
**Overview**
Are you a cloud automation engineer who thrives in a fast-paced, multi-platform environment? As a Senior Infrastructure Engineer on our Digital & Technology team, you will lead the design and deployment of infrastructure automation for enterprise-scale platforms. * Lead infrastructure automation and cloud deployment initiatives.
* Build Python automation for provisioning, configuration, validation, and operations.
* Develop reusable Terraform modules and infrastructure-as-code patterns.
* Deploy compute, networking, storage, security, and platform services.
* Build CI/CD workflows for Python and Terraform using GitHub Actions or equivalent tools.
* Implement secure, idempotent, and version-controlled infrastructure deployments.
* Apply identity, secrets, tagging, governance, and cloud security controls.
* Add testing, drift detection, monitoring, and compliance checks for infrastructure code.
* Support cloud adoption and modernization on GCP or other public clouds.
* Create self-service workflows and documentation for safe cloud infrastructure consumption.
* Troubleshoot deployment failures and production issues in a 24/7 environment.
* Collaborate with platform, application, security, and operations teams within Agile.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Experience: 9+ years designing, automating, and deploying infrastructure in enterprise or cloud environments.
* Core Technical Skills: Strong Python; Terraform; infrastructure as code; and cloud engineering focused on infrastructure deployment.
* Cloud Engineering: Experience deploying cloud compute, networking, storage, security, and platform services.
* Automation Engineering: Experience building reusable, secure, idempotent, testable, version-controlled automation.
* CI/CD and DevOps: Hands-on experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, GitHub Actions or equivalent tools, and DevOps practices.
* Cloud Governance: Experience with cloud security, IAM, governance, policy, tagging, and compliance controls.
* Operating Systems: Strong Linux experience; Windows Server is beneficial.
* Engineering Practices: Working knowledge of Agile delivery, code reviews, testing, documentation, monitoring, and POCs.
* Soft Skills: Excellent communication and collaboration skills; flexible, reliable, self-starting, and able to influence across teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Cloud Platform: GCP, AWS, Azure, or other public cloud experience; GCP preferred.
* Automation Tooling: Ansible, GitHub Actions, Artifactory, Python testing frameworks, or similar tools.
* Infrastructure Delivery: Self-service provisioning, CI/CD, and reusable platform patterns.
* AI and Agent Development: Exposure to AI concepts and developing AI agents or agentic workflows for infrastructure operations and automation.

**ELIGIBILITY**
Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

title: System Administrator
description:

**Job Description**
Manage, secure, and optimize the organization's on-premises and cloud server infrastructure, including Nutanix AHV, Windows and Linux servers, Active Directory, Veeam backup, infrastructure monitoring, and Microsoft Azure. title: Technology Consulting Manager - Manufacturing OT
description:
**ZS**
is a place where passion changes lives. As a management consulting and technology firm focused on improving life and how we live it, we transform ideas into impact by
**bringing together data, science, technology**
and
**human ingenuity**
to deliver better outcomes for all. Here you’ll work side-by-side with a powerful collective of thinkers and experts shaping life-changing solutions for patients, caregivers and consumers, worldwide. ZSers drive impact by bringing a
**client-first mentality**
to each and every engagement. We partner collaboratively with our clients to develop custom solutions and technology products that create value and deliver company results across critical areas of their business. Bring your curiosity for learning, bold ideas, courage and passion to drive life-changing impact to ZS.
  
  
**About ZS Manufacturing Team**
At ZS, our Manufacturing, Engineering and Quality practice helps global organizations transform how they design, operate and optimize their manufacturing environments. We work at the intersection of business strategy and technology, combining AI, Agentic systems, advanced analytics, and digital twin technology to drive manufacturing efficiency, engineering precision, and quality compliance at scale.
  
  
Our teams work hands-on with clients to connect shop floor data with enterprise decision-making, integrate with legacy systems, and embed intelligent, outcome-driven solutions across manufacturing execution, maintenance, and quality workflows. Whether the challenge is improving yield, ensuring compliance, reducing operational risk, or accelerating the shift to smart manufacturing, we bring deep expertise and purpose-built technology approached to make it real.
  
  
***What You'll Do :
  
  
Engagement & client leadership -***

* Lead multiple technology engagements simultaneously, ensuring successful delivery across the lifecycle — discovery, requirements, solution design, implementation, testing, deployment and ongoing operations.
* Build and manage client relationships across assigned accounts, serving as a trusted advisor and primary point of contact for technology initiatives and strategic discussions.
* Partner with client stakeholders to understand business objectives, identify technology-enabled solutions, and develop roadmaps that support long-term transformation.
* Drive account expansion — identify opportunities, shape proposals, facilitate client discussions and collaborate with internal teams on solutions.
* Coordinate cross-functional, geographically distributed teams across India and the US, ensuring collaboration, delivery excellence and alignment across workstreams.

***Subject matter (OT & industrial data) -***

* Act as the OT subject-matter expert — shape and drive manufacturing and Industry 4.0 use cases across sites and enterprise programs (process monitoring, predictive maintenance, OEE, yield, energy, asset reliability).
* Apply deep knowledge of plant-floor OT and industrial data: sensors and instrumentation, PLC / DCS / SCADA, historians (e.g. OSIsoft / AVEVA PI), industrial IoT and edge, and manufacturing data platforms.
* Design and govern OT/IT data layers and Unified Namespace (UNS) architectures; define semantic models / ontology and contextualization of time-series and equipment data.
* Apply industrial standards and connectivity — ISA-95, ISA-88, OPC-UA and MQTT / UNS — and translate operational needs into scalable data products and analytics.

***Delivery & technology (SDLC) -***

* Lead end-to-end delivery and the full SDLC, guiding solution architecture, integration patterns, data models and the team’s technical approach while staying hands-on as and when required.
* Own estimation, planning, risk, dependency and delivery governance; ensure quality, non-functional requirements and, for validated systems, GxP / CSV validation (IQ/OQ/PQ, RVM traceability) and data integrity.

***Change Management & Value Delivery -***

* Drive organizational change management, ensuring adoption of new technologies and digital ways of working.
* Build business cases with clear ROI, and deliver measurable improvements in productivity, efficiency, quality, and time-to-market.
* Lead workshops, training, and stakeholder engagement to foster a culture of innovation and data-driven decision-making.

**What You'll Bring :**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business, Life Sciences or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* 10–12 years leading client-facing technology, digital transformation or consulting initiatives within a professional-services or technology-consulting environment in the Manufacturing functional area.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple engagements and workstreams concurrently while balancing client expectations, delivery commitments and business priorities.
* Ability to translate business challenges into practical technology solutions and guide initiatives from strategy through execution.
* Experience leading cross-functional teams in a global, matrixed environment across multiple locations (India and US).
* Strong written, verbal and presentation skills, able to communicate with executive stakeholders; fluency in English.
* Client-first mentality, intense work ethic, collaborative spirit and problem-solving approach.
* Deep OT / industrial data expertise: sensors, PLC/DCS/SCADA, historians (PI), IIoT/edge, Unified Namespace, ontology / semantic models; ISA-95, ISA-88, OPC-UA, MQTT.
* Strong technology background: solution architecture, data engineering, Python / SQL, cloud (Azure / AWS / GCP) and integration.
* Life-sciences / pharma manufacturing domain experience.

**Nice to have :**

* Exposure to Smart Factory, Connected Worker, Digital Twin and Industrial AI initiatives.
* Familiarity with cloud industrial data platforms (e.g. Cognite, Snowflake) and streaming (Kafka); OT cybersecurity and data governance.
* Broad exposure across multiple technology domains — enterprise applications, cloud, analytics, data platforms or digital products.
* Demonstrated success identifying, shaping and expanding opportunities within existing client accounts.

**How you’ll grow:**

* Cross-functional skills development & custom learning pathways
* Milestone training programs aligned to career progression opportunities
* Internal mobility paths that empower growth via s-curves, individual contribution and role expansions

**Perks & Benefits:**
At ZS, your growth matters. We offer a comprehensive total rewards package that supports your health and well‑being, financial future, time away, and professional development. With robust skills‑building programs, multiple career progression paths, internal mobility, and a deeply collaborative culture, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, expand your capabilities, and thrive as part of a global community. For details on total rewards in India, visit ZS India office locations | Where we work | ZS.
  
  
**Hybrid working model:**
We are committed to giving our employees a flexible and connected way of working. A flexible and connected ZS allows us to combine work from home and on-site presence at clients/ZS offices for the majority of our week. The magic of ZS culture and innovation thrives in both planned and spontaneous face-to-face connections.
  
  
**Travel:**
Travel is a requirement at ZS for client facing ZSers; business needs of your project and client are the priority. While some projects may be local, all client-facing ZSers should be prepared to travel as needed. Travel provides opportunities to strengthen client relationships, gain diverse experiences, and enhance professional growth by working in different environments and cultures.
  
  
**Considering applying?**
At ZS, we honor the visible and invisible elements of our identities, personal experiences, and belief systems—the ones that comprise us as individuals, shape who we are, and make us unique. We believe your personal interests, identities, and desire to learn are integral to your success here. We are committed to building a team that reflects a broad variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. Learn more about our inclusion and belonging efforts and the networks ZS supports to assist our ZSers in cultivating community spaces and obtaining the resources they need to thrive.
  
  
If you’re eager to grow, contribute, and bring your unique self to our work, we encourage you to apply.
  
  
ZS is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing equal employment and advancement opportunities without regard to any class protected by applicable law.
  
  
To complete your application:
  
  
Candidates must possess or be able to obtain work authorization for their intended country of employment. An on-line application, including a full set of transcripts (official or unofficial), is required to be considered.
  
  
NO AGENCY CALLS, PLEASE.
  
  
Find Out More At:
  
  
www.zs.com

title: Senior Platform Architect-1
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Senior Platform Architect-1
  
  
**Overview**
Infrastructure Design Services is a team of Technology Architects and Engineers responsible for the analysis and design of the infrastructure framework to fit the application, platform or system needs in-line with MasterCard's operational standards and principles.
  
  
Infrastructure Design Services is engaged from the beginning of the analysis and design phase to work with the application team(s) and other critical teams within Mastercard to ensure that the completed infrastructure and application architecture aligns with MasterCard’s security, scalability and availability standards.
  
  
Infrastructure Design Services' primary deliverable is the TAD (Technical Architecture Document) which details the infrastructure design for the application, platform or system.
  
  
This job requires experience in internet fundamentals related to web servers, application servers, internet security and other internet technologies.
  
  
This job actively performs designing and delivering internet infrastructure solutions that satisfy member, product, service and backbone requirements.
  
  
Have you ever worked with Microsoft Visio to design middleware infrastructure from the ground up?
  
  
Can you interface with the user(s), application team(s), etc., and all other stakeholders in order to determine their (evolving) needs and requirements?
  
  
Can you generate the highest level of system requirements, based on the given requirements and other constraints?
  
  
Can you ensure that this set of high level requirements is consistent, complete, correct, and operationally defined?
  
  
Role
  
  

* Generating requirements, together with other architects, engineers, application team(s) and user(s), to determine that all of the high level requirements have been met.
* Generating products such as TADs, technical documents, logical flows, and models to keep the user(s), architects and the engineers constantly up to date and in agreement on the application, system or platform to be provided as it is evolving.
* Ensuring that all architectural products and products with architectural input are maintained in the most current state and never allowed to become obsolete.
* Resolve internet architectural and operational problems impacting infrastructure and product availability and performance globally.
* Research and evaluate new technology for possible deployment in MasterCard’s internet infrastructure.
* May assume lead and total accountability for ongoing regional projects as assigned; including responsibility for planning; time and cost control; resource utilization and implementation.
* Implement, manage and support internet infrastructure components while leveraging current standards and best practices.
* Perform problem diagnosis; performance tuning; capacity planning and configuration management for MasterCard internet components.
* Assure system stability and future compatibility by monitoring production execution of all relevant systems.

**All About You**

* Thorough knowledge and understanding of network, operating system principles and web middleware.
* Thorough knowledge in one or more core functions related to internet infrastructure design and/or web administration
* Advanced knowledge of load balancers and web application firewalls
* Working knowledge of Database technologies.
* Working knowledge of cloud technologies
* Must be high-energy, proactive, detail-oriented and able to function under pressure in an independent environment.
* Must have a high degree of initiative and self-motivation and demonstrate the ability to drive results.
* Strong communication skills both verbal and written and strong relationship and collaborative skills and organizational skills with the ability to work as a member of matrix based diverse and geographically distributed project team.
* Willingness and ability to learn and take on challenging opportunities is critical.
* Knowledge of Zero Trust Architecture principles and Network Micro-segmentation.
* Experience working with YAML based deployments

**Skills/Abilities**

* Displays leadership and initiative.
* Detailed oriented and customer obsessed.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to multi-task and prioritize efforts.
* Ability to pick up new technologies at a quick pace and learn on-the-go
* Ability to work with team members located in multiple geographies
* Displays excellent collaborative skills with cross-functional teams.
* Provide positive customer service to internal business partners.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Advanced Services Engineer
description:
**Description**
**Shape the Future of Cybersecurity at Forescout**
Every day cyberattacks threaten to disrupt hospitals, power grids, financial systems, and the infrastructure we all depend on. At Forescout, we build defenses that keep civilization running smoothly in an increasingly connected world.
  
  
For more than 25 years, Fortune 100 organizations, government agencies, and large enterprises have trusted Forescout as their foundation to manage cyber risk, ensure compliance, and mitigate threats. From power grids and healthcare systems to financial networks and transportation hubs, Forescout protects the critical infrastructure of our modern world.
  
  
**What Will You Do**
At Forescout, we seek customer driven individuals who thrive on collaboration, embrace innovation, and are passionate about delivering exceptional customer experiences. Working as one team, we anticipate emerging threats and create forward-thinking solutions that shape the future of cybersecurity. Join us and make a meaningful impact through your unique talents and perspective.
  
  
The Advanced Services Engineer (ASE) position at Forescout Technologies offers the opportunity to assist customers with technical issues to ensure optimal performance of our products and solutions within large and complex customer environments. You will need a solid understanding of Forescout products and basic knowledge of the environments in which they are deployed. You will take ownership of assigned projects and support configurations to address and resolve customer issues. Competencies essential to your success in this role include customer service, problem-solving, organization, time management, combined with agility of learning and technical aptitude, and operating Forescout solutions in real-world customer environments. The ASE will troubleshoot the Forescout solutions, provide upgrade and deployment best practices to the base Forescout Solution, as well as integrate the Forescout product with other customer third-party software, such as remote access and SIEM technologies.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Develop a deep understanding of Forescout products and in-depth knowledge of environments in which they are deployed.
* Provide complex product support, in a collaborative team environment, to customers, other Forescout employees, and partners.
* Participate in knowledge transfer with teammates, attend formal team training sessions, brown bags, and formal mentoring.
* Routinely monitor and develop knowledge assets to enable customer self-sufficiency.
* Monitor and manage Support Services cases.
* Achieve a high level of expertise in all areas of the product.
* Capable of completing assigned duties, handling cases, and escalations within guidelines with minimal direction from Support Services Leadership.
* Routinely act independently while researching and developing solutions to customer issues.
* Liaison to Engineering on product issues, including design, features, and defects.
* Acts as a technical point of contact and is repeatedly sought by others to provide specialty knowledge to assist them in their problem-solving.
* Administer and mature a customer enterprise deployment of the Forescout solution.
* Interface with Forescout Support and/or R&D to resolve issues that may impede success.
* Analyse and optimize polices in accordance with customers’ business requirements.
* Manage equipment installation and configuration at all locations, to include lab environments.
* Assist customers with planning and executing Forescout software and hardware upgrades.
* Create customer reports to achieve project alignment and unity of effort.

**What You Will Bring To Forescout**

* Computer Networking Systems Administrator level knowledge of all protocol layers
* Strong knowledge of enterprise networking environments
* Expertise in debugging and root-cause analysis in complex systems and large environments
* Understanding of enterprise computing environments, distributed applications, and strong knowledge and understanding of TCP/IP networks to include ASA, Palo Alto firewalls, Cisco, Juniper, and Brocade switches.
* Experience with the configuration of Forescout products.
* Hands-on experience in both Windows and Linux, Mac OSX platforms, with a solid understanding of networking principles and security best practices
* Computer Networking Systems Administrator level knowledge of all protocol layers
* Strong knowledge of enterprise networking environments
* Industry Certifications such as CASP+, Security+, CEH, CCNA, SANS (GCIA, GCIH, GREM, GPEN) is a plus.
* Advanced Administrator’s level of understanding of Operating Systems (Linux, Windows, Macintosh, and UNIX) is a plus.
* Experience installing, implementing, and debugging network access control security solutions is a plus.
* Desired skills: VMware -vSphere, Microsoft Hyper-V, and PGSQL
* Understanding of programming languages: C, Java, Bash, and Python is a plus
* Minimum 3 years of experience with network hardware configuration.
* 3 years of significant experience with Windows-based operating systems and Unix systems, specifically Linux.
* Expertise in deploying large-scale enterprise deployments/data centers.
* Experience deploying and/or supporting enterprise security software products such as firewalls, IPS, Anti-Virus solutions, application firewalls, high availability solutions, network management systems, and virtual systems.
* Experience implementing complicated software products that involve multiple components.
* Experience in working and troubleshooting in heterogeneous environments.
* Ability to clearly document complicated steps and procedures.
* Working knowledge of shell, Perl, and XML scripting.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, strong customer orientation, good organizational skills, self-driven with the ability to multi-task on various projects, and aptitude to learn new technologies.
* Knowledge/experience utilizing Salesforce.com or similar CRM tools.
* Excellent interpersonal skills and experience working in demanding and challenging environments.
* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent industry experience.
* ForeScout Certified Administrator (FSCA) and/or ForeScout Certified Engineer (FSCE) within the first year of employment.
* A self-motivated individual with a ‘can do’ attitude.

**What Forescout Offers You**
Managing cyber risk, together – We are led by a visionary leadership team who encourages professional growth and development. We promote a diverse and inclusive culture providing for a collaborative and innovative environment where our team can make an impact on worldwide security while working on technology which is at the forefront of the industry. We are also proud of our competitive compensation and benefits offered. If you have a strong work ethic, are visible and lean in, you will be recognised. We are in growth mode and there is a ton of opportunity at Forescout. Apply now to find out more!
  
  
**Our Mission**
To continuously identify, protect, and ensure the compliance of all cyber assets across the modern organisation.
  
  
**Our Vision**
A world where every cyber asset is seen, secure and compliant.
  
  
**Our Core Values**

* One Team – We all work together, and we all win together.
* Cyber Obsessed – We are curious about technology, and we are innovative and passionate about solving big programs.
* Customer Driven – We listen, we learn, and we make it right.
* Relentless – We're smart, determined, and find a way. We figure stuff out.
* Collaborative, without Ego – No one succeeds alone. We strive to be the humble person that people want to work with.

**Thank you for taking the time to learn more about us.
  
  
If this opportunity intrigues you, we would love for you to apply!**

Forescout Technologies is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. We value and embrace diversity, equality, inclusion, and collaboration at the core of our “One Team” philosophy. description:
VP – Enterprise Observability & Security Engineering (Splunk, Datadog)

**Work shift:**
US Eastern hours; approximately 6:30 PM–3:30 AM IST, with flexibility as specified

**Role focus:**
Enterprise monitoring, observability, SIEM, infrastructure engineering, automation and security detection

The opportunity

We are looking for a technically strong enterprise infrastructure leader to engineer and evolve the monitoring, observability and security capabilities that support a complex global technology environment.

This role sits at the intersection of infrastructure engineering, telemetry and performance monitoring, security detection, automation and platform architecture.

You will lead technical initiatives across enterprise monitoring and security technologies, improve the visibility and resilience of infrastructure and applications, evaluate emerging solutions, and help integrate threat detection and prevention into core enterprise platforms.

We are looking for someone who understands how these systems work under the hood—not just someone who manages monitoring tools or coordinates projects.

What you will own

**1. Enterprise monitoring and observability**

* Design, engineer, implement and support enterprise-scale monitoring, telemetry aggregation and performance-management platforms.
* Work with platforms such as Splunk, Google SecOps, Datadog and SCOM, as applicable to the environment.
* Develop effective monitoring, alerting and troubleshooting approaches across Windows, Linux/Unix, networks and enterprise infrastructure.
* Work with protocols and telemetry mechanisms such as SNMP, syslog, ICMP, WMI and Windows performance counters.

**2. Security detection and infrastructure defense**

* Help engineer and implement technologies that strengthen enterprise threat detection, prevention and response.
* Integrate security monitoring and detection practices into infrastructure platforms and business systems.
* Evaluate security technologies against current and emerging infrastructure risks.
* Contribute to the engineering of internet-facing infrastructure and security controls, including data loss prevention, DNS/DHCP and local/global load balancing.

**3. Infrastructure engineering and automation**

* Apply strong Windows, Linux/Unix, networking and TCP/IP knowledge to diagnose complex monitoring and infrastructure issues.
* Develop automation and integration solutions using Python, PowerShell, Shell, Perl, Java or equivalent scripting technologies.
* Improve platform reliability, operational consistency, monitoring coverage and repeatability.
* Assess new technologies and lead implementation of solutions that deliver measurable operational or security benefits.

**4. Technical strategy and delivery**

* Define technical roadmaps, architecture standards and implementation practices for enterprise monitoring and management capabilities.
* Lead concurrent engineering projects, including implementations requiring carefully planned production changes.
* Work closely with infrastructure, networking, security and application teams, senior stakeholders and technology vendors.
* Guide technical staff, mentor engineers and provide recommendations on platform architecture and strategic direction.

What we are looking for

* 8–12 years of relevant enterprise infrastructure, systems engineering, monitoring or security technology experience.
* Strong hands-on knowledge of Windows and Linux/Unix administration.
* Practical experience designing, implementing or engineering enterprise monitoring and observability solutions.
* Experience with SIEM platforms such as Splunk or Google SecOps and monitoring platforms such as Datadog or SCOM.
* Strong understanding of SNMP, syslog, ICMP, WMI, performance counters and infrastructure telemetry.
* Scripting and automation capability using Python, PowerShell, Shell, Perl, Java or comparable technologies.
* Solid networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP.
* Working knowledge of information security principles and infrastructure security technologies.
* Experience contributing to the design or implementation of DLP, DNS/DHCP, load balancing or internet-facing infrastructure.
* Ability to lead technical projects, influence architecture decisions and communicate with senior business and technology stakeholders.
* Willingness to work the specified US Eastern-hours shift.

Additional experience that will strengthen your profile

* SIEM integration, log pipelines, security analytics and detection engineering.
* Large-scale monitoring architecture and cross-platform telemetry.
* Enterprise cloud and modern data-centre infrastructure.
* Infrastructure security design, policy implementation and production change management.
* Experience leading senior individual contributors and complex technical delivery.

Why consider this role?

* Influence enterprise monitoring, observability and security engineering across a global technology environment.
* Work across infrastructure, networks, monitoring and security rather than in a narrowly defined tool-support role.
* Lead strategic engineering initiatives and evaluate technologies with enterprise-wide impact.
* Combine technical problem-solving, architecture and team leadership.

**Interested?**
Apply with details of the monitoring/SIEM platforms you have engineered, the scale of the environments you have supported, your scripting experience and examples of security or infrastructure improvements you have delivered.

title: MCU Networking & Diagnostics Engineer
description:
Role Purpose
  
  
Design, develop, integrate, and validate MCU-based automotive communication and diagnostic software, ensuring robust vehicle-network connectivity, standards-compliant diagnostics, reliable fault handling, and traceable delivery across ECU programs.
  
  
Main Responsibilities
  
  
Core duty description: Design and configure MCU communication stacks and develop diagnostic services for automotive applications.
  
  

* Design and configure MCU communication stacks for CAN, CAN FD, LIN, Ethernet, SOME/IP, and transport protocols based on project architecture.
* Develop and integrate diagnostic services using UDS, DoIP, OBD, DTC management, diagnostic sessions, security access, and routine control.
* Configure AUTOSAR communication and diagnostic modules, including COM, PduR, CanIf, CanTp, Dcm, Dem, NvM interfaces, and Ethernet-related services where applicable.
* Translate customer signal databases, diagnostic specifications, and network descriptions into maintainable software configurations and interface contracts.
* Implement network management, wake-up and sleep handling, communication control, timeout supervision, bus-off recovery, and degraded-mode behavior.
* Perform bench, SIL, HIL, and vehicle-level debugging using traces, bus logs, diagnostic logs, and MCU runtime measurements.
* Ensure bidirectional traceability from networking and diagnostic requirements through design, implementation, configuration, and verification evidence.
* Coordinate with system, BSW, application, validation, cybersecurity, and customer teams to resolve interface issues and deliver production-ready releases.

Key Requirements
  
  

* Strong embedded C development and debugging experience on automotive microcontrollers.
* Hands-on knowledge of CAN, CAN FD, LIN, Ethernet, SOME/IP, DoIP, UDS, ISO-TP, OBD, and vehicle network management concepts.
* Experience with AUTOSAR Classic communication and diagnostic BSW configuration, integration, and issue analysis.
* Ability to interpret DBC, ARXML, ODX, CDD, diagnostic extracts, signal matrices, and customer interface specifications.
* Proficiency with bus analyzers, debuggers, diagnostic testers, oscilloscopes, and log-analysis methods.
* Good understanding of ASPICE engineering practices, functional safety awareness, cybersecurity constraints, and disciplined defect resolution.

Nice to Have
  
  

* Experience with Vector CANoe, CANalyzer, CANape, DaVinci Configurator/Developer, EB tresos, or equivalent automotive tools.
* Exposure to bootloaders, secure diagnostics, OTA or flash programming, Ethernet test tools, scripting, and test automation.

Other Details
  
  
Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Embedded Systems, Automotive Engineering, or a related discipline. Equivalent relevant industry experience may also be considered.
  
  
Expected leadership behaviors include owning networking and diagnostic delivery outcomes, promoting reusable configurations, and coaching engineers in protocol analysis and systematic debugging.
