title: Senior Cloud Operations Specialist
description:
**Company Description**
Assent empowers manufacturers and distributors with the intelligence to build sustainable products, meet global compliance requirements and drive better business outcomes.
  
  
At the center of our offering is the Assent Network, the industry’s most complete Product Intelligence Network, bringing together trusted parts and supplier intelligence, advanced AI and deep regulatory expertise to help organizations identify risk, make informed decisions and stay ahead of evolving requirements.
  
  
Trusted by more than 1,000 customers worldwide, Assent helps organizations stay ahead of evolving regulations across areas including responsible sourcing, human rights due diligence, PFAS reporting, Digital Product Passports, and other emerging requirements. Our platform empowers manufacturers to navigate change with confidence while building stronger supplier relationships and driving measurable business value.
  
  
With more than 1000 team members across India, North America, Malaysia, the European Union, and Kenya, Assent brings together global expertise, diverse perspectives, and a shared commitment to innovation. Our hybrid work model enables teams to collaborate across regions while staying connected to the communities where they live and work. As a certified B Corporation, we meet rigorous standards of social and environmental performance, transparency, and accountability, reflecting our commitment to creating lasting value for our customers, our people, and the planet.
  
  
**People First. Technology Forward.**
Our commitment to People, Culture & Community (PCC) is rooted in building a diverse, inclusive, and high-performing team. We recruit and retain team members with a range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, while fostering a culture of belonging where all Assentees are respected, supported, and empowered to contribute.
  
  
As we continue to embed AI into how we work, we do so thoughtfully, enhancing human potential, supporting better decision-making, and prioritizing appropriate oversight, privacy, and fairness.
  
  
At Assent, we value your privacy and are committed to maintaining transparency in how we handle your personal information. As part of our talent acquisition and management processes, we may use AI technologies to support activities such as resume screening, candidate communication, and talent analytics.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Position Summary**
The Senior Cloud Operations Specialist is a senior technical owner for the stability, security, governance, and resilience of Assent's enterprise AWS environment and SaaS production systems. The role combines hands-on cloud operations with solution architecture, technical leadership, and sound risk-based decision making across a large multi-account AWS estate.
  
  
Working within the SaaS Product Infrastructure group, this individual partners with Engineering, Product, Corporate Security, and IT to design and operate secure, highly available cloud services. The successful candidate works independently at a high level, turns business and technical requirements into practical solutions, and constructively challenges decisions that introduce unnecessary risk, operational burden, or architectural debt.
  
  
This role follows a strict code-first and least-privilege operating model. Infrastructure changes are codified, peer-reviewed, and delivered through approved pipelines. Privileged access is exceptional, time-bound, auditable, and used only when required.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Architecture Technical Leadership and Decision Making**

* Lead the design and delivery of secure, scalable, resilient, and supportable AWS solutions from initial requirements through production operation.
* Translate business, security, compliance, and operational requirements into architecture decisions, implementation plans, and reusable platform patterns.
* Evaluate technical options and make clear, risk-based recommendations that balance security, reliability, maintainability, delivery speed, and cost.
* Question assumptions and respectfully challenge designs or delivery approaches that conflict with enterprise standards, least-privilege principles, reliability objectives, or long-term platform health.
* Participate in architecture and design reviews, document key decisions and tradeoffs, and ensure operational readiness before production adoption.
* Act as a senior technical escalation point, lead complex infrastructure initiatives, and coach team members through design and operational decisions.

**AWS Platform Governance Identity and Privileged Access**

* Own and continuously improve Assent's AWS multi-account environment using AWS Organizations, AWS Control Tower, organizational units, account lifecycle controls, guardrails, and Service Control Policies.
* Architect and operate AWS IAM Identity Center, IAM roles and policies, permission sets, trust relationships, permission boundaries, federation, and cross-account access patterns.
* Apply least privilege by default. Ensure elevated access is approved, time-bound where supported, protected by strong authentication, logged, regularly reviewed, and separated from day-to-day identities.
* Maintain controlled break-glass access and prevent shared credentials, unmanaged access paths, unnecessary standing privilege, and unreviewed administrative changes.
* Lead account provisioning, compliance assessments, access reviews, drift detection, and remediation across the AWS organization.
* Partner with Corporate Security on identity governance, audit readiness, cloud control design, and the implementation of enterprise security requirements.

**Enterprise AWS Networking**

* Design, operate, and troubleshoot enterprise AWS network architectures across accounts and regions, including VPCs, subnets, route tables, security groups, network ACLs, and shared network services.
* Own connectivity and traffic-flow patterns using services such as Transit Gateway, VPC peering, PrivateLink, VPN, Direct Connect, Route 53, Elastic Load Balancing, API Gateway, and CloudFront.
* Design secure ingress, egress, segmentation, DNS, and service-to-service connectivity patterns using AWS Network Firewall, AWS WAF, VPC endpoints, flow logs, and centralized inspection where appropriate.
* Diagnose complex routing, name resolution, load-balancing, firewall, latency, and cross-account connectivity issues and drive permanent corrective action.
* Maintain current network diagrams, traffic-flow documentation, connectivity standards, and recovery procedures.

**Infrastructure as Code Automation and Delivery**

* Provision and govern AWS platform resources through Terraform using reusable modules, secure remote state, controlled workspaces, and maintainable multi-account patterns.
* Use GitHub Actions as the primary delivery mechanism for infrastructure and governance changes, with peer review, validation, security checks, approvals, and traceable deployment records.
* Uphold a no unmanaged changes standard. Use AWS console access only for approved operational needs, and codify or reconcile any necessary emergency change promptly.
* Build automation with Python, PowerShell, Bash, Lambda, Ansible, Semaphore, or similar tools to reduce manual effort, enforce consistency, and improve recovery time.
* Review infrastructure code and automation for security, reliability, maintainability, and alignment with enterprise standards.

**Cloud Operations Reliability and Incident Response**

* Operate and improve core AWS services across compute, containers, databases, storage, messaging, DNS, content delivery, security, and monitoring.
* Install, configure, secure, patch, and troubleshoot Linux and Windows workloads in cloud environments.
* Establish effective monitoring, logging, alerting, dashboards, and automated remediation using CloudWatch, OpenSearch or Elasticsearch, New Relic, PagerDuty, or comparable platforms.
* Lead or support high-severity incident response, communicate clearly under pressure, restore service safely, and coordinate across technical and business teams.
* Conduct root-cause analysis and ensure corrective actions address underlying technical and process failures rather than only immediate symptoms.
* Participate in the on-call rotation and planned off-hours work required to support production infrastructure.

**Security Compliance Resilience and Operational Ownership**

* Maintain enterprise standards for encryption, key management, audit logging, configuration compliance, vulnerability remediation, and evidence collection using services such as KMS, CloudTrail, and AWS Config.
* Support internal and external audits and provide clear evidence of cloud controls, access governance, and operational processes.
* Design, implement, and test backup, business continuity, disaster recovery, and multi-region resilience capabilities.
* Create and maintain accurate documentation for cloud architecture, governance controls, operational procedures, automation workflows, and support handoffs.
* Take end-to-end ownership of assigned platforms and initiatives, surface risks early, and follow decisions through implementation and operational acceptance.

**Qualifications**
**Minimum Requirements**

* 7 or more years of relevant experience in cloud operations, platform engineering, infrastructure engineering, or systems administration, including substantial hands-on responsibility for enterprise AWS environments.
* Proven long-term ownership of a multi-account AWS organization using AWS Organizations, AWS Control Tower, and AWS IAM Identity Center.
* Deep experience with enterprise AWS governance, including organizational design, account provisioning, Service Control Policies, guardrails, configuration compliance, and drift remediation.
* Advanced knowledge of AWS identity and access management, including least privilege, privileged-access controls, federation, cross-account access, permission sets, IAM policies and roles, and emergency access practices.
* Strong AWS networking experience, including multi-account and multi-region network design, routing, DNS, load balancing, private connectivity, segmentation, and network security controls.
* Strong Terraform experience, including reusable modules, multi-account deployment patterns, secure remote state in Amazon S3, code review, testing, and lifecycle management.
* Hands-on experience building and maintaining GitHub Actions pipelines for infrastructure deployment, policy enforcement, and operational automation.
* Demonstrated ability to architect solutions and carry them through implementation, validation, documentation, and production support.
* Sound judgment in ambiguous or high-pressure situations, with the confidence to challenge proposals, explain risk clearly, and make defensible technical decisions.
* Strong scripting and automation skills in Python, PowerShell, or Bash.
* Working knowledge of Linux and Windows administration in production cloud environments.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with technical teams, security stakeholders, leadership, and vendors.
* Ability to work independently as part of a globally distributed team and to participate in on-call and planned off-hours work.
* University degree, college diploma, or equivalent practical experience.

title: Senior Cloud Network Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Locations—India (Remote)
  
  
Senior Cloud Network Infrastructure Engineer
  
  
About Us:
  
  
Platform9: Private Clouds Made Easy
  
  
Platform9 is the leader in simplifying enterprise Private Clouds. Founded by a team of VMware cloud pioneers, we are dedicated to transforming IT operations. Our flagship product, Private Cloud Director, turns your existing hardware into a full-featured, future-ready private cloud. We innovate across what we build and how we deliver it, staying focused on a next-generation, open private cloud while holding ourselves to one standard: exceptional customer outcomes.
  
  
Enterprises are selecting Platform9 to replace legacy virtualization because it eliminates operational risk and complexity. Private Cloud Director is designed for the experienced infrastructure team, offering a familiar GUI experience for managing VMs and containers, seamless integration with your existing hardware and third-party storage, and critical enterprise features (HA/DR, scale, reliability) built-in. This enables IT teams to gain robust API control and a user experience they trust—rooted in customer obsession and an owner’s mindset. We share context quickly and candidly to keep decisions moving.
  
  
With over 30,000 nodes in production at some of the world’s largest enterprises, including Cloudera, EBSCO, Juniper Networks, and Rackspace, Platform9 is the proven path to achieving true vendor independence and operational consistency. We are an inclusive, globally distributed company backed by prominent investors, supported by a partner ecosystem of resellers, systems integrators, MSPs, and technology vendors committed to driving private cloud innovation and efficiency. Our values—innovation, customer obsession, ownership, radical candor, and excellence—guide how we build and support every deployment.
  
  
Position Summary:
  
  
We are seeking an experienced Cloud Network Infrastructure Engineer to join our cloud engineering team. The ideal candidate will design, deploy, operationalize, and maintain high-performance Software-Defined Network (SDN) architectures, bridging deep data center networking expertise with modern cloud-native telemetry, microservices, OpenStack environments, and Kubernetes-native application development. You will manage virtual switching platforms, overlay networking, and L2/L3 dynamic routing to ensure seamless connectivity and robust security across our private cloud infrastructure.
  
  
Roles and Responsibilities:
  
  

* SDN & Virtual Switching: Architect, maintain, and optimize Open Virtual Switch (OVS) and Open Virtual Network (OVN) dataplanes. Manage OpenFlow pipelines and SDN controllers for automated flow control
* Cloud Infrastructure & Kubernetes: Deploy and operationalize OpenStack networking services (Neutron, Metadata Service) using OpenStack Ansible. Contribute to the development of cloud-native networking products, microservices, and controllers for our Kubernetes product ecosystem
* Overlay & Underlay Networking: Design, optimize, and troubleshoot overlay tunnels (VxLAN, GENEVE) and virtual networks (VLAN 802.1Q) running over high-throughput physical fabrics (L3 CLOS, LACP, MCT/vLAG)
* L2/L3 Routing & Switching: Implement and manage dynamic routing protocols (BGP, EVPN, OSPF) for WAN/DC interconnects, ECMP load balancing, and VRRP gateway redundancy
* Network Security: Secure network traffic across untrusted boundaries using IPsec VPNs (IKEv2, ESP). Configure stateful firewalls, connection tracking (Conntrack), and NAT rules using IPTables/Netfilter and NFTables
* Automation, Telemetry & Lifecycle Management: Build, test, and validate network topologies locally using Vagrant and hypervisors (KVM/QEMU) prior to production rollouts. Develop resources to handle platform upgrades, real-time streaming telemetry architectures (gRPC, ProtoBuf, Kafka), and network lifecycle management

Technical Requirements & Skill Stack:
  
  

* Cloud & Virtualization Platforms: OpenStack (Neutron, Nova, Metadata Service), OpenStack Ansible, KVM/QEMU, DevStack
* Software-Defined Networking (SDN): Open vSwitch (OVS), Open Virtual Network (OVN), OpenFlow, SDN Controllers
* Overlay & Encapsulation: VxLAN, GENEVE, VLAN (802.1Q)
* L2/L3 Protocols & Data Center: BGP, EVPN, OSPF, ECMP, VRRP, IPv4/IPv6, ARP/NDP, Ethernet (802.3), STP/RSTP, L3 CLOS, LACP, MCT/vLAG
* Cloud-Native & Telemetry: Kubernetes, Docker, Kubernetes Controllers, Operator SDK, CRDs, gRPC, Protocol Buffers, Kafka, Numaflow
* Security & Packet Inspection: IPsec (IKEv2, ESP), IPTables/Netfilter, NFTables, Conntrack
* DevOps, Automation & Languages: Golang (Go), Python, C, Vagrant, Ansible, Linux CLI, Bash, CI/CD (Jenkins, Git), OpenAPI / REST APIs

Preferred Qualifications:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field with 8–15 years of software development and infrastructure experience across cloud engineering, telecommunications, or large-scale data center environments
* Deep expertise in Linux networking concepts, packet path traversal, and kernel-level networking subsystems
* Proven track record with production OpenStack deployments using OVN/OVS as the default networking backend
* Strong proficiency in Golang, Python, or C with hands-on experience in white-box switch network management applications
* Self-starter with strong problem-solving skills, analytical thinking, and excellent written/verbal communication in dynamic environments

To succeed in this role, you will need to be a team player with a strong sense of ownership for your work and a passion for working in a data-driven organization.
  
  
Benefits and Perks:
  
  
Employees today are looking for companies that truly care and recognise their whole person. Platform9's benefits and perks have been carefully designed to ensure that we take care of an employee's emotions and physical well-being. Many of our benefits extend to families, who form a significant part of our well-being at work
  
  
Please note that benefits change by country.

title: Manager - Network & Cyber Security
description:
**Job Summary**
Lead Medline's Network security & Cyber Security functions by driving security strategy, network security operations, threat and vulnerability management, incident response, and cloud security across hybrid and multi-cloud environments. Partner with cross-functional teams to deliver resilient, compliant, and scalable security solutions aligned with business objectives.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Manager - Network & Cyber Security**
**Role Overview**
Lead Medline's Network security & Cyber Security functions by driving security strategy, network security operations, threat and vulnerability management, incident response, and cloud security across hybrid and multi-cloud environments. Partner with cross-functional teams to deliver resilient, compliant, and scalable security solutions aligned with business objectives.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead, mentor, and develop the Network & Cyber Security team by setting performance goals, providing coaching, and fostering a culture of accountability, continuous learning, and operational excellence.
* Define and execute the enterprise network and cybersecurity strategy, roadmap, and service improvement initiatives aligned with business objectives and evolving security threats.
* Manage day-to-day security operations, including threat detection and monitoring, incident response, vulnerability management, security assessments, risk remediation, and major security incident escalations.
* Design, implement, and support secure network and cloud architectures across on-premises, hybrid, and multi-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, and GCP), including firewalls, Secure Web Gateways (SWG/SSE), VPN, DDoS protection, network segmentation, and cloud-native security controls.
* Develop, implement, and maintain enterprise security policies, standards, procedures, and technical baselines while ensuring compliance with regulatory and industry frameworks such as HIPAA, HITRUST, NIST, and other applicable standards.
* Lead security governance activities, including internal and external audits, third-party security assessments, software security reviews, certification support, and validation of security controls.
* Establish and monitor security KPIs, SLAs, operational metrics, and cybersecurity reporting to measure performance, drive continuous improvement, and communicate security posture and risks to executive leadership and key stakeholders.
* Partner with Infrastructure, Cloud, Application, Audit, Compliance, and business teams to integrate security into technology initiatives, ensure secure solution design, and deliver resilient, scalable security capabilities.
* Drive security awareness and education initiatives, including phishing simulations and organization-wide cybersecurity training, to strengthen the overall security culture.
* Evaluate emerging cybersecurity threats, technologies, and industry trends to continuously enhance the organization's security capabilities while ensuring cost-effective delivery of security services.

**Skills & Knowledge Requirements**
**Experience & Leadership**

* 12+ years of experience in Network Security, Cyber Security, or Information Security, including 3+ years in a leadership or management role, leading security engineering, SOC, and operations teams.
* Strong leadership, stakeholder management, communication, crisis management, project management, and decision-making skills, with experience driving team development, training, and cross-functional collaboration.
* Deep expertise in enterprise network and cybersecurity architecture, including TCP/IP, traffic analysis, next-generation firewalls, VPNs, Secure Web Gateways (SWG/SSE), SASE, Zero Trust, and secure remote access technologies.
* Hands-on experience with leading security technologies such as Palo Alto Networks, Zscaler (ZIA/ZPA), Check Point, Cisco Security, Cloudflare, Illumio, CrowdStrike, ExtraHop (or other NDR solutions), Web Application Firewalls (WAF), Email Security Gateways, Data Loss Prevention (DLP), Identity & Access Management (IAM), Privileged Access Management (PAM/PIM), and related security platforms.
* Strong experience securing on-premises, hybrid, and multi-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, and GCP), including cloud-native security capabilities for IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS.
* Proven expertise in security operations, including threat detection and hunting, incident response, vulnerability management, log analysis, event correlation, third-party risk management, and defining remediation strategies.
* Extensive knowledge of security governance, risk management, and compliance frameworks, including NIST, HIPAA, HITRUST, ITGC, and industry best practices, with experience supporting audits, risk assessments, and regulatory compliance.
* Experience developing and maintaining enterprise security policies, standards, procedures, technical baselines, and governance frameworks to strengthen organizational security posture.
* Strong understanding of cybersecurity risk, business continuity, security controls, and emerging threat landscapes, with the ability to align security initiatives to business objectives.

**Academic & Professional Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related discipline.
* Preferred professional certifications include CISSP, CISM, and vendor certifications from Palo Alto Networks, Zscaler, Check Point, CyberArk, CrowdStrike Cisco, or equivalent cloud and security technologies.

title: Technical Solutions Engineering Manager, Google Cloud Security
description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.
  
  
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following:
**Bengaluru, Karnataka, India; Pune, Maharashtra, India**
.
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics, or equivalent practical experience.
* 13 years of experience troubleshooting and advocating for customer's needs, and triaging technical issues (e.g., hardware, software, application, operational, process).
* 13 years of experience in managing a technical, customer-facing team through critical escalations.
* 8 years of experience reading code in a general purpose coding language (e.g., Java, C, C++, Python, Shell, Go, JavaScript) or in system design.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, GCIH, GCIA, Security+ or Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer.
* Experience in troubleshooting and supporting large-scale applications such as web services, data storage, databases, data pipelines, high-performance computing, commerce engines, with Linux/Unix or Windows operating systems.
* Ability to analyze data using a structured query language.
* Ability to operate in a customer focused environment and advocate for customers across a cross-functional organization.
* Excellent communication skills to interact with customers, engineers, and management and problem solving skills to resolve technical issues

**About The Job**
The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.
  
  
The modern Security Operations (SecOps), effective Detection and Response relies on a tightly integrated stack like Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) aggregates and correlates vast telemetry, Threat Intelligence enriches that data with high-fidelity adversary context, and Security Orchestration, Automation, and Response (SOAR) automates rapid orchestration and containment.
  
  
As the Detection and Response Technical Solutions Engineer Manager, you will empower engineers to debug issues across this entire pipeline from parser failures and rule latency to Application Programming Interface (API) integration bottlenecks while focusing on driving down escalation resolution times, fostering deep product expertise, and delivering a reliable, high-trust experience for enterprise security customers.Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead a team across Asia-Pacific and India technical solutions engineering pods providing support across all Google SecOps (e.g., Chronicle SIEM, SOAR, and Google Threat Intelligence), through strategic direction, clear expectations, feedback and opportunities for professional growth.
* Partner with Software Engineering and Site Reliability Engineering to manage production incidents in real time, with emphasis on timely and thorough issue identification and customer communication
* Resolve high-profile escalations and issues, improve the customer experience and drive initiatives that increase their likelihood of success
* Work as people manager of engineers to partner with regional counterparts in Americas and EMEA to ensure seamless 24x7 case transitions, uniform SLA adherence, and standardized troubleshooting workflows
* Translate recurring customer and technical patterns into clear, evidence-based feedback for Product and Engineering including reproducible examples, impact assessment, and recommendations for contact rate reduction scalable solutions.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

**What's In It For You**

* The opportunity to work across enterprise storage, backup and cloud technologies
* Exposure to NetApp ONTAP, NetApp Cloud Volumes ONTAP, Amazon FSx, Commvault and Azure or AWS services
* Collaboration with IT, development and operations teams on storage requirements and technical projects
* Experience supporting business-critical storage performance, availability, security and data protection
* Opportunities to broaden your knowledge across hybrid-cloud storage, disaster recovery and operational service delivery

**What Skills You Will Learn**

* Advanced administration and optimisation of NetApp ONTAP and cloud-storage environments
* Operational knowledge of Amazon FSx and NetApp Cloud Volumes ONTAP
* Backup and recovery management using Commvault and Azure or AWS backup services
* Storage performance monitoring, configuration tuning and incident troubleshooting

title: Network Specialist
description:
Job Title
  
  
Network Specialist
  
  
**Job Description**
*Effective April 1, 2026, Toyota Automated Logistics brings together Bastian Solutions, Vanderlande’s Warehousing Business, and Viastore under one unified brand.*
*During this transition phase, parts of our recruitment activities and communication may still be conducted via legacy company systems and email domains.*
**Senior Network Engineer | Pune, India| Full-time**
**Your Role**
We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Senior Network Engineer to join our global IT Operations Center (ITOC). The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, implementing, monitoring, troubleshooting, and optimizing enterprise network infrastructure across global data centers and business locations. This role requires strong expertise in routing, switching, firewalls, VPN technologies, wireless networking, network security, and operational support within a 24x7 environment.
  
  
The successful candidate will play a critical role in ensuring network availability, performance, security, and continuous improvement through automation and proactive infrastructure management.
  
  
**What You Will Do/Key Responsibilities**
**Network Operations & Support**

* Monitor and maintain the health, performance, and availability of global network infrastructure and data center environments.
* Provide advanced L2 and L3 support for network incidents, service requests, and problem management activities.
* Troubleshoot complex network connectivity, performance, and security issues across LAN, WAN, WLAN, and VPN environments.
* Take ownership of critical incidents and ensure timely resolution within defined SLAs.
* Collaborate with global IT teams, business units, and external vendors for issue resolution and service improvements.

**Network Administration & Engineering**

* Configure, deploy, and support

+ Layer 2 & Layer 3 Switches
+ Enterprise Routers
+ Cisco ASA / Firepower Firewalls
+ Wireless LAN Controllers and Access Points
+ VPN Gateways and Remote Access Solutions
+ Load Balancers and QoS Implementations

* Design, implement, and support secure site-to-site and remote-access VPN solutions.
* Perform network infrastructure upgrades, firmware updates, security patching, and lifecycle management activities.
* Execute approved changes following established change management and configuration management processes

**Network Monitoring & Performance Management**

* Utilize enterprise monitoring and diagnostic tools such as

+ Nagios
+ Wireshark
+ PRTG
+ SNMP-based monitoring solutions

* Proactively identify performance bottlenecks and implement corrective actions.
* Analyze network traffic patterns and capacity requirements to improve infrastructure efficiency and reliability.
* Develop and maintain network documentation, topology diagrams, asset inventories, and operational procedures

**Network Security & Compliance**

* Implement and maintain network security controls, firewall rules, VPN configurations, and access policies.
* Monitor network security events and collaborate with cybersecurity teams to mitigate risks.
* Ensure compliance with corporate security standards, best practices, and regulatory requirements.
* Participate in vulnerability remediation and security improvement initiatives.

**Automation & Continuous Improvement**

* Drive automation initiatives to improve operational efficiency and reduce manual effort.
* Develop scripts and automated workflows for network monitoring, reporting, configuration backup, and routine maintenance tasks.
* Identify opportunities for process optimization and service enhancements.
* Contribute to network architecture reviews and infrastructure modernization projects.

**Required Qualifications**
**Education**
Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  
  
**Certifications**

* CCNA and CCNP Certification (Mandatory)
* Additional certifications such as Cisco Security, Fortinet, Palo Alto, or ITIL are highly preferred.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, STP, OSPF, BGP, NAT, ACLs, QoS, and VPN technologies.
* Deep understanding of OSI and TCP/IP networking models.
* Hands-on experience with Cisco routing and switching technologies.
* Expertise in Cisco ASA/Firepower firewall administration and troubleshooting.
* Experience supporting WAN, SD-WAN, MPLS, VPN, and wireless network environments.
* Proficiency with network monitoring, packet analysis, and troubleshooting tools.
* Knowledge of network security frameworks and best practices.
* Experience in automation and scripting using PowerShell, Python, or similar technologies is preferred.

**Required Competencies**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a global, multicultural team environment.
* Strong customer service orientation and stakeholder management capabilities.
* Excellent time management, prioritization, and incident management skills.
* Ability to perform under pressure in a 24x7 operational environment.
* Strong documentation and support case management skills.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience supporting enterprise-scale global networks and data centers.
* Experience working in a Network Operations Center (NOC) or IT Operations Center environment.
* Familiarity with cloud networking concepts (Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud).
* Exposure to network automation and infrastructure-as-code methodologies.
* Experience with ITIL service management processes.

**About TAL**
At Toyota Automated Logistics, you actively shape the future of intelligent intralogistics. As part of Toyota Industries Corporation (TICO), we are a global partner for integrated warehouse automation solutions. Founded in April 2026, we bring together the strengths of Bastian Solutions, viastore, and Vanderlande’s warehousing business under one unified brand.
  
  
Together, we develop scalable automation systems, intelligent software, and end‑to‑end services across the entire lifecycle for customers around the world. Our ambition is clear to set industry benchmarks and actively shape the future of intralogistics.
  
  
**Website**
www.toyota-automated-logistics.com
  
  
**What We Offer**
Working at TAL comes with the support and space to grow, achieve, and enjoy the journey. Here is what that looks like in practice
  
  

* Competitive Salary Package
* 30 days of annual leave (pro-rated from the start of the financial year), including

+ 22 paid leave days
+ 8 sick/casual leave days
+ Applicable government holidays

* Comprehensive medical insurance coverage, including parental coverage
* Opportunities to participate in diverse communities, networks, and employee initiatives
* Opportunity to collaborate globally.
* Flexible and hybrid working model that promotes work-life balance.

**Ready to join Toyota Automated Logistics? We look forward to hearing from you!**
Are you interested in this position? Apply directly via our careers page with your CV/Resume.
  
  
**Diversity & Inclusion**
At Toyota Automated Logistics, we believe diversity makes us stronger. We are committed to equal opportunities and an inclusive work environment, and base our hiring decisions on qualifications, potential, and motivation. Support or adjustments during the application process are available upon request.

title: MCU Networking & Diagnostics Engineer (TT610ST RM 4527)
description:
**Position: MCU Networking & Diagnostics Engineer (TT610ST RM 4527)**
**Automotive MCU / Networking & Diagnostics**
**Role Purpose**
Design, develop, integrate, and validate MCU-based automotive communication and diagnostic software, ensuring robust vehicle-network connectivity, standards-compliant diagnostics, reliable fault handling, and traceable delivery across ECU programs.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and configure MCU communication stacks for CAN, CAN FD, LIN, Ethernet, SOME/IP, and transport protocols based on project architecture.
* Develop and integrate diagnostic services using UDS, DoIP, OBD, DTC management, diagnostic sessions, security access, and routine control.
* Configure AUTOSAR communication and diagnostic modules, including COM, PduR, CanIf, CanTp, Dcm, Dem, NvM interfaces, and Ethernet-related services where applicable.
* Translate customer signal databases, diagnostic specifications, and network descriptions into maintainable software configurations and interface contracts.
* Implement network management, wake-up and sleep handling, communication control, timeout supervision, bus-off recovery, and degraded-mode behavior.
* Perform bench, SIL, HIL, and vehicle-level debugging using traces, bus logs, diagnostic logs, and MCU runtime measurements.
* Ensure bidirectional traceability from networking and diagnostic requirements through design, implementation, configuration, and verification evidence.
* Coordinate with system, BSW, application, validation, cybersecurity, and customer teams to resolve interface issues and deliver production-ready releases

**Required Experience And Competencies**

* Strong embedded C development and debugging experience on automotive microcontrollers.
* Hands-on knowledge of CAN, CAN FD, LIN, Ethernet, SOME/IP, DoIP, UDS, ISO-TP, OBD, and vehicle network management concepts.
* Experience with AUTOSAR Classic communication and diagnostic BSW configuration, integration, and issue analysis.
* Ability to interpret DBC, ARXML, ODX, CDD, diagnostic extracts, signal matrices, and customer interface specifications.
* Proficiency with bus analyzers, debuggers, diagnostic testers, oscilloscopes, and log-analysis methods.
* Good understanding of ASPICE engineering practices, functional safety awareness, cybersecurity constraints, and disciplined defect resolution

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Vector CANoe, CANalyzer, CANape, DaVinci Configurator/Developer, EB tresos, or equivalent automotive tools.
* Exposure to bootloaders, secure diagnostics, OTA or flash programming, Ethernet test tools, scripting, and test automation.

**Education**
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Embedded Systems, Automotive Engineering, or a related discipline. Equivalent relevant industry experience may also be considered.
  
  
**Expected Leadership Behaviors**

* Own networking and diagnostic delivery outcomes with clear interface governance, risk communication, and timely escalation.
* Promote reusable configurations, coding discipline, peer reviews, automation, and evidence-based engineering decisions.
* Coach engineers in protocol analysis, systematic debugging, customer communication, and cross-domain issue resolution

title: Sr Principal Network & Security
description:
**About Northern Trust**
As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
  
  
Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Role Summary
  
  
The Senior Principal Network Security Engineer is the highest-level individual contributor responsible for leading the design, engineering, and delivery of complex, multi-team network security initiatives. This role owns end-to-end technical execution for enterprise perimeter, internal segmentation, and application delivery controls, with deep hands-on expertise in Check Point firewalls and F5 load balancers. The engineer serves as a technical authority, driving architecture decisions, mentoring engineers, and ensuring operational resiliency through automation, rigorous troubleshooting, and incident mitigation.
  
  
Primary Technology Focus
  
  

* Designing, Securing and building scalable, resilient enterprise-wide network
* Define and monitor - network security standards / Controls across on prem, hybrid and Private cloud networks through new generation firewalls / IDS/IPS, Micro segmentation and VPN’s
* Monitor and mitigate the network and security incidents across global events on prem, hybrid and private networks
* Ensure Audit and regulatory compliance requirements are implemented across network segmentations, firewalls, VPN’s and at perimeter security devices
* Check Point Firewalls (policy design, NAT, VPN, threat prevention, logging/telemetry, upgrades and migrations)
* F5 Load Balancers (LTM/ASM/APM as applicable; iRules; TLS profiles; health monitoring; high availability)
* Network routing and switching (BGP/OSPF, VLANs, VRFs, QoS, high-availability designs)
* Wireless networking (enterprise Wi‑Fi architectures, security controls, segmentation, troubleshooting)
* Secure web proxy platforms (forward proxy, TLS inspection, policy enforcement, troubleshooting)
* Enterprise network security initiatives (segmentation, zero trust patterns, control hardening, resiliency improvements)

Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead the engineering delivery of complex network security and application delivery projects involving multiple teams, vendors, and stakeholders.
* Architect, implement, and operate Check Point firewall solutions including policy lifecycle management, NAT strategy, VPN solutions, and threat prevention capabilities.
* Design and engineer F5 load balancing solutions with strong understanding of traffic management, TLS, application health, and high availability.
* Develop and maintain automation for network security operations (e.g., configuration management, policy deployment, compliance validation, telemetry and reporting).
* Act as the senior escalation point for critical incidents—debug, mitigate, and resolve high-severity outages and security events across network/security domains.
* Establish engineering standards and reference architectures for firewalling, load balancing, routing/switching, wireless, and proxy capabilities.
* Drive continuous improvement: reduce toil, improve MTTR, implement reliability patterns, and proactively address technical debt.
* Partner with security engineering, infrastructure, application, and cloud teams to deliver secure-by-design solutions and ensure change safety.
* Conduct deep root-cause analysis (RCA) and produce actionable post-incident improvements, runbooks, and automation enhancements.
* Mentor senior engineers and provide technical leadership through design reviews, architecture boards, and operational readiness assessments.
* Monitor and manage information system security incidents, troubleshoot, investigate and implement countermeasures and mitigate the risk.
* Plan the Network recovery / DR / resilience from malware / attacks, unauthorized access, and policy breaches;
* Engage, interact and coordinate with third-party Network / Telecom/ service providers during security incidents.
* Analyze Network security trends and changes in threat and compliance environment and develop and executes plans for compliance and mitigation of risk

**Required Qualifications**

* Extensive, hands-on engineering experience with enterprise network security, including deep expertise in Check Point firewalls and F5 load balancers.
* Demonstrated success leading complex, cross-functional technical initiatives from design through implementation and operational handoff.
* Advanced knowledge of routing and switching, including dynamic routing (BGP/OSPF), redundancy, and troubleshooting at scale.
* Strong understanding of wireless networking and secure web proxy concepts, including policy enforcement and traffic inspection.
* Proven automation skills (required): scripting and/or infrastructure-as-code to integrate with CI/CD pipelines and ITSM workflows.
* Significant experience troubleshooting and resolving critical incidents, including packet-level analysis and performance triage.
* Ability to produce clear technical documentation: design artifacts, standards, runbooks, and post-incident reports.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; able to influence architecture decisions and drive alignment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Relevant industry certifications with major network/security vendors (e.g., Check Point CCSA/CCSE/CCSM, F5-CA/F5-CSE, Cisco CCNP, Palo Alto PCNSE, Fortinet NSE, etc.).
* Advanced certifications such as CCIE Security, CCDE, CISSP, or equivalent is highly desired.
* Experience with modern security patterns (e.g., zero trust segmentation, SASE concepts, secure access) and enterprise logging/telemetry platforms.
* Experience integrating network/security automation with ServiceNow and/or other ITSM systems.
* Experience with cloud networking and security controls (e.g., Azure/AWS/GCP) and hybrid connectivity patterns.
* Hands-on experience with tooling such as Ansible, Terraform, Python, Git, CI/CD, API-driven device management, and configuration compliance frameworks.

Core Competencies
  
  

* Technical authority and systems thinking across security, network, and application delivery layers
* Incident leadership: calm execution under pressure, strong diagnostics, and mitigation mindset
* Automation-first approach: reduce manual effort, standardize delivery, and improve reliability
* Strong collaboration: leads through influence across engineering, operations, and security partners
* Ownership and accountability: drives outcomes end-to-end and follows through on improvements

Examples of Work
  
  

* Lead a multi-phase Check Point firewall upgrade/migration program with minimal downtime and improved security posture.
* Engineer F5 traffic management enhancements for critical applications, including TLS modernization and health monitoring redesign.
* Build automation to validate firewall policy changes, generate compliance evidence, and roll back safely when required.
* Resolve a high-impact outage through packet capture, routing convergence analysis, and coordinated changes across multiple teams.

Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.

title: Active Directory Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
Cyberaube is a cybersecurity services company based in Nagpur and Pune that focuses on practical, vendor-neutral solutions instead of product reselling. The team brings over a decade of hands-on experience with leading security platforms such as QRadar, Splunk, CyberArk, Okta, and Guardium, helping clients avoid costly implementation mistakes. Cyberaube supports organizations with security talent placement, SIEM and IAM operations, data protection, and compliance with India’s DPDP Act and SEBI requirements. The company works with a diverse range of clients, including banks, hospitals, e-commerce firms, government bodies, and SaaS startups across India and beyond.

**Role Description**

* Senior Active Directory Engineer (L3) – Multi-Forest Enterprise
* Location: Pune or Nagpur (WFO)
* Experience: 7+ years
* Notice: Immediate–30 days preferred

**About the role**

We are looking for an L3 Active Directory engineer who owns the directory, not just the tickets in it. You will be the final technical escalation point for a large, multi-forest, multi-domain, multi-site Active Directory estate. When replication breaks, SYSVOL drifts or a DC fails, you read the repadmin and dcdiag output, find the root cause and fix it yourself.

**What will you do**

- Design, build and extend multi-domain and multi-forest AD: new domains, forest and external trusts, selective authentication, SID filtering and cross-forest DNS.

- Own replication health across a multi-site topology: sites, subnets, site links, costs, bridgeheads and KCC/ISTG behaviour.

- Diagnose and resolve deep replication failures: lingering objects, USN rollback, tombstone lifetime issues, and errors such as 8606, 8614, 8524 and 1722, using repadmin, dcdiag, ntdsutil and PowerShell.

- Support SYSVOL on DFSR: backlog analysis, dirty shutdown recovery, authoritative and non-authoritative restores, and FRS-to-DFSR migration where legacy domains remain.

- Manage the full DC lifecycle: promotion, demotion, forced removal, metadata cleanup, FSMO transfer and seizure, Global Catalog placement and OS upgrades.

- Run proactive DC health monitoring: define checks and alert thresholds, review Directory Service, DFS Replication and DNS logs, and act before users notice.

- Lead AD incident response for P1/P2 events and write the RCA and problem records that remove the cause, not just the symptom.

- Maintain AD backup and disaster recovery: system state backups, DSRM, and forest recovery planning and testing.

- Mentor L1/L2 engineers, write runbooks, and raise and execute change requests to ITIL standards.

**What you must have:**

- 7+ years in Windows infrastructure, including 5+ years of hands-on L3 Active Directory engineering in a large enterprise.

- Production experience in multi-forest and multi-domain environments, including setting up and troubleshooting trusts.

- Command-line fluency with repadmin, dcdiag, ntdsutil, dfsrdiag, nltest, setspn and the PowerShell ActiveDirectory module.

- A track record of resolving replication and SYSVOL/DFSR failures yourself, not escalating them.

- Experience leading AD incidents end to end, including writing the root cause analysis.

- An active Microsoft certification: Windows Server Administrator Associate (AZ-802), Windows Server Hybrid Administrator Associate (AZ-800 + AZ-801), or legacy MCSA/MCSE: Windows Server.

**Good to have:**

- AD CS / PKI, ADFS, Entra Connect in a multi-forest topology

- AD security hardening: tiered administration, LAPS, Kerberos/NTLM hardening, privileged group control

- Domain migrations or consolidations with ADMT or Quest

- PowerShell automation for health reporting and remediation

**THIS ROLE IS NOT A FIT IF...**

Your Active Directory experience is mainly user and group administration, password resets and lockouts, SSO/Okta onboarding, or Entra ID and Conditional Access. Those are valuable skills, but this role is about the infrastructure underneath: domain controllers, replication, SYSVOL, trusts and forest design.

Please apply OR you may also send your resume with other details such as your current CTC, your expected CTC and your tetative availability to join if offered at info[at]cyberaube[dot]com

title: Senior Data Center Technician
description:
**Overview**
As a Microsoft Senior Data Center Technician (DCT), you will demonstrate expertise in standard processes and procedures for preparing, installing, performing diagnostics, troubleshooting, replacing, and/or decommissioning equipment, as well as a holistic understanding of the functions of, and interactions between, network and server equipment. You will provide input for suggested modifications to these processes and procedures as needed to improve service quality and efficiency while providing guidance to other technicians.
  
  
Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I DCT, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development of all employees and offers training and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion training and events, and professional certifications.
  
  
Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 Data Centers in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.
  
  
With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our data center design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.
  
  
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Responsibilities**

* Apply advanced diagnostic and troubleshooting expertise to quickly identify the cause(s) of issues to quickly identify the cause of issues.
* Decommission hardware for complex changes and/or systems with complex interactions (e.g., upgrading entire racks) following standard procedures.
* Delegate hardware installation, deployment, and/or replacement work to technicians while providing expert guidance for preparing, staging, setting up, and performing startups and shutdowns (e.g., racks, hard drives, switches).
* Ensure quality execution as defined by organizational standards, coordinating downtime, and keeping relevant stakeholders informed of work status to minimize downstream rework.
* Assist and provide guidance to technicians to complete challenging or complex tasks and escalate issues as needed.
* Ensure that technicians are performing post-execution quality checks and verifying that grounding, staging, labeling, and cabling are set up in compliance with safety protocols, deployment standards, and planned Network Design Tasks (NDTs).
* Verify security compliance for decommissions and processes data-bearing devices for destruction.
* Maintain an awareness of Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) through dashboards and/or monthly performance discussions.
* Train and mentor technicians through on-the-job training and by providing direct guidance on specific tasks.
* Attend, conduct, or assist in conducting daily safety briefings, completes required safety training, provides guidance to technicians to facilitate compliance with safety procedures (e.g., Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) usage, equipment use, lifting, electrical hazards, ladder/rolling stair use).
* Has pride and a sense of accountability for the service quality, completeness, and resulting user experience.
* Embody our culture and values.

**Qualifications**
***Required*
Qualifications:**

* Graduate / Diploma, or equivalent and basic knowledge of computer hardware and components AND 2+ years’ experience supporting IT equipment or related technology.

**Background Check Requirements**
Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:
  
  

* Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

While not required, we also look for the following
***Preferred Qualifications:***

* Associate degree in computer science or other field and/or equivalent work experience.
* 3+ years’ experience supporting IT equipment or related technology.
* 2+ years’ experience working in a production, mission-critical 24x7x365 data center environment.
* Applicable certifications: ASICS/Inventory Control, CompTIA (A+, Server+, Network+), Basic Structure Cabling (BSC), Data Center Foundation Certification (DCFC), Microsoft Certified Professional (MCP), Vendor-Specific Network Certifications.

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

title: Deputy Manager SCADA
description:
**Senior Specialist – SCADA Design & Engineering**
At ENGIE, we are accelerating the shift to a cleaner, more connected energy world. Every project we deliver brings that future closer. We are looking for a Senior Specialist in SCADA Design and Engineering to help shape the digital backbone of our renewable energy assets across India and globally.
  
  
In this role, you will lead the engineering and lifecycle management of SCADA and control systems for Solar PV, Wind, BESS, Hybrid plants, and Substation Automation. Your expertise will directly influence how our plants perform, how our teams operate, and how we meet the energy challenges of tomorrow.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Lead the design, deployment, and validation of SCADA systems across renewable energy projects from engineering through post-commissioning handover.
* Review and validate system architecture, SLDs, tag lists, and data models from EPC contractors and OEMs against ENGIE standards.
* Assess OT network designs and communication protocols including IEC 104, IEC 61850, Modbus, OPC, and DNP3.
* Prepare SCADA technical specifications and tender documentation for PV, Wind, BESS, Hybrid, and substation projects.
* Lead and support FAT and SAT activities, ensuring data accuracy, tag integrity, and telemetry performance.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives and collaborate with IT teams on infrastructure upgrades and cybersecurity enhancements.
* Organize technical workshops with R&D and cross-functional teams to optimize plant performance and integrate emerging technologies.

**What You Bring**

* A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering (BE/BTech or equivalent, full-time).
* 10 to 12 years of experience in industrial engineering, preferably in renewable energy and large EPC environments.
* Strong expertise in SCADA engineering documentation including SLDs, point lists, relay schemes, and architecture drawings.
* In-depth knowledge of OT communication protocols, Power Plant Controllers (PPC), and cybersecurity principles.
* Exposure to BESS integration, hybrid plant control logic, and storage SCADA systems.
* Working knowledge of Python, Power BI, and digital or AI-based integrations.
* Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to deliver under pressure.

**Location**
This position is based in Pune, India.
  
  
**What We Offer**

* A senior role with broad scope, spanning projects in India and across global markets.
* A diverse portfolio of missions covering development, construction, and operations phases.
* Stimulating, technically complex work at the intersection of energy, digital, and automation.
* A collaborative and friendly work environment with access to ENGIE Group expertise worldwide.
* Flexibility and a culture that supports work-life balance.
* Real opportunities for career growth within a global energy leader committed to your development.

**Our Commitment**
At ENGIE, every talent has a role to play in accelerating the energy transition. Make a difference and enjoy a fulfilling professional experience. Take on exciting challenges and build a career path that reflects who you are. Join us and be part of the adventure of the century.
  
  
ENGIE is committed to equal opportunity. We welcome applications from all individuals regardless of age, gender, origin, religion, disability, or sexual orientation. We believe diverse teams build better solutions and stronger organizations.
  
  
If you require any reasonable accommodation during the recruitment process, please let us know. We are here to support you.

title: Lead Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!
  
  
The
**Lead Forward Deployed Engineer**
operates at the intersection of engineering, data, and customer deployment. In this hands-on, customer-facing role, you will lead complex enterprise onboardings to integrate, transform, and operationalize cybersecurity data into Qualys’ Enterprise TruRisk Management (ETM) platform. You will translate fragmented security environments into a unified risk model while bridging the gap between customer needs and core product engineering.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Customer Onboarding & Data Integration
  
  

* Strategic Execution: Lead end-to-end enterprise onboarding from strategy to production rollout, serving as the system of record for customer assets, findings, and business context.
* Pipeline & API Design: Build REST API, webhook, and scalable ingestion (e.g., S3-based ETL/ELT) pipelines to integrate diverse data sources (VM, EDR/XDR, Cloud, IAM, CMDBs, GRC).
* Data Modeling & Correlation: Design custom mapping, transformation, tagging, and asset criticality scoring; implement de-duplication and correlation logic across heterogeneous security feeds.
* Pipeline Reliability: Ensure continuous full and incremental data ingestion with automated scheduling, monitoring, and error handling.

Data Quality & Validation
  
  

* Data Integrity: Establish scalable validation frameworks to audit and maintain asset/findings accuracy for confident risk decision-making.
* Issue Resolution: Execute controlled reprocessing and configuration adjustments to fix data quality issues without disrupting operational metrics.

Dashboards, Remediation & Workflows
  
  

* Analytics & Modeling: Build customized dashboards, trend visualizations, and risk scoring models, including complex "toxic risk combination" scenarios.
* Workflow Automation: Integrate ETM with ticketing/remediation tools (Jira, ServiceNow) and configure automated alerts, escalations, and ownership mapping.
* Executive Reporting: Develop custom reports/utilities using public APIs for board-level, operational, and regulatory audiences.

Product & Engineering Feedback Loop
  
  

* Roadmap Influence: Translate field deployment challenges and recurring integration gaps into technical requirements for product and core engineering teams.
* Customer Maturity: Guide enterprises from initial risk visibility to automated, remediation-driven action.

Required Qualifications:
  
  

* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience: 8–10 years in data engineering, platform engineering, or customer-facing technical roles.
* Technical Stack:
* Strong programming proficiency in Python, Go, or similar languages.
* Deep experience with REST APIs, webhooks, asynchronous systems, and scalable ingestion pipelines (ETL/ELT).
* Hands-on knowledge of relational, NoSQL, search, or graph databases.
* Domain & Data Expertise:
* Strong foundation in data modeling, normalization, transformation, and correlation.
* Solid understanding of core cybersecurity domains (VM, Cloud Security, IAM, Risk Frameworks).
* Hands-on application of AI or automation to optimize data pipelines and onboarding workflows.
* Soft Skills: Exceptional client-facing, communication, and technical consultation skills.

Preferred Qualifications:
  
  

* Background in Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Engineering, or Technical Professional Services.
* Familiarity with large-scale, distributed systems and microservices architectures.
* Proven ability to thrive in high-impact, fast-paced, and ambiguous production environments.

description:
**Company Description**
At the Syngenta Group, our 56,000 people across more than 90 countries strive every day to transform agriculture through tailor-made solutions for the benefit of farmers, society and our planet – making us the world's most local agricultural technology and innovation partner.
  
  
Website address - https://www.syngentagroup.com/

**Job Description**
The Zscaler Technical Engineer will be responsible for the administration, and support of Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) and Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) platforms. The role focuses on securing internet and private application access for users through Zero Trust architecture, ensuring high availability, security compliance, and optimal performance.
  
  
**Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA)**

* Manage ZIA security policies including URL filtering, SSL inspection, sandboxing, firewall policies, and data loss prevention (DLP).
* Manage and troubleshoot Zscaler Client Connector for endpoint traffic forwarding.
* Integrate ZIA with identity providers (Azure AD, Okta, etc.) for user authentication and policy enforcement.
* Implement and manage PAC files, GRE/IPsec tunnels, and proxy configurations.
* Monitor internet traffic using ZIA dashboards, logs, and analytics.
* Troubleshoot connectivity issues related to DNS, proxy, SSL inspection, and application access.

**Zscaler Private Access (ZPA)**

* Manage and administrate Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) using ZPA.
* Manage App Connectors, Service Edges, and Application Segments.
* Define access policies based on user identity, device posture, and application context.
* Integrate ZPA with Identity Providers (SSO) and endpoint posture solutions.
* Manage private application onboarding and segmentation.
* Troubleshoot application access issues and optimize connectivity.
* Maintain high availability and scalability of ZPA infrastructure.

**Required Skills**

* Strong experience with Zscaler ZIA and ZPA platforms.
* Knowledge of Zero Trust Architecture and Secure Access Service Edge (SASE).
* Experience with DNS, TCP/IP, VPN, Proxy, SSL/TLS, and network security concepts.
* Experience with identity integrations (Azure AD, SAML, OAuth).
* Good understanding on Z-Identity.
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.

**Good to have Certifications**

* Zscaler Certified Cloud Professional (ZCCP)
* Zscaler Certified Specialist (ZCS)
* Zscaler Certified Expert (ZCE)

**Qualifications**
5+ years of experience in network / cloud security Including Zscaler Technologies

title: Assistant It Manager
description:

**Job Role Description:**

Manage and maintain the organization’s IT infrastructure, servers, data center operations, network and security systems, cloud services, and enterprise IT applications, ensuring high availability, security, performance, and business continuity.

1. IT Infrastructure Management

* Manage servers, storage, desktops, laptops, printers, network devices, and wireless systems.
* Plan infrastructure upgrades, installations, maintenance, and capacity; maintain documentation, asset inventories, and configuration records.

2. Server and Data Center Operations

* Manage physical/virtual servers, Windows and Linux environments, and virtualization platforms such as Microsoft Hyper-V.
* Monitor server performance, storage, hardware health, operating systems, and critical services; maintain UPS, power backup, cooling, physical access, and equipment safety.
* Plan server upgrades, migrations, preventive maintenance, and infrastructure improvements.

3. Network and IT Security

* Manage LAN/WAN, internet leased lines, routers, switches, firewalls, Wi-Fi, VPNs, and inter-site connectivity.
* Configure firewall policies, network access controls, secure remote access, and segmentation; manage endpoint security, antivirus/EDR, patching, access permissions, and system logs.
* Resolve network/security issues and implement appropriate security controls.

4. Backup, Disaster Recovery and Business Continuity

* Maintain backup policies for servers, virtual machines, applications, and business data; monitor jobs, retention, offsite copies, and recovery procedures.
* Conduct restoration tests and disaster recovery drills; maintain recovery plans to ensure continuity and minimize downtime.

5. IT Operations and Monitoring

* Monitor infrastructure availability, performance, system logs, and critical services; manage OS updates, software installations, patching, and preventive maintenance.
* Troubleshoot issues, perform root-cause analysis, implement corrective actions, and maintain incident, problem, change, and service-request processes.

6. Cloud Services and Enterprise Applications

* Administer Microsoft 365, Microsoft Entra ID, cloud storage, user accounts, access permissions, MFA, email, collaboration tools, and subscription renewals.
* Support cloud migration and hybrid infrastructure; monitor service availability, security configurations, and license utilization.

7. IT Asset, License and Compliance Management

* Maintain records of IT assets, software licenses, subscriptions, warranties, support contracts, installations, allocations, renewals, and compliance.
* Coordinate procurement, vendor support, maintenance contracts, and upgrades; maintain IT policies, SOPs, and audit documentation.

8. IT Service Delivery and Team Management

* Lead the IT support team, assign responsibilities, monitor task completion, and ensure timely incident and service-request resolution.
* Coordinate with departments, vendors, and service providers; prepare IT budgets, infrastructure proposals, operational reports, and project updates.
* Identify opportunities to improve IT service quality, security, reliability, and cost efficiency.

**Qualifications and Skills:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in IT, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field
* 10–15 years of relevant experience
* Windows Server, Linux fundamentals, virtualization and server hardware; networking, TCP/IP, VLANs, DNS, DHCP, VPN, routing, switching and firewall administration; backup/disaster recovery, infrastructure monitoring and endpoint security; Microsoft 365, Microsoft Entra ID and cloud administration; IT asset management, software licensing, vendor management and IT documentation.
* Experience managing enterprise IT infrastructure in a manufacturing or multi-location organization. Relevant certifications in Microsoft technologies, networking, cybersecurity, virtualization, or IT service management.

title: NCX Senior Engineer
description:
NVIDIA is hiring an NCX Senior Engineer who is passionate about NVIDIA Cloud Partner (NCP) infrastructure operations to join our DSX team. This role involves working closely with strategic NVIDIA Cloud Partners to build and improve the operational capabilities essential for running large-scale NVIDIA accelerated infrastructure reliably in production.
  
  
Your role involves guiding partners beyond the initial cluster deployment and validation phase into advanced Day 2 operations. These operations cover ongoing infrastructure health, observability, lifecycle management, quick remediation, performance validation, and operational readiness. You will engage directly with partner engineering and operations teams to develop consistent approaches that support NVIDIA workloads and the broader external customer environments of the partners. This is a highly technical, hands-on role at the intersection of NVIDIA accelerated computing, cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, and production operations.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Lead NCP Day 2 operational readiness efforts. Collaborate directly with NVIDIA Cloud Partners to set up the systems, procedures, automation, and operational methods necessary to consistently manage NVIDIA accelerated infrastructure following initial deployment and activation.
* Build continuous infrastructure validation. Develop and implement methods to continuously validate GPU, CPU, storage, and network health. Do this across large-scale AI clusters to identify degraded infrastructure before it impacts critical training or inference workloads.
* Establish observability and operational telemetry. Help NCPs implement comprehensive telemetry, monitoring, alerting, dashboards, and operational signals across compute, GPU, InfiniBand/RoCE networking, storage, Kubernetes, and AI workloads.
* Develop automated detection and remediation. Build workflows to detect, isolate, drain, repair, validate, and return unhealthy infrastructure to service while minimizing disruption to customer workloads.
* Refine fleet lifecycle administration. Implement scalable strategies for managing sizable GPU fleets, including NVIDIA driver and firmware lifecycle administration, Kubernetes node maintenance, OS patching, configuration management, upgrades, and configuration drift identification.
* Operationalize NVIDIA reference architectures. Translate NVIDIA NCP requirements and reference architectures into production operating practices, validation criteria, runbooks, automation, and measurable operational standards.
* Define operational health and readiness. Develop health signals, SLOs, important metrics, acceptance criteria, and ongoing validation mechanisms that provide NVIDIA and NCPs with clear insight into infrastructure reliability and service readiness.
* Build reusable operational frameworks. Develop tooling, automation, implementation guides, runbooks, operational playbooks, and reference implementations that can be applied consistently across multiple NCP environments.

**What We Need To See**

* BS, MS, or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Computer/Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.
* 8+ years of experience in infrastructure engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, cloud platform engineering, systems engineering, or similar roles supporting large-scale production environments.
* Strong experience operating Linux-based distributed systems and cloud infrastructure in production.
* Deep understanding of Kubernetes, containers, cluster scheduling, and the operational lifecycle of large multi-node environments.
* Strong understanding of production observability, including metrics, logging, alerting, dashboards, health checks, and operations guided by service level agreements.
* Experience crafting automation for infrastructure lifecycle management, failure detection, remediation, upgrades, and configuration management.
* Strong networking fundamentals and experience troubleshooting complex distributed systems across compute, network, and storage layers.
* Programming and automation experience using Python, Go, shell scripting, or similar languages.

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Experience managing extensive GPU or accelerated computing infrastructure that supports AI training and inference workloads.
* Experience with NVIDIA technologies including DGX/HGX systems, CUDA, NVLink/NVSwitch, NVIDIA networking, InfiniBand, RoCE, GPU Operator, Network Operator, or related NVIDIA infrastructure software.
* Proven experience collaborating with NVIDIA Cloud Partners, hyperscale cloud providers, managed AI clouds, or extensive service-provider infrastructure and operating SLOs for large-scale compute infrastructure and using operational data to improve availability, performance, and fleet efficiency.
* Extensive knowledge of infrastructure observability tools including Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Alertmanager, and scalable telemetry pipelines and translating reference architectures or infrastructure requirements into repeatable production operating models across multiple customer or partner environments.
* Knowledge of failure modes related to large distributed AI workloads and the infrastructure features necessary to consistently support extended training and production inference.

NVIDIA is leading the way in groundbreaking developments in Artificial Intelligence, High-Performance Computing, and Visualization. The GPU, our invention, serves as the visual cortex of modern computers and is at the heart of our products and services. Our work opens up new universes to explore, enables amazing creativity and discovery, and powers what were once science fiction inventions from artificial intelligence to autonomous cars. NVIDIA is looking for phenomenal people like you to help us accelerate the next wave of artificial intelligence. NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and dedicated people in the world working for us.

description:
**About Dataction**
Dataction is a new age services firm that offers best in class information technology, analytics, and consulting services to renowned international companies. Dataction was established in 2010 and has grown rapidly over the last decade. Dataction has built a reputation for providing differentiated and reliable services to a wide range of customers across multiple sectors.
