Our people are committed, courageous, and unafraid of pushing boundaries. They help our clients make decisions that deliver immediate and measurable benefits, justifying investments. Our engagement models provide the perfect blend of quality, control, and cost for our customers.
  
  
To know more about Dataction, please visit https://dataction.co
  
  
**Job Purpose**
We are seeking an experienced Senior Hyper-V Infrastructure Engineer to build the target Microsoft Hyper-V platform and migrate our client's server workloads off VMware safely and on schedule. The client's VMware licences expire in November 2026, so this is a time-critical, hands-on delivery role. The successful candidate will act as the senior technical authority for the server workload migration on HPE ProLiant hosts: ~100 production server VMs (TAG cluster) and a single-host backup recovery cluster moving from VMware vSphere 8.0 to Microsoft Hyper-V. He/She will plan and run a rolling host-by-host migration, protect service continuity throughout, work closely with the VDI/XenServer workstream, and leave behind documentation the client's operations team can run with.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Microsoft Hyper-V Platform Build & Hardening

+ Build, configure, and harden Hyper-V hosts (Windows Server 2019/2022 Datacenter) on HPE ProLiant hardware, including iLO, firmware/SPP, and driver compliance.
+ Design and deploy Hyper-V Failover Clusters: Cluster Shared Volumes, quorum/witness, live migration, and Switch Embedded Teaming.
+ Configure virtual networking (Hyper-V virtual switches, VLANs, SET/NIC teaming) and SAN storage connectivity (iSCSI/FC, MPIO) to match the existing VMware design.
+ Deploy and configure management tooling (SCVMM and/or Windows Admin Center), including host groups, logical networks, VM templates, and role-based access.
+ Stand up the Hyper-V environment for ~100 production server VMs (TAG cluster) and the single-host recovery environment.
+ Integrate the new hosts with Active Directory, DNS, monitoring, and patching tooling.

* Server Workload Migration (VMware Exit)

+ Assess the VMware vSphere 8.0 server estate (clusters, VM inventory, application dependencies, networks, datastores) and produce the migration plan and cutover schedule against the 11 November 2026 deadline.
+ Run a rolling migration: evacuate a host, rebuild it as Hyper-V, migrate workloads, and repeat, using spare cluster capacity to avoid disruption.
+ Convert and migrate VMs using appropriate V2V tooling (e.g. SCVMM, Windows Admin Center VM Conversion, Veeam restore to Hyper-V), including VMware Tools removal, Integration Services, Generation 1/2 decisions, and network/IP re-mapping.
+ Plan and execute a safe approach for the single-host recovery cluster, where no spare capacity exists.
+ Define test, validation, and rollback procedures for each cutover, and coordinate change windows, out-of-hours activity, and application owner sign-off with the client.
+ Decommission VMware hosts once workloads are verified and signed off.

* Backup, Resilience & Security

+ Rebuild and migrate the Veeam backup server and backup proxy onto Hyper-V; reconfigure backup jobs for Hyper-V and confirm repositories and restore tests work on the new platform.
+ Configure high availability, VM placement and anti-affinity rules, and checkpoint policies for production workloads.
+ Apply security hardening aligned to CIS Benchmarks and Microsoft Security Baselines on all new hosts.
+ Establish patching and lifecycle processes for the new hosts (e.g. WSUS / SCCM / MECM / Cluster-Aware Updating).

* Automation, Documentation & Handover

+ Automate repetitive build, configuration, and migration tasks using PowerShell (Hyper-V and FailoverClusters modules).
+ Produce build documentation, runbooks, and operational handover for the client's infrastructure team, and brief them on day-to-day management.
+ Coordinate with the Citrix XenServer / VDI workstream on shared hardware, networks, storage, and the overall migration schedule.

**Qualification, Skills And Experience**

* 10+ years of relevant experience in virtualisation and Wintel infrastructure, with deep hands-on expertise in Microsoft Hyper-V.
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology or Engineering.
* Strong hands-on experience building and managing Microsoft Hyper-V hosts and Failover Clusters (Cluster Shared Volumes, live migration, quorum, Switch Embedded Teaming) in production.
* Strong experience with System Center Virtual Machine Manager and/or Windows Admin Center for managing Hyper-V at scale.
* Proven experience migrating 100+ server VMs from VMware to Hyper-V with minimal downtime, using V2V tooling such as SCVMM, Windows Admin Center VM Conversion, or Veeam.
* Good understanding of VMware vSphere/ESXi 7.x/8.x, including vCenter, VM export (OVF/VMDK), VMware Tools removal, and host decommissioning.
* Hands-on experience with HPE ProLiant servers, including iLO, firmware/SPP compliance, and Smart Array configuration.
* Good understanding of storage and SAN technologies, including Fibre Channel, iSCSI, and MPIO, and their use with Hyper-V Cluster Shared Volumes.
* Understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, VLANs, LACP/NIC teaming, switching, and firewalls.
* Good understanding of backup and disaster recovery technologies, especially Veeam Backup & Replication in Hyper-V environments (backup server/proxy rebuilds, repositories, restore testing).
* Strong experience in Windows Server administration (2016/2019/2022/2025), including Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, and Group Policy management.
* Hands-on experience with PowerShell scripting (including the Hyper-V and FailoverClusters modules) for infrastructure automation, administration, and migration tasks.
* Experience implementing security baselines and hardening standards, including CIS Benchmarks and Microsoft Security Baselines, and managing patching (WSUS / SCCM / MECM / Cluster-Aware Updating).
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills across Hyper-V, Failover Clustering, Windows, networking, storage, and other infrastructure layers.
* Experience producing migration runbooks, cutover plans, rollback procedures, and working within change management processes.
* Excellent documentation and communication skills, with the ability to clearly document technical solutions, operational procedures, and handover material.
* Exposure to Citrix XenServer or Azure Stack HCI / Azure Local is desirable.
* Prior VMware exit / hypervisor replatforming project experience is desirable.
* Relevant certifications are desirable: Microsoft (Windows Server Hybrid Administrator Associate / Azure Stack HCI) or VMware Certified Professional – Data Center Virtualization (VCP-DCV).

**Why should you join Dataction?**
Fairness, Meritocracy, Empowerment, And Opportunity Are Pillars Of Our Work Culture. In Addition To a Competitive Salary, You Can Look Forward To
  
  

* Great work-life balance through hybrid work arrangement.
* Company funded skill enhancement and training.
* Exciting reward and recognition programme.
* Opportunity to bond with colleagues through exciting employee engagement initiatives.
* Great on the job learning opportunity through involvement in new product/ ideation teams.

* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills across XenServer, Citrix, Windows, networking, storage, and other infrastructure layers.
* Experience producing migration runbooks, cutover plans, rollback procedures, and working within change management processes.

title: Sr. System Administrator
description:
Senior Server Administrator – IT Infrastructure
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
The Senior Server Administrator is responsible for the design, administration, maintenance, security, and continuous improvement of the organisation’s server and IT infrastructure environment. The role will ensure that infrastructure services remain secure, resilient, highly available, and aligned with business requirements.
  
  
The successful candidate will provide senior-level technical expertise across physical and virtual server environments, operating systems, storage, backup, monitoring, patching, and infrastructure security. They will also play a key role in incident resolution, infrastructure projects, service improvements, and technical planning.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Server & Infrastructure Administration
  
  

* Administer and maintain Windows and/or Linux server environments across physical and virtual platforms.
* Manage server hardware, operating systems, virtualisation platforms, storage, and associated infrastructure services.
* Monitor system performance, capacity, availability, and health, proactively identifying and resolving potential issues.
* Perform server builds, configuration, upgrades, migrations, and decommissioning in accordance with established standards.
* Maintain accurate infrastructure documentation, configuration records, and technical procedures.
* Ensure infrastructure platforms are appropriately configured for availability, performance, and resilience.

Infrastructure Operations & Support
  
  

* Provide senior-level technical support for infrastructure incidents, service requests, and problems.
* Troubleshoot complex server, operating system, networking, storage, and infrastructure-related issues.
* Participate in an on-call or out-of-hours support rota where required.
* Lead or support the resolution of major incidents and provide root-cause analysis and corrective actions.
* Work closely with service desk, network, security, application, and other IT teams to resolve cross-functional issues.

Security & Compliance
  
  

* Maintain server security in line with organisational policies and industry best practices.
* Manage operating system patching, vulnerability remediation, antivirus/endpoint protection, and security configuration.
* Support security audits, compliance requirements, and infrastructure risk assessments.
* Implement and maintain appropriate access controls, privileged access, and server hardening standards.
* Work with cybersecurity teams to investigate and remediate infrastructure security incidents.

Backup, Recovery & Business Continuity
  
  

* Manage and monitor server backup and recovery solutions.
* Regularly test backup restoration and disaster recovery procedures.
* Support the development and maintenance of infrastructure disaster recovery and business continuity plans.
* Ensure critical infrastructure services meet agreed recovery time and recovery point objectives.

Projects & Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Lead or contribute to infrastructure projects, including server upgrades, migrations, cloud adoption, virtualisation, and technology refresh programmes.
* Evaluate new technologies and recommend improvements to infrastructure services.
* Identify opportunities to automate routine administration and improve operational efficiency.
* Develop and maintain technical standards, processes, and best-practice procedures.
* Support capacity planning and future infrastructure strategy.

Stakeholder & Supplier Management
  
  

* Work collaboratively with internal IT teams, business stakeholders, and third-party suppliers.
* Provide technical guidance and communicate complex infrastructure issues clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Support supplier management, technical reviews, and service improvement activities where required.
* Provide mentoring and technical guidance to junior infrastructure team members.

**Essential Skills & Experience**

* Significant experience in a senior server/infrastructure administration role.
* Strong experience administering Windows Server and/or Linux environments.
* Strong knowledge of Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, and core infrastructure services.
* Experience with virtualisation technologies such as VMware or Microsoft Hyper-V.
* Strong understanding of server hardware, storage, networking, and infrastructure architecture.
* Experience with enterprise backup and disaster recovery solutions.
* Strong knowledge of server security, patch management, vulnerability remediation, and hardening.
* Experience troubleshooting complex infrastructure incidents and performing root-cause analysis.
* Good understanding of ITIL principles and IT service management processes.
* Experience working with monitoring and infrastructure management tools.
* Strong documentation and technical communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of complex technical issues.

Desirable Skills
  
  

* Experience with Microsoft Azure, AWS, or other cloud infrastructure platforms.
* Experience with PowerShell, Bash, Python, or other scripting/automation technologies.
* Experience with infrastructure-as-code and configuration management tools.
* Knowledge of Microsoft 365 and hybrid infrastructure environments.
* Experience with enterprise storage technologies.
* Experience with high-availability and disaster recovery architectures.
* Relevant certifications such as Microsoft, VMware, Linux, ITIL, or cloud certifications.

Key Competencies
  
  

* Technical expertise: Demonstrates strong knowledge of server and infrastructure technologies.
* Problem solving: Able to diagnose complex technical problems and develop effective solutions.
* Ownership: Takes responsibility for infrastructure services and follows issues through to resolution.
* Communication: Communicates clearly with technical teams, management, suppliers, and business stakeholders.
* Continuous improvement: Identifies opportunities to improve reliability, security, performance, and efficiency.
* Teamwork: Works effectively across IT teams and supports knowledge sharing.
* Resilience: Able to manage priorities and remain effective during incidents and high-pressure situations.

Key Performance Indicators
  
  

* Infrastructure availability and reliability.
* Timely resolution of infrastructure incidents and problems.
* Successful completion of infrastructure projects and upgrades.
* Server patching and vulnerability remediation compliance.
* Backup success rates and successful recovery testing.
* Infrastructure security and compliance performance.
* Reduction in recurring incidents and infrastructure-related risks.
* Quality and accuracy of infrastructure documentation.
* Delivery of automation and continuous improvement initiatives.

Role Summary
  
  
The Senior Server Administrator will be a key member of the IT Infrastructure team, responsible for ensuring the stability, security, resilience, and performance of critical server and infrastructure services. The role requires a proactive and technically capable individual who can manage day-to-day operations while also contributing to strategic infrastructure improvements and business continuity.

Our associates, customers and shareholders contribute unique and different perspectives as a result of these diverse attributes.

title: WAN & Network Service Delivery Manager
description:
**We Offer**
The WAN & Network Service Delivery Manager combines two equally important responsibilities within KION's Enterprise Network service. Approximately 50% of the role governs the global WAN managed service, and approximately 50% coordinates service delivery and BAU operations across Campus LAN, Wi-Fi, WAN and DDI.
  
  
For WAN governance, the role monitors supplier delivery, contractual performance, service levels, lifecycle, risks, costs and improvement actions. The role prepares analysis, forecasts, recommendations and decision proposals for the Enterprise Network Service Owner. Budget accountability, cost-centre responsibility, contract ownership and final commercial decisions remain with the Enterprise Network Service Owner. Day-to-day operational coordination with the WAN managed service provider is performed by a designated WAN Operations Coordinator under the functional guidance of this role; overall WAN governance responsibility remains with this position.
  
  
For network service delivery, the role coordinates the shared operating model, queues, incidents, service requests, changes, problems, operational readiness and performance reporting. The role has no disciplinary or matrix people-management responsibility for network engineers. Engineering capacity and line management remain with the responsible managers, while this role provides process coordination, prioritisation transparency and cross-domain escalation.
  
  
The role works closely with the Enterprise Network Service Owner, Lead Network Architect, network engineers, IT Service Management, regional IT teams, Procurement, Finance and external network providers.
  
  
**Tasks And Qualifications**

* WAN governance, roadmap and lifecycle - 15%
* Prepare and maintain the proposed WAN service roadmap in alignment with the Enterprise Network Service Owner and Lead Network Architect.
* Identify lifecycle, resilience, capacity, sourcing and technical-debt risks and prepare recommendations for accountable decision makers.
* Track approved governance decisions and improvement actions to completion.
* WAN supplier and contractual-performance governance - 15%
* Act as the primary operational governance interface for the WAN managed service provider, carriers and access providers.
* Monitor SLAs, KPIs, contractual obligations, potential service credits, risks and supplier commitments.
* Prepare evidence and recommendations for contract, renewal and commercial decisions owned by the Enterprise Network Service Owner.
* Lead supplier service reviews and escalate recurring underperformance, weak corrective actions and unresolved risks.
* WAN cost transparency, demand and transition assurance - 10%
* Prepare cost, consumption and forecast transparency for review and approval by the Enterprise Network Service Owner; the role has no budget or cost-centre accountability.
* Assess the WAN service, supplier, commercial and operational implications of approved demands.
* Coordinate provider estimates, service acceptance and transition requirements with the demand owner, Lead Network Architect and Enterprise Network Service Owner.
* Ensure operational acceptance covers documentation, monitoring, testing, support routes, supplier acceptance and handover.
* WAN performance, data and continual improvement - 10%
* Maintain WAN scorecards covering availability, incidents, capacity, resilience, change quality, supplier performance and cost transparency.
* Coordinate supplier follow-up after significant interruptions, including RCA quality and preventive actions.
* Maintain accurate governance artefacts and promote consistent data across ITSM, CMDB, monitoring, inventory and source-of-truth capabilities.
* Identify opportunities for automation, observability, data-quality improvement and reduced manual coordination.
* Enterprise Network operations coordination - 20%
* Coordinate the BAU operating model across Campus LAN, Wi-Fi, WAN and DDI without assuming disciplinary or matrix people-management responsibility.
* Run queue reviews, service-health reviews and handover checkpoints; make ageing, blocked work and coverage gaps transparent.
* Coordinate operational priorities with line managers and engineering leads and escalate unresolved capacity conflicts to the Service Owner.
* Provide functional guidance to the designated WAN Operations Coordinator responsible for daily KION-provider coordination.
* Incident and service-request coordination - 15%
* Coordinate triage, ownership, progression and documentation for incidents and service requests in the shared Enterprise Network queue.
* Coordinate cross-domain and high-priority incidents, bringing together network, security, application, infrastructure and supplier teams.
* Ensure clear ownership, timely escalation, stakeholder communication and disciplined technical handovers; specialist teams retain technical resolution responsibility.
* Monitor ticket ageing, reassignments and documentation quality and drive corrective action where required.
* Change, problem and operational-readiness governance - 10%
* Coordinate operational risk reviews for significant or high-risk network changes, including production dependencies and rollback readiness.
* Drive follow-up of recurring problems, RCAs, known errors and preventive actions.
* Confirm that new or changed services enter BAU with monitoring, documentation, runbooks, support ownership, access and escalation routes in place.
* Operational performance and service improvement - 5%
* Report queue health, response and restoration performance, recurring incidents, backlog, monitoring coverage and handover quality.
* Maintain and improve SOPs, runbooks, escalation contacts, service maps and operational knowledge.
* Use operational trends to recommend improvements to resilience, automation, standards and training

Interfaces
  
  
**Internal**

* Secure Connectivity platform leadership, functional and team leads, and rotating operations engineers
* Enterprise and Network architecture; Cybersecurity and Information Security
* IT Service Management, e.g. Service Desk, (Major) Incident, Problem and Change
* Procurement, Legal, Finance/Controlling and Vendor Management
* Regional and onsite IT, business partners, programme and project managers
* Cloud, datacentre, workplace, decentralised infrastructure and application teams

**External**

* Telecommunications carriers and local access providers
* Managed network and security service providers
* Network technology vendors, integrators and professional-services partners
* Auditors and specialist advisers where required

title: Customer Delivery Architect | 10+ years, SOC transformation
description:
**Meet the Team**
Cisco Customer Experience (CX) Security Services is a global team of elite security practitioners, architects, and trusted advisors who help our largest enterprise and service provider customers defend against sophisticated threats, achieve operational cyber resilience, and accelerate digital transformation. As part of our specialized Security Operations Center (SOC) Transformation & Advanced Analytics practice, you will work alongside top-tier consulting engineers, automation developers, and solution architects to design and deliver next-generation SOC architectures, SIEM modernization, behavioral analytics, and end-to-end security automation.
  
  
**Your Impact**
As a Security Consulting Architect for SOC Transformation & Splunk, you will be the chief technical authority and visionary guiding our enterprise customers through complex SOC modernization journeys. You will translate customer business outcomes, risk profiles, and operational strategies into scalable, high-fidelity security architectures powered by Splunk Cloud, Splunk Enterprise Security (ES), Splunk SOAR, User & Entity Behavior Analytics (UEBA), Cribl Stream, and modern object storage (MinIO).
  
  
This is a high-impact, hands-on leadership role. You will engage with customer CISOs, SOC Directors, and Enterprise Architects to define target operating models and modernization roadmaps, while also leading implementation pods, troubleshooting deep technical roadblocks, optimizing search pipelines, and setting the engineering standards for multi-terabyte security analytics.
  
  

* Target SOC Architecture & Transformation Strategy: Lead the architectural design, Target Operating Model (TOM), and delivery strategy for multi-tier enterprise SOCs, SIEM modernizations, and security automation frameworks aligned with MITRE ATT&CK and Cisco Validated Designs.
* Splunk Cloud & Enterprise Security (ES) Mastery: Architect enterprise-scale Splunk Cloud deployments; design Risk-Based Alerting (RBA) frameworks, Data Model Acceleration (DMA) strategies, optimized | tstats search pipelines, Asset & Identity (A&I) contextual enrichment, and ESCU detection updates to eliminate alert fatigue.
* Modern Telemetry Ingestion & Storage Architecture: Architect high-throughput, resilient security data collection pipelines leveraging Cribl Stream for edge transformation, filtering, and routing, combined with MinIO / S3-compatible object storage for high-performance SmartStore tiering and compliance data archiving.
* Security Automation & SOAR Engineering: Define incident triage and response workflows, designing modular, production-grade Python playbooks in Splunk SOAR for automated threat enrichment (Talos, VirusTotal), endpoint containment (EDR isolation), firewall mitigation, and bidirectional ITSM (ServiceNow) synchronization.
* Technical Pod Leadership & Governance: Provide technical direction, architectural governance, and mentorship to specialized engineering execution pods (Data Ingestion/GDI, Detection Engineering, UEBA, SOAR); serve as the hands-on escalation authority for complex SPL optimization, CIM normalization, and API integrations.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 10+ years of technical cybersecurity engineering and architecture experience designing and deploying enterprise Security Operations Center (SOC) environments and SIEM/SOAR platforms.
* 5+ years of dedicated, hands-on architecture and engineering experience with Splunk Enterprise, Splunk Cloud, and Splunk Enterprise Security (ES), including correlation search engineering, Data Model Acceleration, and Risk-Based Alerting (RBA).
* 3+ years of hands-on experience in security telemetry pipeline engineering, including log routing and normalization with Cribl Stream, data parsing (props.conf / transforms.conf), and object storage/SmartStore tiering with MinIO or S3-compatible cloud storage.
* 3+ years of security orchestration and automation experience designing and building automated response playbooks using Splunk SOAR (Phantom), REST APIs, and Python
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or equivalent practical industry engineering experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Splunk & Pipeline Certifications: Splunk Enterprise Certified Architect, Splunk Enterprise Security Certified Admin, Splunk SOAR Certified Automation Developer, or Cribl Certified Observability Engineer (CCOE).
* Industry Security Credentials: CISSP, CCIE Security, CISM, or GIAC certifications (GCIH, GCIA, GDSA, GMON).
* Advanced Behavioral Analytics & Threat Modeling: Practical experience deploying Splunk UEBA, implementing machine learning models for anomaly detection, and conducting atomic detection testing against the MITRE ATT&CK matrix.
* Executive Advisory & Technical Consulting: Exceptional C-suite consulting, presentation, and technical leadership skills with a proven track record of advising CISOs, leading technical workshops, and driving organizational change.
* Hybrid Cloud & Multi-Vendor Ecosystem Integration: Deep knowledge of multi-cloud security logging, Next-Gen Firewalls (Palo Alto, Cisco Secure Firewall), EDR platforms (CrowdStrike, Microsoft Defender), and Cisco Security Cloud integrations.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

title: Senior Engineer - Network
description:
**Job Title: Senior Zero Trust Network Security Engineer**
**Location- Pune/Bangalore**
**What You Will Do**
As part of JCI’s ongoing and exciting digital transformation strategy, as a Senior Zero Trust Network Security Engineer you will act as a technical lead and subject matter expert across our global Enterprise Security estate. You will work with the wider global network and IT teams, business partners and managed service vendors to design, engineer and operate the physical and logical Enterprise Security infrastructure (Zscaler Secure Service Edge, firewalls, remote access platforms, cloud proxies, microsegmentation (Zscaler and Guardicore), cloud security & perimeter security devices etc.) portfolio in Johnson Controls. This is a senior, hands-on role with a strong emphasis on our Zscaler platform – including Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA), Zscaler Private Access (ZPA), Zscaler Data Loss Prevention (DLP) and Zscaler AI Security – underpinning JCI’s Zero Trust program.
  
  
Our Network infrastructure consists of a large global footprint of more than one thousand sites supporting over one hundred thousand employees ranging from datacenters, manufacturing plants, sales branches, and customer contact centers with exposure to a wide range of exciting network technologies and vendors such as Zscaler (ZIA, ZPA, DLP, AI Security and Microsegmentation), Fortinet, Zscaler ZT Branch Connector, Akamai Guardicore, Imperva WAF, Forescout, Microsoft Azure, Amazon AWS and many more partners.
  
  
The role will be working as part of a global high-performance team focused on continuous network security infrastructure delivery and upgrades, maintenance and operational activities, delivery of security configurations and services, incident and change management, network security design and compliance, equipment ordering, scheduling, security device life cycle management, operational handover, vendor management and network security infrastructure asset management.
  
  
**How You Will Do It**

* Manage and implement network security infrastructure
* Serve as senior engineer and design authority for the Zscaler platform – ZIA, ZPA, Inline DLP, AI Security (Secure AI Access), Digital Experience (ZDX) and Zscaler Microsegmentation
* Build and tune ZIA/ZPA access policies, SSL inspection, DLP dictionaries and AI Security controls, and lead the migration of users to full SSE capability
* Firewall, IPS/IDS and remote access configuration and rule management across the Fortinet estate (FortiGate, FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer)
* Cloud-based Web Application Firewall (Imperva WAF), microsegmentation and workload protection (Zscaler and Akamai Guardicore), and perimeter/geo-blocking controls
* Design, build, operate and automate security solutions and processes to protect the integrity of the organization's networks, systems, applications and data.
* Work closely with Security team partners/Business Relationship Managers , Field IT leadership and managed service suppliers to ensure successful identification and timely delivery of network security services to the business.
* Participate and consult(in partnership with the Network lifecycle refresh team) the identification, selection and prioritization of security infrastructure refresh components to ensure alignment with risk avoidance, strategic goals and organizational priorities.
* Respond to security incidents, including data breaches, and coordinate with other IT teams to mitigate the impact of any security breaches.
* Conduct regular security audits to identify vulnerabilities in the network and implement measures to address them.
* Partner with IT audit to remediate security gaps in a timley manner.
* Drive and develop automation opportunities for the management of security infrastructure.
* Manage the global Network security infrastrucutre inventory in CMDB.
* Ensure timely quote turnaround for security infrastructure delivery.
* Ensure all network asset data is accurate and support contracts are in place.
* Provide technical leadership and mentorship to engineers and operations staff, set standards and act as an escalation point for complex incidents and designs.
* Lead delivery of the Zero Trust program, including microsegmentation of crown-jewel applications with Zscaler and Guardicore, geo-blocking and reduction of the internet-facing attack surface.

**Required**
**What we look for:**

* Deep, hands-on expertise with the Zscaler platform is essential – Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA), Zscaler Private Access (ZPA), Zscaler DLP and Zscaler AI Security (Secure AI Access), including policy design, SSL inspection, App Connectors/Service Edges and tenant administration.
* Strong network infrastructure security background across both on-prem physical components (firewalls, IDS/IPS, remote access) and cloud security services (Zscaler, Azure, AWS), plus experience with Zscaler ZDX and microsegmentation (Zscaler and/or Guardicore).
* Strong knowledge of the Fortinet security suite (FortiGate, FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer) and experience testing and implementing security-related changes in a production environment.
* Experience working with 3rd party vendors and managed network service providers.
* Great organisational skills.
* Strong experience of working on SIEM tools to analyze logs and correlate events.
* Solid understanding of industry standard Cybersecurity Frameworks and compliance requirements
* Experience in Enterprise level network security incidents and change Management process.
* Solid technical understanding of DMZs, security policies, secure application traffic flows, WAF, DDoS protection, SSL offloading and inspection.
* Strong knowledge of Zero Trust Network Architecture
* Experience with private and public cloud providers is a plus, (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP, Nutanix) particularly in connectivity, availability, resilience, and security.
* Familiarity with service now Ticketing and CMDB is desirable
* Demonstrated capability to take part as lead security engineer in multi-phase / multi-year network projects or programs, leading these projects to successful implementation.
* Strong technical troubleshooting skill.
* Strong vendor management experience.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills to provide clear messages to all levels.
* Demonstrated ability to effectively establish and maintain strategic working relationships with peers and constituents at all levels of the organization.
* Demonstrated analysis and problem solving skills using innovative thinking.
* Knowledge of ITIL based practices.
* Knowledge of Python and automation skills are desirable.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or other applicable discipline.
* 8+ years of proven, hands-on network security experience at global enterprise organizations, including significant experience owning and operating a Zscaler (ZIA/ZPA) environment at scale.
* Network security Professional level certification preferred (e.g. Zscaler ZDTA/ZCCP/ZCCA, Fortinet NSE, Imperva, etc.); Zscaler certification strongly preferred.
* CISSP, CEH, CISM or CISA certifications is a plus.

The consultant will work closely with management, internal teams, and external vendors to ensure reliable IT operations, optimize digital platforms, strengthen online visibility, and implement technology-driven solutions that support business growth and customer engagement.

* Explore integrations between the website, customer enquiry systems, and internal business applications.
* Support technology initiatives that improve travel planning, customer service, lead management, and operational efficiency.

* Prepare reports on system performance, website activity, and digital engagement metrics.

The ideal candidate will take ownership of these responsibilities and identify opportunities to strengthen the company’s digital presence and operational capabilities.

**Hungry, Humble, Honest, with Heart.**
**The Opportunity**
Are you a seasoned Systems Reliability Engineer with a passion for troubleshooting complex technical issues, expertise in networking and virtualization, and a customer-driven mindset? If so, you'll thrive in our collaborative team environment at Nutanix, where you will have the opportunity to work on innovative projects, enhance customer satisfaction, and grow alongside top-tier technology specialists in a supportive hybrid work setting.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Systems Reliability Engineer III will join a dynamic and collaborative team focused on delivering exceptional customer support at Nutanix. This team, based in
**Pune**
, comprises top-tier technology specialists who emphasize innovation, problem-solving, and continuous learning. The culture promotes knowledge-sharing and teamwork, all aimed at improving customer satisfaction and contributing to overall business success by engaging in cutting-edge projects that directly impact customer experiences.
  
  
You will report to the Manager, Worldwide Support, who fosters a supportive and customer-centric leadership style. This manager emphasizes collaboration and growth, ensuring that each team member has opportunities to contribute effectively and excel in their role. The work setup for this position is hybrid, requiring team members to be in the office three days a week to facilitate meetings and collaboration while allowing flexibility for remote work on the remaining days.
  
  
This role does not require travel, allowing you to focus on delivering outstanding support and service to our customers while maintaining a healthy work-life balance in a hybrid setup.
  
  
**Your Role**

* Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues for customers, ensuring high satisfaction levels.
* Collaborate with developers to identify and improve product serviceability by addressing defects.
* Analyze customer data to enhance product reliability and mitigate risks.
* Foster partnerships with technology allies for issue resolution and ecosystem improvements.
* Mentor and guide junior team members, promoting a collaborative and growth-oriented team environment.
* Contribute to and expand knowledge bases, facilitating continuous improvement efforts.
* Champion customer needs by gathering feedback and advocating for product enhancements.
* Provide rotational support coverage during weekdays and off-hours as necessary.

**What You Will Bring**

* 3.5yrs-7 years of experience in Systems Reliability Engineering or similar roles.
* Strong expertise in troubleshooting Virtualization (preferably VMware ESXi), Networking (layer 2/3), Linux Systems.
* Proficient in both written and verbal communication for effective collaboration across teams.
* Experience resolving complex technical issues directly with customers.
* Degree in Engineering or Computer Science preferred.
* Customer-driven mindset with a focus on delivering high-quality support experiences.
* Familiarity with technologies from partners like VMware, Citrix, and Microsoft.
* Ability to develop tools and contribute to improving internal and external knowledge bases.

**Work Arrangement**
Hybrid: This role operates in a hybrid capacity, blending the benefits of remote work with the advantages of in-person collaboration. In locations where our workplace policy applies (i.e. San Jose, Durham, Mexico City, Bangalore, Pune, Hoofddorp, Belgrade, Barcelona, Singapore, Sydney and Tokyo), employees are expected to work onsite a minimum of 3 days per week to foster collaboration, team alignment, and access to in-office resources. Workplace type may vary based on location and team requirements. Please speak with your recruiter for details. Additional team-specific guidance and norms will be provided by your manager.

title: Manager, AI/HPC Infrastructure Technical Delivery — India
description:
Are you a technically seasoned leader with a passion for driving excellence in AI, HPC, and data center infrastructure delivery? Do you thrive in leading technical teams to build and deploy some of the world’s largest and fastest AI/HPC systems across the India region? At NVIDIA, we are revolutionizing deep learning, data analytics, and data center capabilities, and we are seeking a Senior Technical Delivery Manager (People Manager) to oversee a team of technical specialists—with end-to-end technical control over Ethernet, InfiniBand, HPC, and AI cluster delivery across APAC. This role requires a strong technical background in NVIDIA DC products (Networking, InfiniBand, AI orchestration tools), full-stack data center technologies (storage, server, networking, virtualization, GPU), and deep understanding of AI technology, paired with proven people management skills to lead a team of a few to dozens of technical professionals. Additionally, you are expected to have a solid grasp of the the region's business model, as well as experience engaging with the customers closely.
  
  
As a key leader in NVIDIA’s Infrastructure Specialist Team, you will serve as the Senior Technical Delivery Manager, owning people management for a team of Senior Networking (Eth/IB/AI/HPC) Solutions Architects and technical specialists, while providing overall technical control for all InfiniBand, HPC, and AI cluster delivery projects in the India and APAC region. You will balance team leadership, technical oversight, and customer-centric delivery—leveraging your understanding of the APAC business model and Chinese customer needs—to ensure alignment with NVIDIA’s strategic goals and maintain the highest standards of technical excellence and customer satisfaction. Your deep expertise in AI technology and full-stack DC technologies (storage, server, networking, virtualization, GPU) will be critical to guiding the team and delivering successful projects.
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing**

* Lead, manage, and develop a high-performing technical team (size: a few to dozens of members) of Senior Networking (ETH/IB) Solutions Architects and technical specialists, overseeing the full people management lifecycle—hiring, onboarding, performance management, career development, coaching, and retention—fostering a collaborative, technically driven team culture. Provide overall technical control for all InfiniBand, HPC, and AI cluster delivery projects in the region, ensuring technical excellence, adherence to NVIDIA DC product standards, and alignment with customer requirements.
* Oversee the design, deployment, and operational reliability of large-scale AI/HPC infrastructure for new and existing customers in India and APAC, with a focus on InfiniBand networking, HPC clusters, and AI orchestration tools (e.g., BCM - Base Command Manager).
* Lead technical decision-making for complex delivery projects, leveraging your deep understanding of AI technology and full-stack DC technologies (storage, server, networking, virtualization, GPU) to resolve critical technical challenges related to InfiniBand networks, data center architecture, network automation, and GPU-accelerated infrastructure.
* Drive continuous improvement in delivery processes, leveraging your deep technical expertise to optimize workflows for network provisioning, system design, automation, and post-deployment support (monitoring, logging, alerting).
* Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams (engineering, sales, product, support) to align technical delivery strategies with NVIDIA’s product roadmap, especially for NVIDIA DC products (networking, InfiniBand, AI orchestration tools).
* Build and maintain trusted relationships with key customers (including Chinese customers) and partners across India and APAC, leveraging your understanding of the India business model and bilingual communication skills to serve as the technical leadership point of contact for large-scale AI/HPC delivery projects and address strategic technical and business needs.
* Ensure the team adheres to technical best practices, compliance standards, and NVIDIA’s quality requirements, while driving accountability for project delivery timelines, budgets, and customer satisfaction.
* Monitor team performance, track project progress, and communicate technical delivery status, challenges, and solutions to senior leadership in a clear, data-driven manner.

**What We Need To See**

* BS/MS/PhD or equivalent professional experience in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, or a related technical field.
* 10+ years of progressive technical experience in data center infrastructure, or equivalent experience, and 5+ years of people management experience leading a technical team (size: 10 or more members).
* Strong technical background in NVIDIA DC products (networking solutions, InfiniBand, AI orchestration tools, e.g., BCM - Base Command Manager), GPU-accelerated infrastructure, and full-stack data center technologies including storage, server, networking, virtualization. Additionally, a deep understanding of AI technology and its integration with DC infrastructure is required.
* Deep expertise in networking fundamentals, TCP/IP stack, data center architecture, and InfiniBand networks—with hands-on experience in medium to large-scale HPC/AI environments.
* Demonstrated experience overseeing end-to-end technical delivery of large-scale AI/HPC infrastructure projects, with a focus on performance, reliability, and customer satisfaction.
* Strong people management skills: ability to lead, coach, and develop technical teams, foster collaboration, and drive accountability in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
* Excellent customer-facing and communication skills (verbal and written in both languages), enabling effective engagement with customers (including Chinese customers), partners, and cross-functional teams across the India region.
* A solid understanding of the India business model to address their unique technical and business requirements. Ability to support regional delivery needs and collaborate across time zones.
* Proven track record of resolving complex technical challenges and driving continuous improvement in technical delivery processes.
* Self-motivated, results-driven, and able to balance technical oversight with people management responsibilities.

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Linux or Networking Certifications (e.g., CCNP, CCIE, HCIE) or NVIDIA-related certifications.
* Extensive experience with HPC job schedulers (Slurm, PBS) and cluster management technologies (BCM - Base Command Manager is a strong plus).
* Experience leading technical teams in a professional services or tech vendor environment, with a focus on top CSP/Cloud/Hyper-Scale customers in the India.
* Deep understanding of AI/ML workloads, their integration with HPC/InfiniBand infrastructure, and full-stack DC technologies (storage, server, networking, virtualization, GPU)—with hands-on experience optimizing performance for GPU-accelerated systems.

title: Sr Principal - Data Protection and Cyber Recovery Engineer
description:
**About Northern Trust**
As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
  
  
Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
  
  
With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a Senior Data Resiliency Engineer to own the design, implementation, and assurance of our data protection and recovery capabilities across our hybrid cloud estate.
  
  
This is a high-trust, high-accountability role. Our backup infrastructure is not just an operational concern — it is a regulatory obligation, a cyber defense layer, and a core component of our operational resilience framework. You will be the subject matter expert who ensures our ability to recover is proven, not assumed, and that our posture satisfies the expectations of regulators including the FCA, PRA, and the requirements of DORA.
  
  
You will work in close partnership with Information Security, Technology Risk, Business Continuity, and SRE teams, and will interface directly with audit and regulatory processes.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
**Backup & Recovery Engineering**

* Architect, implement, and operate backup and restore solutions across on-premises data centers and cloud environments (AWS, Azure, and/or GCP), covering the full range of financial services workloads — core banking systems, trading platforms, payment processing, databases, and unstructured data.
* Define, own, and continuously validate RTO and RPO targets in alignment with Important Business Service (IBS) mapping and impact tolerances as required under the PRA/FCA operational resilience framework.
* Own backup policy governance — retention schedules, legal hold processes, data classification alignment, and lifecycle rules — ensuring consistency with data management and records retention obligations under GDPR and FCA COBS/SYSC requirements.
* Lead a structured restore testing programs including full DR failover, Business Service recovery exercises, clean-room scenario based recovery simulations, and immutable backup integrity validation — with evidence packages suitable for regulatory review.
* Own backup failure investigation and resolution end-to-end, conducting blameless post-incident reviews and feeding findings into the firm’s risk event process.

**Cyber Recovery & Resilience**

* Design and maintain air-gapped and immutable backup tiers as a core ransomware and cyber-attack recovery capability, aligned to the firm’s Cyber Recovery Plan and wider BCBS 239 / DORA ICT resilience obligations.
* Participate in adversarial recovery exercises and cyber simulation scenarios (e.g. ransomware tabletops, clean-room service restores under incident conditions) — providing technical leadership on recoverability.
* Maintain alignment with NIST CSF, ISO 27001, and DORA ICT risk management requirements as they apply to backup and recovery controls.
* Work with the Information Security team to ensure backup systems are hardened, access-controlled, and monitored for anomalous activity — treating backup infrastructure as a high-value target requiring its own threat model.
* Maintain audit trails and cryptographic integrity verification for backup data to support forensic and regulatory investigation requirements.

**Infrastructure as Code & Automation**

* Build and maintain all backup infrastructure using Terraform and supporting IaC tooling (Ansible, CloudFormation, or Pulumi where applicable), with all changes managed through version-controlled, peer-reviewed CI/CD pipelines.
* Automate restore validation workflows so recovery confidence is continuously measured, evidenced, and reportable — not dependent on manual spot checks.
* Manage Terraform state, module libraries, and environment promotion across non-prod and production estates within a change-controlled, audit-friendly delivery model.
* Contribute to shared platform engineering standards and champion IaC best practices across the wider infrastructure function.

**Hybrid Environment Ownership**

* Maintain deep expertise across both on-premises (Cohesity, Rubrik, NetApp SnapVault, Dell Data Domain, IBM Safeguarded Copy) and cloud-native (AWS Backup, Azure Backup, snapshot-based recovery, object storage immutability) paradigms.
* Design and manage data transfer, replication, and egress cost optimisation for hybrid backup flows, with particular attention to latency and bandwidth constraints on critical financial data paths.
* Ensure backup coverage extends to containerised workloads (Velero or equivalent) as the firm’s Kubernetes adoption grows.

**Governance, Compliance & Audit**

* Maintain a live and accurate backup estate inventory, coverage map, and gap register — with regular reporting to Technology Risk and the CTO organisation.
* Produce and own the Backup & Recovery Policy, associated standards, and operational runbooks, ensuring they are reviewed annually and remain aligned with regulatory expectations.
* Serve as the primary technical contact for internal audit, external audit (Big 4), and regulatory examination processes relating to backup, recovery, and operational resilience.
* Ensure the firm’s backup posture can satisfy requirements under DORA — including ICT risk management, resilience testing, and third-party backup vendor oversight obligations.
* Support Technology Risk in maintaining and evidencing compliance with SS2/21 (PRA operational resilience), PS6/21, FCA PS21/3, and relevant EBA/EIOPA guidelines as they touch recovery capabilities.
* Provide input to the firm’s ICAAP/ILAAP and recovery plan where ICT recoverability is a factor.

**Essential**
**What You’ll Bring**

* 15+ Years professional, 6+ years in infrastructure or platform engineering with a significant focus on backup, recovery, and data protection, with at least 3 years in a financial services or other regulated environment.
* Hands-on production Terraform experience — modules, remote state, workspaces, policy-as-code, and integration with enterprise CI/CD pipelines.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience across both on-premises infrastructure (VMware, Dell, Cohesity, Runrik, Commvault, NetApp, or equivalent) and at least one major cloud provider.
* Working knowledge of the UK/EU regulatory landscape for operational resilience and ICT risk — FCA/PRA SS2/21, DORA, BCBS 239, and their practical implications for backup and recovery.
* Deep understanding of cyber-resilient backup design: immutability, air-gap architecture, encryption, integrity verification, and ransomware recovery patterns.
* Proven experience designing, executing, and evidencing RTO/RPO validation and DR testing for audit and regulatory purposes.
* Strong scripting capability in Python, Bash, or PowerShell for automation, remediation, and tooling.

**Preferred**

* Direct experience with DORA ICT resilience testing requirements (TLPT) and how backup systems are scoped within them.
* Familiarity with cyber recovery frameworks — NIST CSF Recovery function, NCSC guidance on offline backups, SWIFT CSCF controls.
* Experience with Kubernetes workload backup (Velero or equivalent) in a financial services context.
* Exposure to regulatory examination processes — preparing evidence packs, responding to findings, and tracking remediation.
* Experience with data sovereignty, cross-border data transfer controls, and their implications for cloud backup architecture in a multi-jurisdiction financial institution.
* Relevant certifications: AWS/Azure backup and storage certifications, HashiCorp Terraform Associate or Professional, CISSP, CRISC, or ISO 22301 Lead Implementer.

**Behaviors & Ways of Working**

* Treats recoverability as a provable property, not a configuration setting — if it hasn’t been tested under realistic conditions, it doesn’t count.
* Communicates technical risk clearly and credibly to non-technical stakeholders including Risk, Compliance, and senior leadership.
* Comfortable operating in a high-governance environment where changes require documentation, approval, and audit trails.
* Raises standards through peer review, runbook quality, and enabling colleagues — not just personal output.
* Maintains discretion and professionalism when handling sensitive data, regulatory findings, and security incidents.

**Key Relationships**

* Technology Risk & Information Security — backup posture aligned to firm risk appetite and cyber recovery plan.
* Business Continuity & Operational Resilience — recovery capabilities mapped to Important Business Services.
* Internal & External Audit — evidence provision and finding remediation.
* Platform / SRE Teams — IaC standards, incident response, and day-2 operations.
* Third-party backup vendors — contract oversight, SLA assurance, and DORA third-party ICT risk obligations.

**Working with Us**
As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
  
  
Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.
  
  
**Reasonable Accommodation**
Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.
  
  
**About Our Pune Office**
The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.
  
  
Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
AI Security Consultant, Infrastructure
  
  
As an AI Security Senior Consultant specializing in Infrastructure in Deloitte Cyber's Cyber for AI practice, you will own technical workstreams that secure the cloud, network, container and model-serving foundations used to run generative AI and agentic workloads. You will combine client advisory with hands-on engineering, turning requirements into architectures, integrations and production controls. You will guide junior practitioners, lead demonstrations and help estimate delivery work.
  
  
Work you'll do
  
  
As an AI Security Senior Consultant on the Infrastructure team, you will be responsible for:
  
  

* Lead discovery and architecture analysis for managed AI services, self-hosted model stacks, cloud foundations, networks and operational tooling.
* Design and deploy secure AI landing zones and model-serving environments across AWS, Azure, Google Cloud or Kubernetes-based platforms.
* Lead implementation of network isolation, private access, egress controls, cluster security, secrets, artifact controls, IaC and policy enforcement.
* Engineer and review Kubernetes and model-serving patterns for tenant isolation, GPU workloads, autoscaling, resilience and controlled enterprise integration.
* Plan and execute platform security, resilience and operational testing, diagnose complex failures, and drive issues through resolution.
* Own an infrastructure workstream, manage dependencies and milestones, and provide day-to-day guidance to consultants.
* Lead technical demonstrations and prototypes, and contribute architecture, effort and estimation inputs to pursuits.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:
  
  

* Ability to independently lead a technical workstream and manage priorities, dependencies and delivery commitments.
* Clear communication of architecture decisions, technical tradeoffs, risks and implementation status to engineering and business stakeholders.
* Ability to guide consultants, review technical work and create a collaborative delivery environment.
* Strong demonstration and technical storytelling skills for workshops, prototypes and client readouts.

The team
  
  
Deloitte Cyber's Cyber for AI practice helps organizations secure generative AI and agentic systems from design through production. The team brings together AI engineering and cyber skills across identity, data, infrastructure, application security and operations.
  
  
We work with clients to make security controls part of the platform and delivery lifecycle, so teams can move from experiments to production without creating unmanaged access, data or infrastructure risk.
  
  
Within the practice, the Infrastructure capability focuses on secure AI landing zones, cloud and network architecture, container and model-serving platforms, policy automation and observability.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Cybersecurity or a related field; alternatively, equivalent demonstrated experience.
* 4+ years of combined cybersecurity and AI engineering experience, including hands-on production work in both domains.
* Hands-on experience designing, integrating and securing production generative AI, RAG or agentic workloads, including model, tool and enterprise data connections.
* Hands-on depth in AWS, Azure or Google Cloud, with working knowledge of infrastructure security patterns in the other major cloud platforms.

* Strong knowledge of network segmentation, private connectivity, egress controls, DNS, TLS, firewalls, gateways, service meshes and enterprise integration patterns.
* Implementation experience with Terraform or comparable IaC, CI/CD pipelines, policy-as-code, Kubernetes RBAC, network policies, admission controls and secrets.
* Ability to design, build and review infrastructure automation using Python, Go, Bash, PowerShell or a comparable language, together with HCL or YAML, Git and CI/CD tooling.
* Ability to travel 25% to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and engagements you serve.

Preferred:
  
  

* Previous consulting, client delivery or customer-facing engineering experience.
* Experience across both managed AI services and self-hosted or open-weight AI platforms.
* Experience with AI threat modeling, red teaming, security evaluations, secure AI development practices or AI-specific monitoring.
* Experience developing reusable technical assets, guiding junior engineers or contributing to engineering standards.
* Familiarity with the broader machine learning lifecycle and frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow or MLflow.
* Experience with AI platforms and model-serving technologies such as Amazon Bedrock, Bedrock AgentCore or SageMaker AI; Microsoft Foundry or Azure Machine Learning; Google Vertex AI; vLLM; KServe; NVIDIA Triton or NIM; Ray Serve; or comparable platforms.

description:
Join Barclays as a Network Engineering Security role, where to build and maintain infrastructure platforms and products that support applications and data systems, using hardware, software, networks, and cloud computing platforms as required with the aim of ensuring that the infrastructure is reliable, scalable, and secure. At Barclays, we don't just anticipate the future - we're creating it.
  
  
**To be successful in this role, you should have below skills:**

* Network engineering activities (which covers design , testing and certification, upgrades and Vulnerability management activities in lab and support in Prod )

**Purpose of the role**
To build and maintain infrastructure platforms and products that support applications and data systems, using hardware, software, networks, and cloud computing platforms as required with the aim of ensuring that the infrastructure is reliable, scalable, and secure. Ensure the reliability, availability, and scalability of the systems, platforms, and technology through the application of software engineering techniques, automation, and best practices in incident response.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

Including the identification of the appropriate technologies and solutions to meet business, optimisation, and resourcing requirements.

* Automation: Development and implementation of automated tasks and processes to improve efficiency and reduce manual intervention, utilising software scripting/coding disciplines.
* Security: Implementation of a secure configuration and measures to protect infrastructure against cyber-attacks, vulnerabilities, and other security threats, including protection of hardware, software, and data from unauthorised access.
* Teamwork: Cross-functional collaboration with product managers, architects, and other engineers to define IT Infrastructure requirements, devise solutions, and ensure seamless integration and alignment with business objectives via a data driven approach.

title: Consulting Engineer - Security
description:
**Security Senior Consulting Engineer for Americas Time Zone**
**Meet the Team**
The Customer Experience (CX) team is a group of outstanding technical experts to delivering an outstanding customer experience. We tackle the toughest business challenges with network-centric solutions that accelerate customer success and dedication. Our success is reflected in our outstanding financial results, industry recognition, and high employee satisfaction. As the face of Cisco, our CX teams are the primary drivers of digital transformation. Within CX, the Global CX Centers serve as the engine for this transformation, providing flexible, innovative, and highly technical resources to support customer engagements across all theaters. We act as a seamless delivery partner, ensuring our customers achieve their business goals through flawless execution.
  
  
**Who You Are**
We need a team player and natural leader and innovator that can drive improved customer experiences with products, technologies, and solutions by demonstrating Consultative and technical excellence, collaboration, and ownership in all aspects of customer delivery deployments. Focus should be on complex, interdependent, highly visible customer issues that have broad impact. Serve as a cross-functional technical advisor by applying depth and breadth of knowledge to drive customer success.
  
  
**Your Impact**
As a Cisco Network Consulting Security Engineer, you will translate business requirements into technical solutions and design, implement, and manage enterprise security solutions, with a focus on Cisco ISE. You will provide architecture and consulting expertise across customer projects, ensuring alignment with security, compliance, and business objectives. You will lead and guide teams delivering Architecture & Consulting Services, owning key deliverables such as design documents, migration plans, MoPs, test plans, and campus network best-practice recommendations. You will facilitate design workshops, provide customer consultancy, and ensure successful delivery against expectations. You will collaborate with customers, SMEs, project managers, account teams, and Product & Services Sales and Systems/Consulting Engineers to solve complex technology challenges. You will drive process optimization, automation, thought leadership, customer outcomes, and continuous improvement across the practice.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Architect, design, deploy, and manage enterprise-level Cisco security solutions, including firewalls, web and email security, VPNs, access control.
* Conduct thorough network security assessments, vulnerability analysis, to identify weaknesses and propose solutions.
* Configure, administer, and optimize Cisco Secure Firewall ASA and Firepower (FTD) firewalls, including Secure Firewall Management Center (FMC), for perimeter defense, data center segmentation, VPN enforcement, and secure segmentation.
* Implement and maintain robust security protocols and measures, including Access Control Lists (ACLs), Network Address Translation (NAT), Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), and Intrusion Prevention Systems (IPS).
* Develop, document, and enforce network security policies, procedures, and standards in compliance with industry best practices and regulatory requirements (e.g., NIST, PCI, DoD STIGs).
* Deploy and manage Network Access Control (NAC) solutions, specifically Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE), for 802.1X authentication, profiling, posture assessments, and policy enforcement across wired, wireless, and data center environments. Including but not limited to Guest Services, Trustsec, pxGrid and 3rd party integrations.
* Troubleshoot complex network, security, and data center incidents, performing root cause analysis and implementing corrective measures to restore services swiftly and prevent future occurrences.
* Design, implement, and enforce security policies with Secure Access, including but not limited to VPN as a Service, Zero Trust Network Access, Secure Web Gateway, Cloud Access Security Broker, Data Loss Prevention, Firewall as a Service with IPS, Cloud Secure Malware Analytics, DNS-layer security, Secure Internet Access, Secure Private Access and Umbrella.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field & A minimum of 8-10 years of experience in network and security engineering with a strong focus on network security, firewalls and Network Access.
* Active professional/expert-level certifications such as CCNP Security, CCIE Security or CCIE Enterprise or CCIE Data Center are highly preferred.
* Other valuable certifications include ITIL Foundational, CISSP, Palo Alto PCNSE, or CompTIA Security+.
* Expert-level knowledge of Cisco routing and switching technologies and protocols (BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, MPLS, VLANs, STP).
* Strong understanding of security principles, including IDS/IPS, VPN (IPsec, SSL), encryption protocols, and endpoint security.
* Experience with network monitoring, packet capture analysis (e.g., Wireshark, tcpdump), and SIEM tools.

**Shift Requirement**

* Must be willing to work in a swing shift to support customers across the Americas (AMER) region

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Familiarity with network automation tools, scripting languages such as Python and Ansible, and AI agents is a plus.
* Knowledge of cloud networking concepts and hybrid cloud architectures, including AWS and Azure.
* Ability to lead and mentor security network engineers, provide technical guidance, and foster a culture of continuous learning and professional development.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with excellent attention to detail.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
* Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and drive initiatives effectively.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
  
  
**Disclaimer**
**About**
To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:
  
  

* be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
* begin with screening or an interview
* originate from a Cisco email address, and
* be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other than https://careers.cisco.com or cisco.wd5.myworkday.com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport.
  
  
If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.

title: Network Delivery Engineer 1
description:
PhonePe Limited (Formerly PhonePe Private Limited) is a technology company that builds digital platforms for Payments, Digital Distribution Services and Financial Services. Headquartered in India, the PhonePe digital payments app was launched in 2016. As of April 2026, PhonePe has over 70 Crore life-till-date registered users and a digital payments acceptance network spread across over 5 Crore merchants. PhonePe’s products and services include Consumer Payments (including Digital Distribution Services), Merchant Payments, Lending and Insurance Distribution services, and New Platforms, which comprise Share.Market (stock broking and mutual funds distribution platform), and Indus Appstore (Android-based mobile app marketplace). At PhonePe, we go the extra mile to make sure you can bring your best self to work, Everyday!. And that starts with creating the right environment for you. We empower people and trust them to do the right thing. Here, you own your work from start to finish, right from day one. PhonePe-rs solve complex problems and execute quickly; often building frameworks from scratch. If you’re excited by the idea of building platforms that touch millions, ideating with some of the best minds in the country and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us!
  
  
**Job Description**
As a Network Delivery Engineer, you will be responsible for the execution of network provisioning tasks and 24/7 continuous monitoring, initial troubleshooting, and escalation of network infrastructure and service incidents. This role requires strong problem-solving skills, a foundational understanding of networking concepts, and the ability to work effectively under pressure in a fast-paced environment to ensure maximum network uptime and performance.
  
  
**Experience bucket: 1-3 years**
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Handling BAU tasks:
* Conduct network provisioning deployments.
* Perform Firewall configuration which includes ACL management, Periodic Firewall reviews and IPSec/NAT.
* Perform periodic Patch Management for Network switches/firewalls and servers.
* Upgrade OS for network devices to maintain a stable environment.
* Undertake network maintenance activities during business off-peak hours.
* Performance Optimization:
* Conduct performance analysis and implement optimizations to ensure the network operates at peak efficiency.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to fine-tune network parameters and troubleshoot performance bottlenecks.
* Network Automation:
* Develop and implement automation scripts to streamline routine network tasks and enhance operational efficiency.
* Integrate automation tools and frameworks to support network provisioning, monitoring, and management.
* Incident Response and Resolution:
* Act as a primary on-call engineer in resolving complex network incidents and outages and file RCAs wherever applicable.
* Function as L1 point of escalation for Network Operations.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor Engineering in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
* 1-3 years of experience in network operations, network engineering or a related role.
* Familiarity with Data Center topologies and network routing and switching concepts like BGP, OSPF, VLAN, VRRP, etc. Knowledge of VxLAN will be an added advantage
* Basic scripting and automation skills, with entry-level proficiency in languages like Python, Go, Shell and orchestration tools like Ansible, Salt or similar.
* Basic fundamental knowledge of Linux esp. Distributions like Ubuntu and RHEL and web-servers like Nginx and Apache2.
* Experience in a 24x7 on-call rotation environment and in handling critical incidents.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
* Excellent leadership and communication skills.
* Certifications/Course Completion for Cisco CCNA/Juniper JNCIA or equivalent would be an added advantage.

Join our team and be a key contributor to the success and innovation of our data center network infrastructure.
