title: Staff Consulting Architect
description:
**Hungry, Humble, Honest, with Heart.**
**The Opportunity**
Are you a seasoned professional with strong hands-on expertise in virtualization, SDN, and network security, complemented by excellent consulting and communication skills? If so, you’ll thrive in our collaborative environment where you’ll lead the design and implementation of cutting-edge data center and hybrid cloud solutions, make a significant impact on our clients' success, and advance your career as part of a dynamic team at Nutanix.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Staff Consulting Architect will be a vital member of Nutanix's Professional Services team, which is dedicated to delivering innovative virtualization, software-defined networking (SDN), and network security solutions to our clients. This team operates from Bangalore or Pune and fosters a collaborative and inclusive culture that values creativity and knowledge sharing. The mission of the team is to empower organizations with next-generation data center and hybrid cloud environments that enhance performance, security, and scalability.
  
  
You will report to the Director of Professional Services, who promotes a supportive and mentoring leadership style, focusing on empowering team members to achieve their full potential and encouraging a strong sense of collaboration. The role is hybrid, requiring the employee to come into the office three days a week, fostering teamwork and facilitating knowledge exchange while allowing flexibility for remote work.
  
  
Nutanix is seeking a
**Staff Consulting Architect**
specializing in
**virtualization, software-defined networking (SDN), and network security**
to design, implement, and optimize next-generation data centre and hybrid cloud environments.
  
  
The ideal candidate will possess
**strong hands-on expertise in hypervisors (VMware / AHV)**
and a
**deep understanding of network virtualization and microsegmentation concepts.**
While certain specialized or automation-related areas can be developed through internal enablement programs, strong fundamentals in virtualization and SDN are mandatory.
  
  
**Your Role**

* Architecture & Design
* Lead the design and deployment of SDN solutions including:

+ Virtual networks, overlays (Geneve / VXLAN), logical switches and routers.
+ Network Controllers / Managers for centralized control and automation.
+ VPCs or logical segments for tenant isolation and scalability.
+ Gateways, VPNs, and BGP configurations for hybrid connectivity.

* Architect multi-tier microsegmentation strategies and enforce Zero Trust principles.
* Collaborate with enterprise network and security teams for seamless integration between virtual and physical infrastructures.
* Implementation & Delivery
* Configure SDN controllers, edge gateways, and security policies in production environments.
* Enable L2 extensions, VPN tunnels, and BGP sessions across sites or clouds.
* Implement application-centric security and isolation policies for East-West and North-South traffic control.
* Support workload and network migrations between virtualization platforms with minimal downtime.
* Integrate network visibility and flow analytics into compliance systems.
* Security & Policy Management
* Define and enforce microsegmentation and application security frameworks.
* Manage security groups, categories, or tags for dynamic policy application.
* Configure allowlist / denylist rules and quarantine mechanisms.
* Ensure compliance with enterprise standards; integrate with SIEM / Syslog for auditability.
* Platform & Virtualization Management
* Manage and optimize virtualization platforms (VMware vSphere / Nutanix AHV / equivalent).
* Administer orchestration and lifecycle management using Prism Central, vCenter, or similar tools.
* Support hybrid cloud network architectures spanning on-premises and public cloud environments.
* Collaborate with compute and storage teams to ensure end-to-end performance.
* Troubleshooting & Optimization
* Diagnose and resolve issues related to network overlays, routing, and policy enforcement.
* Utilize CLI tools, REST APIs, or automation scripts for diagnostics and configuration management.
* Perform performance tuning and maintain high availability of network services.

**What You Will Bring**
**Mandatory Skills (Must-Have)**

* 10+ years of experience in data centre virtualization and SDN solutions.
* Strong understanding of networking concepts — VLANs, routing, NAT, VPNs, BGP, firewalls, overlays (VXLAN/Geneve).
* Hands-on experience with at least one SDN platform:

+ VMware NSX / Nutanix Flow / Cisco ACI (or equivalent).

* Proven expertise in microsegmentation and Zero Trust architecture design.
* Working knowledge of any one hypervisor (VMware ESXi, Nutanix AHV, or Hyper-V).
* Experience integrating virtual and physical network infrastructures.
* Strong troubleshooting skills using CLI / API / network analysis tools.
* Excellent consulting, customer engagement, and communication skills.
* Ability to translate business requirements into scalable technical architectures.

**Trainable / Developable Skills**
*(These can be built on-the-job or via internal learning programs)*

* Automation and scripting using REST APIs, PowerShell, or Python.
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC) with Terraform or Ansible.
* Exposure to hybrid or multi-cloud networking (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Integration of flow analytics and visibility tools for monitoring and compliance.
* Performance tuning and advanced SDN optimization techniques.
* Mentoring, workshop facilitation, and leadership in technical communities.

**Soft Skills**

* Strong consulting and stakeholder management abilities.
* Excellent documentation and presentation skills.
* Team mentorship and ability to guide junior consultants.
* Structured approach to problem-solving and decision-making.

**Education & Certifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent discipline.
* Preferred Certifications (VCP-NV, VCAP-NV, CCNP Data Centre, Nutanix NCP).

**Location**

* Pune/Bangalore (Work from Office).
* Travel as required for customer assignments.

description:
Job description:
  
  
Job Description

Connect Direct-JD

Location-Pune, Hyderabad, Bangalore

Key responsibilities

Platform engineering & SME ownership

● Act as the technical SME for IBM Connect:Direct (CD) across build, run, and change.

● Lead installations, configurations, upgrades, patching, migrations, and platform enhancements .

● Maintain platform standards: configuration baselines, naming conventions, certificate/key management approach, and operational runbooks.

● Drive capacity planning, performance tuning, and resilience improvements.

Operations, incident/problem management

● Provide L2/L3 support for production issues: triage, root cause analysis, and permanent fixes.

● Troubleshoot end-to-end MFT flows including process definitions, scheduling, connectivity, authentication, encryption, and partner onboarding.

● Improve monitoring/alerting and reduce repeat incidents through automation and problem management.

Automation & DevOps enablement

● Build and maintain automation using Ansible, Jenkins, and GitHub (CI/CD for configuration, deployments, and repeatable changes).

● Develop and maintain Bash/Python scripts for operational tasks (log parsing, housekeeping, certificate checks, health checks, reporting).

Observability & performance

● Implement and enhance monitoring using Splunk (dashboards, alerts, correlation searches) and AppDynamics (application performance insights where relevant).

● Monitoring system healthiness (availability, transfer success rate, latency, queue depth, error rates).

Infrastructure, network & security collaboration

● Partner with network/infrastructure/security teams on firewall rules, routing, DNS, load balancers, TLS/certificates, vulnerability remediation, and access controls.

● Ensure secure configuration aligned to enterprise security expectations (encryption in transit/at rest, least privilege, audit logging).

Cross-platform support

● Provide support across Linux and Windows Server environments, including service/process management, troubleshooting, and patch coordination.

Required skills & experience

● ~8 years of hands-on experience in enterprise middleware / managed file transfer / platform engineering.

● Strong experience with IBM Connect:Direct:

Installation, configuration, upgrades/patching, process configuration, troubleshooting, performance tuning.

● Strong Linux administration skills:

Service/process management, file permissions, networking basics, log analysis, troubleshooting.

● Scripting skills in Bash and/or Python for automation and operational tooling.

● Experience with Ansible, Jenkins, and GitHub in a DevOps delivery model.

● Working knowledge of Splunk (search, dashboards, alerting) and AppDynamics (usage for diagnostics/monitoring).

● Solid understanding of networking and security concepts (TLS, certificates, ports, firewalls, authentication/authorisation).

● Experience supporting Windows Server environments.

Qualifications

● Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

● Relevant IBM product certifications are a plus (Connect:Direct).

with DevOps and Engineering teams to embed platform standards into delivery pipelinesPartner with SecOps to integrate all controls and security requirementsDocument everything: blueprints, ADRs, description: ZS is a place where passion changes lives. As a management consulting and technology firm focused on improving life and how we live it, we transform ideas into impact by bringing together data, science, technology and human ingenuity to deliver better outcomes for all. Here you’ll work side-by-side with a powerful collective of thinkers and experts shaping life-changing solutions for patients, caregivers and consumers, worldwide. Implement best practices for cluster management, including lifecycle management, scaling, patching, and ensuring high availability. Containerization: Utilize Docker and helm to containerize applications, ensuring consistency across development, testing, and production environments. Develop and maintain Docker files and Docker Compose configurations for multi-container applications. Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Develop and manage infrastructure as code (IaC) using Terraform to automate the provisioning and management of AWS resources. Ensure modularity, reusability, and version controlled Terraform configurations to enable efficient infrastructure deployment. AWS Infrastructure Architecture: Architect scalable, resilient, and cost-effective infrastructure solutions on AWS. Design and implement AWS services such as EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, VPC, IAM, and CloudFormation to support application workloads and services. CI/CD Pipeline Implementation: Design and implement continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines using tools like Jenkins, GitLab CI, or AWS Code Pipeline. Automate build, testing, and deployment processes for seamless application delivery. Terraform & CI/CD Integration: Integrate Terraform into CI/CD pipelines to automate the deployment and configuration of infrastructure alongside application deployment. Centralized Logging & Analysis: Configure centralized logging solutions like AWS CloudWatch Logs, the ELK stack, or Splunk to aggregate, analyze, and visualize logs across distributed systems for troubleshooting and insights. Safeguard infrastructure using encryption, IAM roles/policies, security groups, and other AWS security services to maintain least privilege access. Cost Optimization & Resource Management: Continuously optimize AWS resources to maximize cost-efficiency. Leverage auto-scaling capabilities, right-size resources, and use AWS Cost Explorer and other management tools to monitor usage and reduce cloud expenses. Cloud Governance: Ensure adherence to best practices in cloud governance, ensuring security, reliability, and compliance across AWS environments. Regularly audit resources and configurations to avoid potential risks. What You’ll Bring:ZS welcomes candidates with degrees in computer science, information technology or a related discipline. A demonstrated record of success and significant programming experience are required. Additionally, we seek individuals with the following qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field. 3+ years of experience of working as a DevOps Engineer with a focus on AWS cloud platform. Strong proficiency in Kubernetes and secondary skills in Terraform for infrastructure provisioning and management. In-depth knowledge of AWS services and their configuration, including EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, VPC, IAM, and CloudFormation. Experience with CI/CD pipelines and tools like Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, or AWS CodePipeline. Expertise with containerization technologies such as Docker and helm. Solid understanding of networking concepts, security principles, and best practices in AWS environments. Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills with the ability to debug complex issues in cloud infrastructure. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a cross-functional team environment. Comfortable working in rotational shiftsAbility to quickly learn new platforms, languages, tools, and techniques as needed to meet project requirements. Self-motivated and directed, with strong attention to detail. Certification on Terraform / AWS certified is a plus.Fluency in EnglishClient-first mentality Intense work ethicCollobarative spirit and problem solving approach. title: Senior Software Solutions Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Senior Software Solutions Engineer to support NVIDIA AI Enterprise customers and deployments across cloud and datacenter environments. This is a dual role: (1) Support, triage and resolve complex customer software issues end-to-end, and (2) build software features, automation, diagnostics, reproducible test cases, and deployment tooling—to improve product readiness and scale support across enterprise environments.
  
  
You will work across compute and cloud-native technologies in CSP environments, including container platforms/orchestrators, enterprise system software, and GPU-accelerated AI frameworks and inference services used to run production AI workloads at scale. In this customer-facing role, you will work closely with customers and internal engineering teams to understand issues, explain root causes, drive resolution, and collaborate on fixes and improvements. Success in this role requires strong debugging skills, crisp communication, and ownership of technically deep escalations from inception to closure.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Develop and maintain product-facing features and deployment assets for AI Enterprise supportability (e.g., scripts, configuration guidance, Kubernetes manifests/Helm charts, and reproducible test cases)
* Develop and maintain Python-based tooling/automation (validators, log collectors, repro harnesses) to improve NVIDIA AI Enterprise deployment reliability across NGC and container orchestrators (e.g., Kubernetes)
* Contribute code-level fixes, patches, or pull requests (as appropriate) in collaboration with engineering to address customer-impacting issues and improve product readiness
* Support enterprise customers deploying NVIDIA AI Enterprise in datacenter and CSP environments, including Kubernetes-based and containerized production AI platforms
* Take ownership of customer issues from inception to resolution: reproduce in lab/cloud, collect diagnostics, provide mitigations, and partner with engineering on fixes
* Create high-quality bug reports and RFEs with clear repro steps, environment details (CSP/Kubernetes/GPU), impact analysis, and supporting artifacts
* Develop customer-facing and internal documentation (KBs, runbooks, deployment guidance) to improve time-to-value and reduce recurring issues
* Be on call one weekend per month in the event a customer has a Sev1 outage and requires engineering assistance

**What We Need To See**

* BS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience)
* 5+ years system software development and troubleshooting experience, ideally with some customer facing
* Strong computer science fundamentals and programming/scripting skills (Python required; Bash; Go/C++ a plus) to automate investigations and build diagnostics/repro tools
* Strong troubleshooting fundamentals (networking, concurrency, OS concepts) and a structured approach to isolating issues across application, platform, and infrastructure layers
* Deep understanding of at least two of the following: data centers/servers, distributed systems, virtualization, deep learning frameworks, containers (Docker/Kubernetes), hybrid cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), and CI/CD for reliable deployments
* Familiarity with GPU-accelerated AI/ML stacks and production model deployment/serving (e.g., NGC containers, CUDA/tooling concepts, inference serving such as Triton or similar)
* Deep Linux knowledge and comfort troubleshooting in production Linux environments; working knowledge of Windows is a plus
* Professional-level communication skills, interpersonal skills with a passion to solve problems

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Hands-on experience deploying and operating NVIDIA AI Enterprise components in production across on-prem or CSP environments
* Hands-on experience using AI coding assistants/tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, or similar) to accelerate debugging, automation, and test creation
* Experience operating Kubernetes-based platforms in production (cluster operations, upgrades, control-plane/data-plane failure modes)
* Strong performance debugging skills for GPU and cloud workloads (profiling, latency/throughput tuning) and familiarity with observability/tracing tools

title: Senior Enterprise Operations Engineer-1
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Senior Enterprise Operations Engineer-1
  
  
**Job Description**
L2 Cloud Operations Engineer – Role Description
  
  
Two shifts - Sun to Wed 06:30 am to 06:30 pm with Sun alternate
  
  
Thurs to Sun 06:30 am to 06:30 pm with Sun alternate
  
  
We are seeking a highly skilled L2 Cloud Operations Engineer to operate, scale, and continuously improve enterprise-grade multi-cloud platforms. This role combines expertise in cloud engineering, DevOps, SRE, automation, CI/CD troubleshooting, observability, security operations, and AIOps-driven incident management.
  
  
You will be responsible for ensuring complex incident resolution, platform reliability, DevOps enablement, Kubernetes operations, automation, and operational excellence across AWS, Azure, and hybrid environments.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Cloud Operations & Platform Reliability (SRE Focus)
* Take ownership of production cloud platform stability, availability, performance, and reliability.
* Lead complex incident triage, deep troubleshooting, and resolution across cloud and container platforms.
* Implement SRE best practices such as SLIs, SLOs, SLAs, error budgets, and resilience engineering.
* Drive root cause analysis (RCA) and eliminate recurring failures through engineering solutions.
* CI/CD Pipeline Support & DevOps Enablement
* Provide advanced troubleshooting for CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps, AWS CodePipeline).
* Diagnose and resolve pipeline failures related to infrastructure, container builds, artifact storage, security scanning, and deployment orchestration.
* Enable self-service pipelines, progressive delivery, canary deployments, and rollback automation.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to improve deployment velocity, quality, and reliability.
* Multi-Cloud Engineering & Kubernetes Operations
* Operate and support large-scale AWS, Azure, and hybrid cloud platforms.
* Perform advanced Kubernetes operations including:
* Cluster management
* Node scaling
* Networking troubleshooting
* Pod failures
* Storage & ingress debugging
* Manage cloud networking, compute, storage, IAM, load balancing, and security services.
* Observability, AIOps & Intelligent Operations
* Operate and enhance enterprise observability platforms across metrics, logs, traces, and events.
* Implement AIOps-driven alert correlation, noise reduction, anomaly detection, and predictive analytics.
* Build automated remediation workflows and self-healing systems.
* Drive MTTR reduction through automation-first operations.
* Security Operations & DevSecOps
* Provide cloud security incident triage and remediation.
* Implement DevSecOps automation for vulnerability scanning, compliance checks, and policy enforcement.
* Support cloud security posture management (CSPM), IAM governance, secrets management, and certificate lifecycle management.
* Automation, Infrastructure as Code & Engineering Excellence
* Build and maintain infrastructure as code (IaC) using Terraform, CloudFormation, ARM, and Bicep.
* Develop automation scripts and tools using Python, Bash, PowerShell, and Go.
* Implement event-driven automation and auto-healing frameworks.
* ITSM, Incident, Change & Problem Management
* Serve as the technical escalation point for L1 teams.
* Lead incident management, problem management, and change governance using ITIL best practices.
* Maintain high-quality SOPs, runbooks, and knowledge articles.

**Mandatory Qualifications & Certifications (Strict Requirement)**
Candidates must hold at least two of the following certifications:
  
  

* Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA)
* AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate
* AWS DevOps Engineer – Professional / SysOps Administrator – Associate
* Microsoft Azure Solutions Architect Expert
* Azure DevOps Engineer Expert

Candidates without minimum two active certifications will not be considered.
  
  
**Required Technical Skills**
Cloud & Platform
  
  

* AWS: EC2, EKS, VPC, IAM, ALB/NLB, S3, RDS, CloudWatch, Lambda
* Azure: AKS, VNET, IAM (Entra), Load Balancer, App Services, Monitor
* Multi-cloud architecture & operations

Kubernetes & Containers
  
  

* Kubernetes (EKS, AKS, OpenShift)
* Helm, Kustomize, ArgoCD, Flux
* Docker, container build pipelines
* Service mesh (Istio / Linkerd – good to have)

CI/CD & DevOps Toolchain
  
  

* Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps
* Terraform, CloudFormation, ARM/Bicep
* Artifact management: Nexus, Artifactory
* GitOps workflows

Observability & AIOps
  
  

* Dynatrace, Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, ELK
* Event correlation, anomaly detection, predictive analytics
* AIOps platforms & auto-remediation frameworks

Security & Compliance
  
  

* IAM, secrets management, PKI & certificates
* CSPM: Prisma Cloud, Wiz, Defender
* Security incident response
* Vulnerability scanning & remediation

Scripting & Automation
  
  

* Python, Bash, PowerShell, Go (any two)
* REST APIs, event-driven automation
* Serverless automation workflows

SRE & Operational Excellence Skills
  
  

* SLIs, SLOs, SLAs
* Error budgets
* Chaos engineering
* Capacity planning & forecasting
* Performance engineering

Behavioral & Leadership Skills
  
  

* Strong problem-solving mindset
* Excellent troubleshooting skills
* High ownership & accountability
* Stakeholder communication
* Ability to work in 24x7 global operations model

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

Technical Leadership & Influence Mentor engineers and architects across the IDE community. Publish white papers, architectural patterns, and reference designs. Required Skills & Experience :Cloud & Infrastructure Deep expertise in AWS, Azure, Kubernetes, Hybrid Cloud, Networking, Compute, Storage, AI , System Architecture, Service Oriented Architecture, Cloud Security, Cloud Services , IT Infrastructure .Proven experience designing large-scale, resilient, secure enterprise platforms.

* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and

* Lead technical response on Severity 1/2 security and PulseAI platform incidents until management command engages; own the SLA status cadence (hourly / every 30 minutes on Severity 1\) to customer authorised contacts; hand infrastructure\-side events (network fabric, GPU hardware, storage) to the Network Operations Consultant and stay engaged on cross\-domain incidents.
* Own root cause analysis for PulseAI platform and OpenShift cluster incidents; reproduce and characterise platform defects and route them to Gruve PulseAI product engineering; own the corrective\-action backlog and problem management to eliminate recurring incidents.
* Own the PulseAI platform operations practice: severity classification standards, diagnostic runbooks for the PulseAI and OpenShift layers (control plane, operators, authentication/SSO, RBAC, tenancy and quota enforcement, model\-serving endpoints, observability), Grafana observability standards, alert thresholds for the SLA appendix, and the monitor / remediate / escalate matrix as applied per customer.
* Lead OpenShift cluster lifecycle operations for PulseAI customers — y\-stream upgrades on customer approval within the agreed window of the Red Hat release, operator and platform\-component changes, emergency vulnerability remediation of the cluster and platform — enforcing the pre\-change backup gate, and coordinating node\-pool, GPU driver/firmware and fabric changes with the Network Operations Consultant.
* Own Kubernetes/OpenShift security operations for the engagement: onboarding kube\-audit and workload telemetry into the SIEM, detection content for container attack paths (MITRE ATT\&CK for Containers), Cilium/Hubble and OVN\-Kubernetes flow use cases, admission\-control and image/runtime security posture, and RBAC / service\-account hygiene reviews.
* Act as vendor engineering liaison for the platform stack: Red Hat for OpenShift product defects, NVIDIA for GPU Operator / driver / NVIDIA AI Enterprise (NIM) software issues, and the third\-party platform variant (Rafay, vCluster, vNode, NVIDIA Run:ai, Red Hat OpenShift AI) where restoration is best\-effort with committed vendor escalation.
* Lead customer onboarding technically for the platform layer: deploy and validate OpenShift and PulseAI within the 14\-day Ready\-for\-Install window, configure identity provider federation and initial tenancy structure, onboard the platform to monitoring via the agreed connectivity pattern (outbound collector, site\-to\-site VPN or jump host with just\-in\-time elevation), and complete the platform sections of the countersigned environment validation checklist.
* Own the detection\-content backlog and tuning program; own log\-pipeline integration health with escalation into engineering.
* Approve and execute high\-risk security and platform changes; cross\-train the SOC L1/L2 bench on Kubernetes/OpenShift platform operations; drive shift\-quality audits and post\-incident reviews for the SOC pod.


**Mandatory Qualifications**
* 8–11 years with prior senior/lead experience in SOC or 24×7 platform operations and genuine security\-to\-platform cross\-domain fluency.
* Incident command capability; deep SIEM content and query skills.
* Strong Kubernetes/GKE security operations depth — onboarding kube\-audit and workload telemetry, building detection content for container attack paths (MITRE ATT\&CK for Containers), and tuning Cilium/Hubble\-based use cases.
* Deep Red Hat OpenShift / Kubernetes operations experience in production — multi\-node cluster administration, operators, y/z\-stream upgrades, RBAC, storage and networking, observability stack (Grafana, metrics, logs, alerting), backup/restore of cluster and platform state — with a track record of platform diagnostics and RCA.
* GPU\-cluster platform operations experience: NVIDIA GPU Operator/driver lifecycle, NVIDIA AI Enterprise components (NIM), DCGM\-class telemetry, node health and capacity management for AI inference workloads on RTX PRO 6000 / HGX B300\-class servers or equivalent.
* Experience operating against contractual SLAs (acknowledgement, restoration, availability, service credits) and running vendor engineering escalations through to fix.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Red Hat certifications (EX280 / EX380 / RHCE); exposure to Rafay, vCluster, NVIDIA Run:ai or Red Hat OpenShift AI; MLOps or AI\-platform operations (model\-serving endpoints, GPU scheduling, quota governance).

title: Senior Technical Lead – Industrial networking and motor control software
description:
Senior Technical Lead – Industrial Networking and Motor Control Software
   

  

**Senior Technical Lead – Industrial Networking and Motor Control Software**
**Pune / Bangalore – India**
*Join the RISC\-V Revolution!*
**About GlobalFoundries**
 GlobalFoundries is a leading full\-service semiconductor foundry providing a unique combination of design, development, and fabrication services to some of the world’s most inspired technology companies. With a global manufacturing footprint spanning three continents, GlobalFoundries make possible the technologies and systems that transform industries and give customers the power to shape their markets. For more information, visit www.gf.com.
   

  

 Introduction
   

  

 We are looking for a senior technical leader to own industrial networking and motor control software for our next\-gen RISC\-V\-based real\-time MCUs. Industrial networking sits at the heart of our industrial strategy – where the hardest problems live: complex switch and protocol IP, tight real\-time latency budgets, and a wall of certification and conformance requirements. You’ll lead the software team building production\-grade Industrial Ethernet stacks (EtherCAT, PROFINET, CC\-Link IE TSN, Ethernet/IP), integrating them with motor control on the same MCU, and getting all of it validated on FPGA and first silicon.
   

  

**This Is a Chance To**
* Build the software that turns our industrial protocol IP into something a customer can actually ship.
* Work where networking, real\-time control, and functional safety meet – factory automation, robotics, motor drives, and zonal/edge compute.
* Shape a growing team and set the technical direction for a strategic, high\-visibility area of the business.


 Our aim is to build software components that not only let our IP and SoC solutions be thoroughly validated but also give customers and partners a robust repository of software to kick\-start their adoption of MIPS IP and SoCs – extracting the highest performance from hardware and software working together.
   

  

 If you’re an innovative problem solver with a deep passion for embedded networking and real\-time software, and you like building things from the ground up, we want to hear from you. As our mission goes, we are committed to offering “Freedom to Innovate Compute” – join us in accelerating your impact on the larger industry, and your own growth.
   

  

**Our Key Differentiators**
 Our RISC\-V MCUs are built with features that matter for this domain:
   

  

* Real\-Time Hardware Multithreading (RTMT): run the protocol firmware, TSN/time\-sync, and application on dedicated hardware threads with minimal context\-switching overhead – the key to hitting industrial latency targets.
* Integrated TSN Ethernet switch and industrial protocol IP: multi\-port TSN switch with the full 802\.1 feature set, plus paths to EtherCAT, PROFINET IRT, and CC\-Link IE TSN.
* Custom instructions for math\-intensive motor control, so networking and real\-time control can live on one chip.


**Key Responsibilities**
 Team Leadership
   

  

* Build and lead a 5\+ member cross\-functional embedded software team across industrial networking and motor control.
* Define execution plans, schedules, and quality metrics across SDK, protocol stacks, and validation.
* Mentor engineers; guide them through hard technical calls and delivery pressure.


 Industrial Networking Software
   

  

* Deliver and integrate Industrial Ethernet stacks – EtherCAT (master and SubDevice), PROFINET RT/IRT, Ethernet/IP, CC\-Link IE TSN, Modbus, and HSR/PRP redundancy – through in\-house work and partners (RT\-Labs, be.services, Beckhoff/Siemens IP).
* Own a stack abstraction (port layer) and common APIs so customers and third\-party stacks drop in cleanly.
* Contribute to and leverage the RISC\-V open\-source ecosystem


 Motor Control Software
   

  

* Guide real\-time control software (FOC loops, ADC/PWM handling, encoder interface) and its co\-existence with the networking stack on shared cores/threads.
* Deliver reference applications and customer packages that combine motor control with industrial connectivity.


 Certification, Conformance \& Compliance
   

  

* Own conformance and certification readiness – CLPA (CC\-Link IE TSN), EtherCAT Conformance Test Tool, PROFINET (ART Tester), and TSN profiles (IEC/IEEE 60802\).
* Set up conformance test infrastructure and drive the software to pass it.


 Post\-Silicon Validation (AVV) \& Bring\-Up
   

  

* Define and run the software\-centric validation strategy for the networking and control subsystems on FPGA and first silicon.
* Lead bring\-up, deep debugging, and regression of Ethernet/TSN switch, MACs, DMA, PHYs, timers, CAN/LIN.
* Build automation for lab validation and CI pipelines; support ASIL\-level safety validation where applicable.


 Cross\-Functional \& Customer Engagement
   

  

* Work closely with SoC/hardware, IP (e.g. Comcores/PacketArchitects), and safety teams; feed learnings back into next\-gen switch and CPU features.
* Engage OEM/Tier\-1 and industrial customers (factory automation, robotics, motor drives) on integration, onboarding, and SDK adoption.


**Ideally, You’ll Have**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s in Embedded Systems, Computer Engineering, or Electrical Engineering.
* 7\+ years in embedded software and/or post\-silicon validation, with at least 2\+ years leading a team.
* Deep, hands\-on experience with Industrial Ethernet and TSN – EtherCAT, PROFINET, Ethernet/IP, CC\-Link IE TSN, or HSR/PRP – including the IEEE 802\.1 TSN standards. This is the core of the role; we want someone who has actually shipped and certified this, not read about it.
* Strong RTOS background (FreeRTOS, Zephyr, or similar), device drivers, and real\-time systems.
* Working knowledge of motor control fundamentals (FOC, ADC/PWM, encoders) or a demonstrated ability to lead across networking and control.
* Hands\-on bring\-up and debug with OpenOCD, Segger J\-Link, Lauterbach.
* Solid scripting and automation (Python, Bash) and familiarity with CI/CD.


**You Might Also Have**
* Experience taking an industrial protocol stack through conformance/certification (CLPA, EtherCAT CTT, PROFINET) a real plus.
* Prior delivery of networking or motor control SDKs to Tier\-1s or OEMs.
* Familiarity with LwIP, OpenAvnu, gPTP/1588 time\-sync stacks.
* Knowledge of functional safety (ISO 26262 / IEC 61508\), bootloaders, secure boot, and firmware update.
* Familiarity with RISC\-V ISA; exposure to other ISAs (ARM64, x86\_64\).

Fastly helps people stay better connected with the things they love. Fastly’s edge cloud platform enables customers to create great digital experiences quickly, securely, and reliably by processing, serving, and securing our customers’ applications as close to their end\-users as possible — at the edge of the Internet. The platform is designed to take advantage of the modern internet, to be programmable, and to support agile software development. Fastly’s customers include many of the world’s most prominent companies, including GitHub, Yelp, Paramount, and JetBlue.
   

  

 We're building a more trustworthy Internet. Come join us.
   

  

****Network Support Engineer****
**The Fastly Edge Cloud Platform powers the best of the internet, and our Mission Control Program (MCP) — a key function within our broader Customer Experience organization — ensures this mission is a success through rigorous operational excellence.**
**As a
 **Network Support Engineer** 
 , you are the steward of service quality, distilling vast streams of monitoring data into precise, actionable events before they impact our strategic accounts, high\-profile digital partners, and designated strategic enterprise support customers. You are more than a responder; you are a champion of problem management and continuous improvement, ensuring our platform remains resilient for organizations within our Performance and Focus Centers. During acute platform incidents, you act as a critical advocate for these accounts, collaborating with incident commanders to ensure mitigation strategies prioritize the stability of their unique traffic profiles. Working in association with various engineering teams for network delivery and compute services, you provide the proactive troubleshooting, maintenance coordination, and focus on leading contributing factor analysis required to manage the world's most complex traffic.**

* Advocate for strategic customers during maintenance planning to ensure early notifications and identify necessary configuration updates before implementation
* Partner with incident commanders and escalation management during acute platform disruptions to advocate for strategic accounts and ensure mitigations are targeted for their specific performance needs
* Drive continuous improvement by developing and maintaining shared customer runbooks with customized, proactive thresholds for our Performance, Focus Center, and strategic enterprise partners
* Lead the transition from incident response to problem management by identifying leading contributing factors and coordinating with engineering teams for network delivery and compute services
* Work with Advanced Professional Services to identify platform gaps that may appear as security vulnerabilities or false\-positive attack patterns
* Manage customer CDN configurations via digital channels while advocating for the unique needs of our performance\-critical accounts
* Help scale our proactive support capabilities by developing global monitoring policies rooted in high\-quality industry standards

* Deep foundational knowledge of networking protocols and the ability to debug connections using cURL, traceroute, and MTR

-

Join the team building many of the largest and fastest AI/HPC systems in the world! We are looking for someone with the ability to work on a dynamic customer focused team that requires excellent interpersonal skills. This role will be interacting with customers, partners and internal teams, to analyze, define and implement large scale Networking projects. The scope of these efforts includes a combination of Networking, System Design and Automation and being the face to the customer!
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
* Primary responsibilities will include building AI/HPC infrastructure for new and existing customers.
* Support operational and reliability aspects of large\-scale AI clusters, focusing on performance at scale, real\-time monitoring, logging, and alerting.
* Engage in and improve the whole lifecycle of services—from inception and design through deployment, operation, and refinement.
* Maintain services once they are live by measuring and monitoring availability, latency, and overall system health.
* Provide feedback to internal teams such as opening bugs, documenting workarounds, and suggesting improvements.

* BS/MS/PhD or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, or related fields.
* At least 5\+ years of professional experience in networking fundamentals, Ethernet or InfiniBand World.
* Hands\-on experience with network switch/router platforms like Cumulus Linux, SONiC, IOS, JunosOS, and EOS, etc.

* Capable of independently diagnosing and troubleshooting typical IB/Eth network anomalies, including link flapping, connection failure, as well as bandwidth and latency jitter issues.
* Master practical RDMA network optimization strategies such as QP tuning, MTU configuration and congestion control optimization.
* Hands\-on working experience in RDMA\-accelerated business scenarios, including distributed storage and high\-performance computing clusters.
* Extensive experience delivering automated network provisioning solutions using tools like Ansible, Salt, and Python.

title: Senior HPC Cluster Engineer - AI, ML
description:

Our technology powers everything from generative AI to autonomous systems, and we continue to shape the future of computing through innovation and collaboration. You will provide leadership and strategic guidance on the management of large\-scale HPC systems including the deployment of compute, networking, and storage. You will be working with a team of passionate and skilled engineers across NVIDIA that are continuously working to provide better tools to build and manage this infrastructure. Ideal candidate is strong in building and maintaining distributed clusters, driving improvements, and has the ability to understand researcher computing needs.

* Develop and improve our ecosystem around GPU\-accelerated computing including developing scalable automation solutions.
* Build and maintain heterogeneous AI/ML clusters on\-premises and in the cloud.
* Create and cultivate customer and cross\-team relationships to meet user evolving user needs.
* Support our researchers to run their workloads including performance analysis and optimizations

* Conduct root cause analysis and suggest corrective action Proactively find and fix issues before they occur.

description:
**Job Description**
 We are seeking a results\-driven Senior Network Engineer with strong hands\-on expertise in MPLS, BGP, OSPF, and L2/L3 networking to lead network implementation and operations for large\-scale telecom and metro rail infrastructure projects. The ideal candidate will bring proven experience across multi\-vendor platforms (Cisco, Juniper, Nokia, Allied Telesis, Belden), a track record in NOC operations and incident management, and familiarity with metro domain systems such as CCTV, PA/PIDS, ACID, and FOTS.
   

  

****Key Responsibilities****
* Lead telecom network implementation, configuration, and commissioning for metro rail and enterprise infrastructure projects.
* Configure and manage multi\-vendor network devices including Cisco (ASR, NCS), Juniper (ACX, SRX, EX), Nokia 7705, Allied Telesis, and Belden switches.

* Perform OFC testing and fault detection using OTDR and LSPM tools; conduct signal testing and loss analysis for end\-to\-end connectivity.
* Generate SLA and performance reports, including downtime and penalty calculations.
* Coordinate with cross\-functional and client teams for network upgrades, deployments, and troubleshooting.


**Required Skills \& Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Electronics, Telecommunications, or a related engineering field.
* 8\+ years of experience in telecom/enterprise network operations, with exposure to metro rail or large infrastructure projects preferred.

* Hands\-on experience with Cisco, Juniper, Nokia, Allied Telesis, and Belden networking equipment.
* Experience with network security fundamentals: ACLs, NAT, port security, VACLs, and firewall management (e.g., pfSense).
* Familiarity with NOC operations, incident/escalation management, and SLA monitoring \& reporting.
* Exposure to metro domain systems (CCTV, PA/PIDS, ACID, FOTS) is a strong plus.
* Proficiency with network monitoring tools such as NMS, Athenta NMS, OMS, and iperf.
* Excellent troubleshooting, documentation, and client\-facing communication skills.


**Preferred Certifications**
* CCNA – Cisco Certified Network Associate
* JNCIA – Juniper Networks Certified Associate
* JNCIS\-ENT – Juniper Networks Certified Specialist (Enterprise Routing \& Switching)


****Work Environment****
* Combination of NOC\-based monitoring work and on\-site fieldwork at project locations.
* May require occasional travel to metro/project sites for deployment, testing, and commissioning.
* Fast\-paced environment involving critical infrastructure with defined SLA commitments.

**Job Title**
 TM \- Core Performance
   

  

**Designation**
 Manager \- Core Performance
   

  

**Band**
 M1
   

  

**Function**
 Technology
   

  

**Sub\-Function**
 Central Operations Group :Core Performance\-Active Operations
   

  

**Reports To**
 TL \- Data Core Performance
   

  

**Location Type:**
 Pune\-COR
   

  

**Job Purpose**
 The TM – Core Performance role requires strong knowledge of 4G LTE/EPC and 5G NSA/SA architecture, along with hands\-on experience in Packet Core KPI monitoring, analysis, and troubleshooting. The role also requires a good understanding of core network elements, DNS, interfaces, protocols, Cloud/NFV infrastructure, and Cloud KPIs such as CPU, memory, disk, VM/container health, and network utilization. Key responsibilities include identifying KPI degradation, performing PCAP analysis, conducting troubleshooting and RCA, and coordinating with internal teams and vendors to maintain network performance and service stability.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* PAN\-India Core Monitoring: Monitor performance across multi\-vendor core network nodes, including MME, SGW, PGW, and PCRF.
* Success Rate Tracking: Track key Packet Core success metrics, including S11 SR, ASR, PDN, LUSR, and WiFi\-to\-LTE handovers, and initiate timely corrective actions.
* Capacity and Throughput Management: Audit IP pool utilization and SGW/PGW throughput trends to support demand forecasting and capacity planning.
* Enterprise Platform Oversight: Monitor DRA/OCS performance and AAA/APN\-wise KPIs to support enterprise service efficiency and stability.
* P1 Incident Response: Support high\-priority incident resolution through real\-time KPI analysis, alerting, and coordination with cross\-functional teams.
* Reporting and Audits: Conduct parameter audits for quality compliance and publish weekly Data Core and Cloud KPI trend reports.
* Technology Evolution: Build knowledge across emerging technology areas, including WiFi, DNS, Cloud KPIs, and Packet Core 4G/5G architectures.
* Cloud Infrastructure Monitoring: Monitor infrastructure\-level Cloud KPIs such as CPU load, virtualization latency, VM/container health, and virtual switch packet drops for cloud\-native telecom functions.
* OpenSignal, Customer Complaints and User Experience Monitoring: Monitor OpenSignal KPIs, including download/upload speed, latency, packet loss, discard rate, and TTFB. Analyse customer complaints and experience indicators, correlate them with network KPIs to drive service improvements and corrective actions.


**Technical/ Functional Competencies**
* Packet Core KPI Monitoring: Track performance across MME, SGW, PGW, PCRF, and DNS elements.
* Enterprise Core Performance: Monitor DRA, OCS, PCRF, AAA, and APN performance indicators.
* Data Core Protocols: Understand S11, S5, and S8 interfaces, along with GTP, Diameter, and Radius protocols.
* Capacity Utilization Analysis: Analyse IP pool utilization, throughput trends, and demand projections.
* Network Performance Reporting and Alerting: Prepare KPI dashboards, configure threshold alerts, and support performance reporting.
* Cloud Infrastructure Performance: Understand RHOSP and RHOCP architectures and monitor key cloud performance indicators.
* User Experience KPI Correlation: Correlate OpenSignal, TTFB, latency, throughput, packet loss, and discard\-rate metrics with network performance.


**Behavioural \& Leadership Competencies**
* Analytical Thinking: Strong capability to dissect complex network data and troubleshoot underlying protocol issues.
* First\-Time\-Right Approach: High commitment to quality and accuracy in execution to minimize network downtime.
* Accountability \& Ownership: Demonstrated capability to own network issues from initial detection through to final resolution.
* Digital Mindset: Adaptable to evolving cloud\-native telecom technologies and automated monitoring systems.
* Collaboration: Proven track record of working effectively across cross\-functional engineering and infrastructure teams.


**Qualifications \& Experience**
**Minimum Education Qualification**
 B.E./B.Tech — Electronics / Telecommunications / Computer Science.
   

  

**Years Of Working Experience**
 Minimum 4–6 years of experience in core network performance management or Packet Core operations, with exposure to multi\-vendor 4G/VoLTE environments and a basic understanding of Cloud/NFV infrastructure.

* SNOC — INM, FM, CHM, PM teams
* COG Central Core Operations team
* Enterprise and APN operations teams

* Enterprise \& Roaming Partners: Interconnectivity and national/international roaming carriers.

title: Senior Support Specialist (Security & Network)
description:
*Securonix is leading the transformation of cybersecurity by helping organizations stay ahead of modern threats. Security teams are no longer constrained by data or tools. They are constrained by speed, clarity, and confidence. Securonix was built to close that gap. Our mission is to enable security teams to decide and act faster across the entire threat lifecycle.*
*The Securonix Unified Defense SIEM is the industry’s first platform powered by agentic AI and designed with a human\-in\-the\-loop philosophy. It unifies detection, investigation, and response in a single system. Advanced UEBA delivers deep behavioral insight across users, entities, and data. Native threat intelligence continuously enriches detections and investigations with real\-world context. AI reinforces every layer of the platform while keeping accountability with the security team.*
*Built cloud\-native for scale and performance, the platform enables real\-time analytics, deep investigation, and automated response without compromise. Analysts gain faster access to relevant signals. Investigations move from days to minutes. Response becomes consistent and measurable. The result is a CyberOps experience that scales as threats evolve.*
*Securonix is recognized as a six\-time Leader in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for SIEM and a Customers’ Choice on Gartner Peer Insights. The company has been featured by leading publications including WIRED, Dark Reading, and Fortune for its innovation and leadership in security operations. Organizations rely on the platform for always\-available data, rapid search and investigation, continuously updated threat content, and a fully integrated Threat Detection, Investigation, and Response experience.*
*Backed by Vista Equity Partners, one of the world’s leading enterprise software investors, Securonix benefits from deep operational expertise and a long\-term commitment to innovation and growth. This partnership strengthens our ability to scale the platform, accelerate product execution, and support customers as their security needs evolve.*
*With more than 1,000 customers worldwide, including a meaningful portion of the Fortune 100, Securonix operates at global scale. Our ecosystem of partners and managed security service providers extends that reach, helping organizations deploy and operate with confidence wherever they do business. What drives us is how we work.*
* We win as one team. We operate with trust, respect, and shared accountability.
* We are customer driven. Innovation is guided by real security challenges and measurable outcomes.
* We act with agility. Change is constant, and we stay aligned on purpose while adapting fast.


*That focus is how Securonix helps organizations move from reactive security to proactive, autonomous operations.*
**Role Summary**
 The Senior Support Specialist is a senior security practitioner responsible for defending the organization’s network, infrastructure, and cloud environments against internal and external threats. This role operates at the intersection of security engineering and operations, with direct ownership of network security controls, threat detection, and incident response. Support responsibilities exist to enable security outcomes, not as an end in themselves.
   

  

 This position requires hands\-on expertise, sound judgment under pressure, and the ability to identify systemic risk before it becomes an incident.
   

  

**Core Responsibilities**
 Network Security Ownership
   

  

* Architect, deploy, and continuously harden network security controls including firewalls, VPNs, IDS/IPS, segmentation, and zero\-trust access models.
* Own network perimeter and internal trust boundaries, including firewall policy design, rule lifecycle management, and access validation.
* Actively monitor network traffic and telemetry to identify indicators of compromise, lateral movement, and policy violations.
* Lead vulnerability discovery and remediation for network and infrastructure components.


 Threat Detection \& Incident Response
   

  

* Serve as the primary escalation point for all security incidents involving network intrusion, unauthorized access, malware, or data exposure.
* Perform deep forensic analysis using logs, packet captures, and endpoint data to determine scope and impact.
* Contain, eradicate, and recover from incidents while preserving evidence and maintaining operational continuity.
* Drive post\-incident root cause analysis and ensure corrective controls are implemented, not merely documented.


 Security Operations Engineering
   

  

* Maintain and tune security tooling including SIEM, NDR, EDR/XDR, and vulnerability management platforms.
* Define detection logic, alert thresholds, and response playbooks aligned to real threat models rather than checkbox compliance.
* Reduce noise and false positives while improving time\-to\-detect and time\-to\-contain metrics.


 Security\-Driven Support \& Escalation
   

  

* Handle only the most complex escalations where security risk, system integrity, or availability is at stake.
* Enforce secure configuration standards across systems, networks, and cloud services.
* Mentor support and IT staff on secure operational practices and adversarial thinking.


 Risk, Governance \& Assurance
   

  

* Translate security policy and control requirements into enforceable technical reality.
* Support audits and assessments by producing defensible, technically accurate evidence.
* Continuously assess gaps between documented controls and actual security posture.


 Architecture \& Strategic Hardening
   

  

* Influence infrastructure and application design decisions to reduce attack surface and blast radius.
* Identify architectural weaknesses and advocate for durable, long\-term security improvements.
* Track emerging threats and adjust defensive strategies accordingly.


**Required Experience**
* 7\+ years in security engineering, network security, SOC, or infrastructure defense roles.
* Deep, hands\-on experience with enterprise networking and security architectures.
* Proven incident response experience involving real\-world security events.
* Strong understanding of attacker techniques, lateral movement, and network\-based threats.
* Experience securing cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP).


**Preferred Experience**
* Security certifications (CISSP, GSEC, GCIA, CySA\+, or equivalent).
* Experience operating within SOC 2, ISO 27001, or similar frameworks.
* Scripting or automation capability to improve detection, response, or control enforcement.
* Background supporting SaaS, high\-availability, or distributed environments.


**What Success Looks Like**
* Security incidents are detected earlier and contained faster.
* Network access is tightly controlled, auditable, and aligned with least\-privilege principles.
* Recurring issues are eliminated through structural fixes rather than repeated response.
* Security is embedded into daily operations, not bolted on after failures.


**Benefits**
*As a full\-time employee with Securonix, you will be eligible for the following employee benefits:*
* Health Insurance with a total sum insured is INR 7,50,000
* Coverage: Self, Spouse, 2 kids, Dependent parents, or parents\-in\-law
* Personal Accident with total sum insured is INR 10,00,000
* Term Life Insurance with a sum assured for employees is 5 times fixed base pay is covered.


*Securonix, Inc. provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, amnesty or status as a covered veteran in accordance with applicable federal, state and local laws.*
*Securonix complies with applicable state and local laws governing non\-discrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, and transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.*

description:

**Job Description**
**Meet the Team**
 Cisco Customer Experience (CX) is a global team of extraordinary technical specialists whose singular focus is delivering a premier customer experience. We partner with the world's leading Service Providers to tackle their most complex network transformation challenges — designing, deploying, and optimizing next\-generation infrastructures built on Cisco's industry\-leading IOS\-XR platforms, IP/MPLS architectures, and cloud\-native solutions. Our SP Migration practice sits at the heart of some of the largest and most strategically significant network modernization program globally, driving measurable outcomes for customers while advancing Cisco's position as the trusted partner of choice.
   

  

**Your Impact**
 As a Consulting Engineer (G4\) within the SP Migration practice, you will be an active contributor to the full lifecycle of large\-scale Service Provider network migration projects. Working alongside senior technical leads, you will help accelerate customer business outcomes by supporting the design, configuration, testing, and execution of migrations across Cisco SP platforms. This role offers hands\-on exposure to cutting\-edge network technology, real\-world migration execution, and the opportunity to develop deep expertise in IOS\-XR, IP/MPLS, and automation — positioning you for accelerated career growth within Cisco CX.
   

  

* Support the design and implementation of Service Provider network migrations, including platform upgrades, topology changes, and protocol transitions across Cisco IOS\-XR \& Nexus \-based router platforms (ASR, NCS, and Cisco 8K Series).
* Contribute to the development of technical documentation including test plans, MOPs, and post\-migration validation reports that meet Cisco CX quality standards.
* Apply Python scripting and automation tooling to accelerate repetitive migration tasks, improving delivery efficiency and reducing manual error rates.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams including TAC, and partner organizations to resolve escalated issues and maintain customer satisfaction throughout the migration lifecycle.
* Identify and escalate risks proactively, providing structured problem analysis and recommended mitigation actions to senior engineers and program leads.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Telecommunications, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline; or equivalent, demonstrable work experience in a network engineering role.
* Active CCNA certification; CCNP (Service Provider) certification highly desirable or actively in progress.
* 1–3 years of hands\-on experience configuring, deploying, and troubleshooting Cisco routing and switching platforms, including exposure to IOS\-XR environments.
* Working knowledge of core Service Provider networking protocols: BGP, IS\-IS, OSPF, IP/MPLS, and QoS fundamentals.
* Demonstrated experience supporting or executing network migration activities, including lab validation, MOP adherence, and change window participation.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Familiarity with competitor SP platforms (Juniper, Nokia, Huawei or Arista) is desired.
* Basic proficiency in Python scripting for network automation tasks; exposure to Ansible, REST APIs, or NETCONF/YANG is an advantage.
* Foundational awareness of AI/ML applications in network operations (AIOps) and an interest in leveraging AI\-driven tooling to enhance service delivery.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to document technical procedures clearly and engage confidently with customer technical teams.
* Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively in a team\-oriented, high\-velocity delivery environment; proactive, detail\-oriented, and committed to continuous learning.


 Why Cisco?
   

  

 At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
   

  

 Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
   

  

 We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

title: IT Technical Analyst - Senior
description:
**Job Summary**
 Provides application or infrastructure technical expertise, analysis and specifications for IT systems to meet business requirements in accordance with IT architecture policies and standards; translate requirements into technical specifications, create detailed solution design, coordinate construction, installation, configuration and testing of IT systems; and identifies, troubleshoots and resolves system technical issues.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Assists in creating and managing the technical specifications from which programs and configurations will be applied to create the application, infrastructure or complete solution. Assists in technical analysis of potential solutions including evaluating the technical fit and viability of commercial\-of\-the\-shelf products versus custom built solution. Delivers solution design, adhering to standards and leveraging re\-use of components. Assists in creating high level and detail design of infrastructure OR applications, interfaces, conversions, extensions, reports, and workflows while meeting architecture, security, performance, scalability, and maintainability requirements. Assists technical and infrastructure groups in understanding the solution design and specifications. Works closely with IT technical service providers to ensure outsourced work packages are delivered to specifications, meeting key parameters of quality, schedule, cost, security, performance, and scalability. Participates in formal design reviews and code reviews (where applicable) to ensure the detailed design specifications have been understood and coding standards have been adhered to by the development team(s). Leverages re\-usability of component designs to reduce costs and shorten time to deliver solution Ensures adherence to obtain efficiency in the build and deploy processes, leveraging automation where possible. Assists in the test strategy and execution of master test plan. Participates in the creation of standards, processes, procedures, and guidelines for the IT design and development community as well work instructions or ‘runbooks’ used for end\-user support. Analyzes and revises existing systems and documentation to identify remediation or improvements in the application or infrastructure solution. Provides level 3 support for critical issues.
   

  

**Competencies**
 Customer focus \- Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer\-centric solutions.
   

  

 Global perspective \- Taking a broad view when approaching issues, using a global lens.
   

  

 Manages complexity \- Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.
   

  

 Manages conflict \- Handling conflict situations effectively, with a minimum of noise.
   

  

 Optimizes work processes \- Knowing the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, with a focus on continuous improvement.
   

  

 Data Modeling \- Creates, writes and tests data models, test scripts and build scripts using industry standards and tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance and compliance requirements.
   

  

 Performance Tuning \- Conceptualizes, analyzes and solves application, database and hardware problems using industry standards and tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance and compliance requirements.
   

  

 Solution Configuration \- Configures, creates and tests a solution for commercial off\-the\-shelf (COTS) applications using industry standards and tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance and compliance requirements.
   

  

 Solution Design \- Creates and defines the solution design complete with instrumentation and measurement, using industry standards and tools, version control, and build and test automation to synthesize diagrams, models and documentation in order to build a solution that meets buildability, business, technical, security, governance and compliance requirements.
   

  

 Solution Functional Fit Analysis \- Composes and decomposes a system into its component parts using procedures, tools and work aides for the purpose of studying how well the component parts were designed, purchased and configured to interact holistically to meet business, technical, security, governance and compliance requirements.
   

  

 Solution Modeling \- Creates, designs and formulates models, diagrams and documentation using industry standards, tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance and compliance requirements.
   

  

 Solution Validation Testing \- Validates a configuration item change or solution using the Function's defined best practices, including the Systems Development Life Cycle (SDLC) standards, tools and metrics, to ensure that it works as designed and meets customer requirements.
   

  

 Values differences \- Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.
   

  

**Education, Licenses, Certifications**
 College, university, or equivalent degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, or related subject, or relevant equivalent experience required. This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.
   

  

**Experience**
 8\-10 years of relevant experience required

title: Tech S and T-Network Engineer Senior-GDSN02
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**DevSecOps \& AI Engineer**
**Job Description**
* Build and maintain secure CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, and CircleCI for application, data, and AI workloads.
* Integrate DevSecOps practices into pipelines using Snyk, SonarQube, Checkmarx, Trivy, Anchore, and OWASP tools for continuous security scanning.
* Implement shift\-left security with secret scanning (GitLeaks, TruffleHog), SBOM automation (Syft, CycloneDX), and dependency management (Dependabot, Renovate).
* Work with containerization (Docker/Podman) and Kubernetes (EKS, AKS, GKE) including Helm/Kustomize for deployments and secure image pipelines.
* Develop and automate MLOps workflows using MLflow, Kubeflow, Azure ML, SageMaker, or Vertex AI for model training, packaging, and deployment.
* Build and maintain RAG/AI integration pipelines using LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, and vector databases like Pinecone, Weaviate, or FAISS.
* Implement AI inference systems using Seldon Core, KServe, BentoML, Ray Serve, or Triton Inference Server for scalable model serving.
* Automate ETL/ELT and data feature pipelines using Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, dbt, or Kafka/Kinesis for AI model data feeds.
* Work with IaC tools such as Terraform, Pulumi, CloudFormation, or Azure Bicep to provision cloud and AI infrastructure.
* Implement event\-driven architectures using serverless functions (AWS Lambda, Azure Functions, Cloud Functions) and messaging systems like Kafka or RabbitMQ.
* Maintain monitoring and logging using Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/Loki, OpenTelemetry, Jaeger, Datadog, or New Relic for both app and ML workloads.
* Handle model \& data observability using tools like Evidently AI, Arize AI, WhyLabs, or Fiddler for drift, bias, and performance tracking.
* Secure cloud environments using IAM best practices (AWS IAM, Azure AD/Entra ID, GCP IAM), workload identities, and least\-privilege controls.
* Support configuration management using Ansible, Chef, or SaltStack for environment consistency and automation.
* Develop scripts in Python, Bash, or SQL for automation, data processing, validation, and orchestration of ML workflows.
* Implement API integrations for AI systems using REST, gRPC, or GraphQL for model consumption and downstream applications.
* Use GitOps tools like Argo CD or Flux for automated, secure Kubernetes deployments and progressive delivery.
* Apply AI security practices including guardrails, prompt protection, model validation, and safe inference techniques using industry tools.
* Ensure compliance with data governance, privacy, and security standards including GDPR, CCPA, and cloud security best practices.
* Collaborate with data engineers, ML engineers, DevOps teams, and security teams, contributing to documentation, reviews, and mentoring juniors.


**Desired Profile**
* Looking for a DevSecOps \& AI Engineer with 4–7 years of hands‑on experience in cloud, DevOps, and AI/ML workflows.
* Strong skills in Terraform, Kubernetes, Helm, Docker, and CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Azure DevOps).
* Proficient in Python and scripting (Bash/PowerShell) with good automation mindset.
* Experience implementing DevSecOps practices—SAST/DAST, container scanning, secrets scanning, SBOM, and policy\-as\-code.
* Exposure to MLOps/AI integration using MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker, Azure ML, KServe, or Seldon.
* Familiar with cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), configuration management (Ansible/Puppet), and GitOps tools (Argo CD/Flux).
* Strong communication, troubleshooting, and collaboration skills with ability to work cross‑functionally.


**Experience**
* 4 to 7 years


**Education**
* B.Tech. / BS in Computer Science


**Technical Skills \& Certifications**
* Terraform, Pulumi, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
* Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/GKE), Docker/Podman, Helm, Kustomize
* CI/CD tools: GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Azure DevOps
* Cloud platforms: AWS, Azure, GCP
* Python, Bash, PowerShell scripting
* DevSecOps tools: Snyk, SonarQube, Trivy, Checkmarx, GitLeaks, TruffleHog
* Policy\-as\-code (OPA/Gatekeeper, Kyverno) and SBOM tools (Syft, CycloneDX)
* MLOps tools: MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker, Azure ML, Vertex AI
* Model serving frameworks: KServe, Seldon Core, BentoML, Ray Serve
* Vector DBs \& RAG stack: Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS, Chroma, LangChain, LlamaIndex
* Monitoring \& observability: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/Loki, OpenTelemetry, Jaeger
* Configuration management: Ansible, Puppet
* GitOps: Argo CD, Flux
* Serverless: AWS Lambda, Azure Functions, Google Cloud Functions.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Network Engineer
description:

description:

 As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next\-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry\-first model which brings together the best of in\-house and 3rd party capability.
   

  

 We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
   

  

 \#VOIS \#BeUnrivalled \#CreateTheFuture

 We are seeking a Network Operations \& Transmission Monitoring Specialist to provide 24x7 operational support for network monitoring, incident management, carrier coordination, and service assurance across transmission and transport technologies. This role is based in Pune and is ideal for individuals with experience in network operations centres (NOC), transmission networks, alarm monitoring, and service restoration activities. * Validate alerts using network management systems, databases, and planned network activity records
* Perform initial troubleshooting and basic service impact assessments

* Maintain adherence to established operational processes, service levels, and quality standards


 Contribute to service restoration planning and operational improvement activities

* Experience using Network Management Systems (NMS), Element Management Systems (EMS), monitoring tools, ticketing platforms, Citrix, and remote access technologies
* Understanding of carrier management, incident handling, escalation processes, and service assurance practices
* Working knowledge of IP networking concepts and network change management processes
* Familiarity with testing equipment such as OTDR, RTU, and BERT
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to work effectively under pressure
* Effective written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate across technical and business teams

* Opportunity to work within a global network operations environment supporting critical customer services
* Exposure to diverse transmission, transport, and network management technologies

* Development opportunities within service assurance, incident management, and network operations

title: Tech Solutions Engineer II (L2)

**Technical Support \& Maintenance:**

* Perform routine maintenance, POS integration, and issue resolution to enhance platform performance.


**Product Performance**
* Take ownership of platform performance, driving improvements through proactive monitoring and issue identification.

* Serve as a liaison with internal and external stakeholders, including executives and partners, to address project updates and concerns.

* Collect and analyze data on platform usage, performance, and improvement opportunities.

**Cross\-functional Collaboration**

**Testing \& Optimization**

**Documentation**

* Document changes to scope, timelines, and resources, ensuring alignment with stakeholder approvals.


**Escalation Management**

**Profile And Skills**

* Extensive experience with Linux systems; proficient in Docker and/or Podman.
* Strong scripting abilities in Bash, Python and NodeJS
* Proficient in Git, Prometheus and Grafana
* Knowledge of Cloud technology
* Knowledge of standard network communication protocols such as TCP, UDP, HTTP, WS, FTP.

* Strong capability to troubleshoot complex issues across system resources and application stack traces.
* Proficiency in project management tools such as Microsoft 365, Jira, and Smartsheet.
* Exceptional problem\-solving and organizational abilities, with a proactive and self\-motivated mindset.
* Capable of managing multiple initiatives in a dynamic environment.
* Excellent communication skills for effective collaboration with cross\-functional teams and external stakeholders.
* A passion for AI: Interest in additional education and research about Artificial Intelligence".


**About Everseen**
